title: Senior AI Specialist
description: <h3><strong>Hi 👋 we’re Genio. We create beautifully simple learning tools that boost knowledge, skills, and confidence.</strong></h3> <p> </p> <ul> <li>We’re a SaaS scale up - there’s 90+ of us around the UK with our HQ in Leeds.</li> <li>Our software is award-winning and used by 100,000s of students at over 1,000 universities & colleges worldwide.</li> <li>We’re driven achieve our mission to support 1 million students to become better learners by 2030.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <h4><strong>🚀 About the role</strong></h4> <p><strong>Career track:</strong> IC4</p> <p><strong>Unit:</strong> Shared Services</p> <p> </p> <p>Genio has given everyone access to Claude, but most of what makes AI work across a company doesn’t exist here yet: connections to our business systems, a shared skills library, people in each team who can help their colleagues, and the checks that keep it safe. This role designs and builds that system, then gets every team using it.</p> <p> </p> <p>It’s a hands-on building role. We buy and configure leading platforms rather than build our own agent infrastructure, and you’ll write code and build custom integrations wherever configuration isn’t enough. Success is measured by how well other teams build and run their own workflows.</p> <p> </p> <p><strong>You will be responsible for:</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Design.</strong> You design how our AI platforms, connectors, skills and agents fit together. You track what’s changing in AI tools, recommend platform and model choices to the Head of BizOps, and judge new tools on measured performance, reliability, security and cost.</li> <li><strong>Build and run.</strong> You build and maintain the integrations and agents that connect our AI platforms to business systems such as our CRM and our documentation, communication and finance tools. You’re responsible for the health of the whole system: spotting failures and out-of-date skills, and tracking use and cost by team so they can be recharged and reported. Champions answer first-line questions and IT handles access, while you handle escalations and fix root causes so problems don’t come back.</li> <li><strong>Knowledge.</strong> You build and look after the skills library and the shared knowledge our AI tools draw on: where it lives, how it’s organised, and how it’s kept current and correctly permissioned. You spot good workflows in one team, refine them and make them available to everyone, and decide which become company standards. The teams that own content keep it up to date.</li> <li><strong>Adoption.</strong> You train people at every level of technical skill and build a network of champions, nominated by their function heads, so every team has someone nearby to ask. You work alongside teams as they redesign processes, bringing the options for what can be automated, and share practice with engineering in both directions. You also report, team by team, where use is growing, where it’s slow and which uses are producing value.</li> <li><strong>Guardrails.</strong> You keep the inventory of AI tools and what each can access, run a fast track for low-risk trials using criteria from our AI policy, and coordinate security, data protection and legal reviews for everything else. Every trial starts with agreed success criteria and ends with a decision to adopt, scale or stop. You configure and check guardrails, such as human review before AI output reaches customers or students, and limits on what agents can do on Genio’s behalf.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <h4><strong>👥 Meet the team</strong></h4> <p>You will be reporting directly into the Head of BizOps (Business Operations) and working most closely with:</p> <ul> <li>Division leaders and SME champions</li> <li>Platform Ops and the Principal Engineers</li> <li>Head of EX (Employee Experience), on how roles and expectations change</li> <li>VP Finance, on cost and recharging</li> <li>IT and InfoSec, RevOps and Data in BizOps</li> <li>Legal and data protection</li> </ul> <p> </p> <h4><strong>👤 About you</strong></h4> <p><strong>Essential:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Professional experience rolling out AI tools or automation that teams other than your own use day to day, including redesigning the processes around them.</li> <li>Hands-on experience connecting systems through APIs and automation platforms such as Zapier, Make or n8n, and enough Python or JavaScript to write, read and debug integrations, with AI assistance.</li> <li>A track record of teaching technical things to non-technical people, and a way of knowing it worked.</li> <li>Examples of persuading senior people when you disagreed with their priorities, and of setting your own direction against a wider goal.</li> <li>Sound judgement about data and access, including knowing when a connection needs a security review before it goes live.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Desirable:</strong></p> <ul> <li>HubSpot administration or development</li> <li>Organising shared knowledge, such as documentation or knowledge bases</li> <li>Setting up or running a champions or super-user network</li> <li>Experience in education or with sensitive personal data</li> <li>An engineering background</li> </ul> <p> </p> <h4><strong>💰 Salary and benefits</strong></h4> <p>£70,000 - £85,000 dependent upon experience</p> <ul> <li>🏖️ 33 days annual leave (Inclusive of bank holidays)</li> <li>🎄 3 gifted days off at Christmas</li> <li>💰 EMI Share Options Scheme</li> <li>🎓 Generous individual learning and training allowance</li> <li>⌚ Truly flexible hours to suit when you work best</li> <li>💻 Full home working set up and beautiful collaborative office space</li> <li>🚗 Free Leeds City Centre office parking</li> <li>🌴 Nomad working policy with family travel insurance</li> <li>🍼 Enhanced 26 weeks maternity and 4 weeks paternity (fully paid)</li> <li>🤍 Health cash plan (from glasses to massages)</li> <li>💸 6% employer pension contribution</li> </ul> <p> </p> <h4><strong>📍 Location</strong></h4> <p>Our beautiful office space in Leeds is our key hub for collaboration, and we love to get together in person. We operate a flexible hybrid working model, including supporting our Genios who are based remotely across the UK. If you are more than 50 miles away from the office, we offer full remote working support, with the opportunity to join colleagues for in-person collaboration several times a year.</p> <p>We will discuss ways of working with you at interview however if you have any questions before you apply please reach out to <a ---------- <p> </p> <h4><strong>📄 Applicant Privacy Notice</strong></h4> <p>We think it’s important that you understand how we use and handle your personal information, so here’s a link to our <a href="https://glean.co/glean-applicant-privacy-notice">privacy notice.</a> By submitting your application, you’re confirming that you’ve read and understood this notice.</p> Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: National Account Executive
description: <h2><strong>Job Description</strong></h2> <p>As the <strong>National Account Executive - Retail</strong>, you will serve as a key operational and commercial partner to our National Account Managers across our key retail channels (Majors, Independents, and Petrol & Convenience). You will act as a primary liaison with retail buying teams to coordinate promotional execution, evaluate campaign performance, and partner cross-functionally across Marketing, Finance, and Supply Chain to drive the growth of our Youfoodz retail business.</p> <p>This role is based in <strong>Chippendale, Sydney</strong> and reports to the <strong>Senior National Account Manager</strong>.</p> <h2> </h2> <p><strong>You will…</strong></p> <ul> <li>Accurately track and manage customer promotional mechanics, trade spend investment, and records of promotional activity and pricing changes.</li> <li>Partner with Commercial Finance to proactively investigate, track, and resolve customer claims, deductions, and discrepancies.</li> <li>Generate weekly, monthly, and quarterly sales and commercial performance reports, highlighting key trends and variances for the NAM team.</li> <li>Synthesize retail market and competitor insights across in-store, digital, and e-commerce channels.</li> <li>Support demand planning and supply chain teams by providing volume forecasts based on confirmed promotional plans, monitoring stock-on-hand status, and mitigating out-of-stock risks.</li> <li>Prepare impactful presentation materials for annual range reviews, category reviews, and new product development (NPD) sell-ins.</li> <li>Coordinate the timely delivery of product samples, marketing assets, and retailer compliance documentation.</li> <li>Serve as the operational bridge between the sales team and internal departments to troubleshoot day-to-day retailer queries regarding logistics, invoicing, and POS.</li> </ul> <h2> </h2> <p><strong>You have…</strong></p> <ul> <li>1–3 years of experience in an analytical, administrative, field sales, or commercial support role within With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence, and world-class partnerships – all united by our pioneering agentic marketing platform, WPP Open – we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity, and deliver transformational growth. </p> <p>WPP Media is WPP's AI-driven media operating unit, bringing together media, data, and partnerships to deliver creative personalisation at scale. Mit der Kraft von Kreativität gestalten wir eine bessere Zukunft für unsere Mitarbeitenden, unsere Kunden, unsere Gemeinschaften und unseren Planeten. Genau hier setzt WPP Media an: Als globales Mediennetzwerk von WPP vereinen wir die besten Plattformen, Talente und Partner, um in einer vernetzten Medienwelt neue Chancen für grenzenloses Wachstum zu schaffen.</p> <p> </p> <h2><strong>Das bieten wir dir:</strong></h2> <ul> <li><strong>Work-Life-Balance</strong>: Dank flexibler Arbeitszeiten mit Schwerpunkt auf dem persönlichen Austausch im Office und ergänzender Remote Work passt sich dein Job deinem Leben an. Überstunden kannst du flexible ausgleichen.</li> <li><strong>Vacation mode on</strong>: Du erhältst 30 Urlaubstage plus einen flexiblen Tag – zusätzlich sind der 24. und 31.12. frei.</li> <li><strong>Wellbeing first: </strong>Gesundheitsleistungen, attraktive Altersvorsorge sowie Mental Health Awareness Days stellen deine Gesundheit in den Mittelpunkt.</li> <li><strong>Practice makes perfect</strong>: Entfalte dich mit unseren vielfältigen Weiterbildungen und nutze unsere internen Karriereprogramme für deine Entwicklung im WPP-Netzwerk.</li> <li><strong>More than just a job</strong>: Dich erwarten unvergessliche Events, Mitarbeitendenrabatte und weitere Highlights wie das Job Ticket, Wellhub oder das Job Bike.</li> <li><strong>Be yourself</strong>: Bei uns ist jede:r herzlich willkommen - Vielfalt und Chancengleichheit liegen uns am Herzen.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <h2><strong>Das bewegst du:</strong></h2> <p></p> <p><span data-teams="true">Als <strong>Werkstudent (Mensch)</strong> für unseren Kunden <strong>Estee Lauder </strong>erlebst du Mediaarbeit für eines der weltweit führenden Prestige-Beauty-Unternehmen aus nächster Nähe. Du packst im Tagesgeschäft mit an, lernst vom Team und übernimmst Schritt für Schritt eigene Aufgaben.</span></p> <ul> <li><strong>Kampagnenunterstützung:</strong> Du unterstützt das Team bei Planung, Umsetzung und Steuerung crossmedialer Kampagnen für die Marken von Estée Lauder</li> <li><strong>Reporting:</strong> Du erstellst Reportings und Präsentationen und bereitest Kampagnenergebnisse verständlich auf</li> <li><strong>Analyse:</strong> Du wertest Mediadaten aus und leitest erste Optimierungsansätze ab</li> <li><strong>Marktbeobachtung:</strong> Du behältst Trends im Beauty-Markt und Aktivitäten im Wettbewerb im Blick</li> <li><strong>Koordination:</strong> Du pflegst Daten in unseren Tools und unterstützt die Abstimmung mit Vermarktern und Partnern</li> </ul> <p> </p> <h2><strong>Das zeichnet dich aus:</strong></h2> <p></p> <ul> <li><strong>Studium:</strong> Du bist an einer Hochschule eingeschrieben, idealerweise in Wirtschaft, Medien, Marketing, Kommunikation oder einem vergleichbaren Fach</li> <li><strong>Mediainteresse:</strong> Du begeisterst dich für Media, Marketing und Beauty; erste Praxiserfahrung in Agentur oder Marketing ist ein Plus</li> <li><strong>Zahlenaffinität:</strong> Du arbeitest gern mit Daten und bist sicher in Excel und PowerPoint</li> <li><strong>Sprachkenntnisse:</strong> Du kommunizierst sicher auf Deutsch (mind. C1) und gut auf Englisch</li> <li><strong>Organisationstalent:</strong> Du arbeitest strukturiert und sorgfältig und behältst auch bei parallelen Aufgaben den Überblick</li> </ul> <p>Darüber hinaus bist du:<strong> #neugierig #zuverlässig #teamorientiert</strong></p> <p>Wenn du diesen Job spannend findest, dann ermutigen wir dich ausdrücklich zur Bewerbung, auch wenn du nicht jede oben gelistete Qualifikation aufweisen kannst.</p> <p> </p> <h2><strong>Arbeiten bei WPP Media:</strong></h2> <p>Als WPP Media gestalten wir die Zukunft der Medien und investieren dabei konsequent in unsere Mitarbeiter:innen. Jede:r Kolleg:in genießt die Vorteile des globalen Netzwerks von WPP Media und WPP, um sich weiterzuentwickeln und an der Spitze von Marketing und Werbung zu lernen. Vielfalt und Zusammenhalt leben wir durch zahlreiche Employee Resource Groups und regelmäßige interne Events - zum Austausch, zur Inspiration und zum gemeinsamen Feiern unserer Erfolge.<br> <br>WPP Media ist ein Arbeitgeber, der Chancengleichheit fördert. Wir berücksichtigen alle Bewerber:innen für alle Positionen ohne Diskriminierung. title: Outcomes Architect, Nordics (Customer Success)
description: WHO WE ARE Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion. Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work. ABOUT THE ROLE: Notion is reimagining how customers adopt, expand, and realize value from software in an AI-native world. As an Outcomes Architect, you’ll be the build-beside partner who helps customers turn ambition into working systems inside Notion. You’ll own workflow adoption, value delivery, and renewal outcomes for a book of named accounts, with a focus on customers that are flat, at-risk, or need a stronger path to measurable impact. You’ll partner closely with Solutions Consultants on account strategy, expansion qualification, and customer success planning, while directly shaping outcomes that strengthen customer partnerships and contribute to predictable revenue. If you’re a builder who loves helping customers solve real business problems—and you want to work at the intersection of AI, productivity, customer value, and revenue impact—this is the role. This role will be based in Dublin. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days. WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE: - Drive workflow adoption and value realization for a book of named accounts, ensuring customers expand their use of Notion and as a result, Notion sees high NRR - Partner closely with the Solutions Consultant on account strategy for expansion and renewal, including owning the renewal opportunity for flat and at-risk customers - Shape customer outcomes, strengthen executive and team-level partnerships, and contribute directly to predictable revenue through retention, renewal, and expansion impact - Design and deploy workflows that solve specific business problems as a build-beside partner to the customer, translating goals into durable systems in Notion - Partner with Solutions Consultants on account strategy, customer planning, and identifying and qualifying expansion opportunities within existing accounts - Co-define, build, and manage against customer success plans that help every customer achieve their desired objectives and realize measurable value - Learn Notion’s product and the broader AI ecosystem inside and out so you can be the best build-beside partner for customers navigating new ways of working - Innovate and iterate on Outcomes Architect programs that retain and grow customers while mitigating churn or contraction risk SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: - Experience driving customer adoption, value realization, renewals, or expansion within a B2B software environment - Strong customer-facing discovery instincts, with the ability to understand business problems, map workflows, and translate goals into practical implementation plans - Technical fluency and genuine comfort building live in software—you can co-design, configure, and troubleshoot with customers in the room - Commercial awareness and the ability to partner with account owners on renewal risk, expansion potential, and account strategy - Strong program and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to manage success plans, timelines, risks, and customer commitments across a book of accounts - You operate with agency, urgency, and customer empathy, bringing structure to ambiguous problems and helping teams move from ideas to working systems - You’re obsessed with AI, constantly building with the newest tools and learning new ways of working NICE TO HAVES: - Prior experience in customer success, solutions consulting, implementation, technical account management, or post-sales strategy for productivity, collaboration, or workflow software - Experience working with flat, at-risk, or complex renewal accounts and helping customers return to a clear value path - Familiarity with usage-based or consumption-based models and the ability to connect adoption patterns to commercial outcomes - The professional services that feed it (design, engineering, feasibility, permitting) represent hundreds of billions in spend that no one has seriously automated. Proptech spent the last decade selling SaaS on the edges of these workflows. Every project compounds our data advantage across typologies, geographies and regulatory contexts. Architects cycle through dozens of floorplan revisions to meet regulatory and client constraints, each round taking days, each missed constraint restarting the loop. title: Change and Transformation Manager - Client Delivery (Fluency in French & English required)
description: Change and Transformation Manager – Client Delivery (French/english) Location: Paris, France (hybrid, three days a week in the office; occasional travel to Brussels and London) Level: Programme Manager senior Team: Client Delivery Contract: Permanent Reporting To: Operating Model Design Lead Please note: This role is based in France, so you need to live here or be open to relocating, and it requires an existing right to work in the EU. We can’t offer visa sponsorship, but we review sponsorship role by role, so keep an eye on our careers site for future opportunities. Fluent French and English (spoken and written) are essential, and we kindly ask you to submit your CV in English. About Kaluza Kaluza is the Energy Intelligence Platform, turning energy complexity into seamless coordination. We help energy companies overcome today’s challenges while accelerating the shift to a clean, electrified future. Our platform orchestrates millions of real-time decisions across homes, devices, markets and grids. By combining predictive algorithms with human-centred design, Kaluza makes clean energy dependable, affordable and adaptive to everyday life. With teams across Europe, Asia and Australia, and a joint venture with Mitsubishi Corporation in Japan, we power leading companies including OVO, AGL and ENGIE, as well as innovators like Volvo and Volkswagen. What you’ll do Own change and transformation support for go-live readiness for ENGIE France’s migration onto Kaluza as the hands-on lead, from planning through cutover, hypercare and transition towards scaling, so ENGIE’s teams are ready and confident to adopt the platform from day one. Decide the change approach for the programme: stakeholder analysis, change impact assessment, training design and business readiness engagement, shaped to ENGIE France’s operating context and owned by their teams. Operate Kaluza’s business readiness governance: stage gates, readiness evidence, risk and dependency tracking and weekly reporting. Partner with the Learning and Adoption Specialist in France to coordinate training, Train the Trainer and knowledge content, so enablement lands throughout each programme increment as we build out and release features via Agile delivery. Be the day-to-day point of contact for ENGIE France on business readiness, change and adoption, giving practical change advice to their transformation leads. Track adoption and operational stability through hypercare, root-cause any shortfall against acceptance criteria, and agree interventions with ENGIE. Improve Kaluza’s readiness playbook: evolve what worked on ENGIE Belgium, test fixes where it falls short in France, and share what you learn with colleagues across Client Delivery to shape the platform’s operational foundations and improvements and to set our global standards. Day to day, the activities you’ll lead or support include: Change impact and readiness planning: diagnosing the full scope of impacts across roles, workflows, systems and customer experience, then turning them into a prioritised readiness plan sequenced against delivery, migration and release cadence. Stakeholders, sponsors and change networks: mapping stakeholders and influence at workstream level, helping sponsors stay visible and engaged, and shaping the champion, superuser and people-manager networks that carry change into ENGIE’s business. Communications and resistance: supporting ENGIE France’s own communications and engagement strategy, so their teams and customers hear a consistent, positive story about the programme. You’ll help leaders and champions advocate for the change, internally and with customers, and anticipate where resistance may form so you can intervene before it becomes entrenched. Migration and go-live readiness: building the business and operational readiness evidence that enables a smooth transfer to service, measured against the agreed acceptance criteria, and supporting the go-live command centre. Hypercare and stabilisation: agreeing hypercare entry and exit criteria, monitoring stability and adoption signals, and handing over cleanly to ENGIE’s business-as-usual teams. Early releases and workarounds: planning for known limitations in early releases, and reflecting them in training, knowledge and communications so users are never caught by surprise. You’ll work with Release Management so each platform release arrives with the enablement it needs. What you’ll bring Ideally, you’ll have: Several years of hands-on change delivery on large platform or systems transformations, with a recognised change management discipline. You solve a wide range of problems creatively and work with little supervision. Experience in regulated, customer-facing operational environments, including live customer account migration, cutover and go-live, where you have shaped the approach rather than only followed one. Strong communication and stakeholder management, credible with client programme leads and transformation sponsors. Fluency in French and English, written and spoken. Comfort working with data: you explore adoption and programme data yourself, report on it clearly and challenge decisions when evidence is weak. Commercial awareness: you understand how Kaluza makes money and balance what the client needs against cost, working alongside SI partners and the client’s own change resources without duplicating effort. What will set you apart: a background in energy retail or utilities, vendor-side experience on a SaaS implementation, and/or knowledge of contact centre operations and technology. Our Values Five values guide how we work at Kaluza: Play to win: Collective pride in decarbonising energy at scale. Solve the real problem: Cutting through complexity to focus on real-world outcomes. Build trust every day: Consistency, transparency and doing what we say. Own the outcome: Full accountability, wins and setbacks, without ego. Go further together: Collaboration, respect and different perspectives. Our Perks Financial & Insurance: Discretionary bonus, Alan Mutuelle Health Insurance, x3 Life & Death insurance (Prévoyance) via Alan, and standard Sécurité Sociale contributions (pension, family allowance, unemployment insurance) Allowances: 50% commuting expense reimbursement, €200 Home Working Allowance, and €150 Learning Fund Time Off & Flexibility: 25 days holiday + bank holidays + RTT days, Moments That Matter Leave, Compassionate Leave, two paid Volunteering Days, Flexible Working, and Career Break eligibility Come as you are We want to meet people from all walks of life. The more inclusive we are, the better our work will be, and we recognise talent on merit and potential. If you’re excited about the role but don’t tick every box, we’d still love to hear from you. Find out more on our careers page and LinkedIn . Our Applicant Data Protection Policy is here . Compensation: €56 – €75 • €56 – €75 Find more English Speaking Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

title: Product Manager – Agent Experience ( Français/ Anglais)
description: Product Manager – Agent Experience Lieu : Paris de préférence, possibilité à Londres (hybride, trois jours par semaine au bureau) Équipe : Customer Care Langues : Maîtrise du français et de l’anglais Contrat : CDI Rattachement : Lead Product Manager À noter : ce poste est ouvert à Paris et à Londres, et nécessite un droit de travailler déjà acquis dans le pays où vous serez basé(e) (UE pour Paris, Royaume-Uni pour Londres). Nous ne pouvons pas proposer de parrainage de visa, mais nous étudions le parrainage poste par poste : gardez un œil sur notre site carrières pour de futures opportunités. Merci de soumettre votre CV en anglais. À propos de Kaluza Kaluza est la plateforme d’Energy Intelligence qui transforme la complexité de l’énergie en coordination fluide. Nous aidons les énergéticiens à relever les défis d’aujourd’hui tout en accélérant la transition vers un avenir propre et électrifié. Notre plateforme orchestre des millions de décisions en temps réel entre les foyers, les appareils, les marchés et les réseaux. En associant algorithmes prédictifs et conception centrée sur l’humain, Kaluza rend l’énergie propre fiable, abordable et adaptée à la vie de tous les jours. Avec des équipes en Europe, en Asie et en Australie, et une joint-venture avec Mitsubishi Corporation au Japon, nous accompagnons des acteurs majeurs comme OVO, AGL et ENGIE, ainsi que des entreprises innovantes comme Volvo et Volkswagen. Ce que vous ferez Piloter la roadmap : porter la stratégie de bout en bout de Kaluza Agent Experience (KAE) sur le marché européen, en cohérence avec les objectifs produit globaux et affinée par les besoins clients locaux et les comportements des agents. Vous suivrez les indicateurs opérationnels clés (AHT, FCR, CSAT, adoption de l’IA, onboarding) pour vous assurer que chaque évolution améliore l’expérience des agents et des clients. Concevoir les parcours et garantir la cohérence UX : être le garant de l’expérience agent sur l’ensemble de KAE. Vous travaillerez avec les équipes UX et métier pour appliquer des patterns communs, réduire la charge cognitive des agents et rester aligné avec le design system, y compris quand de nouvelles capacités d’automatisation et d’assistance par l’IA sont introduites. Mener les intégrations et l’onboarding client : piloter les intégrations techniques et produit avec des plateformes tierces, et superviser de bout en bout le déploiement de nouvelles instances KAE pour les nouveaux clients, de la phase de découverte jusqu’à la mise en production. Garantir l’accessibilité et la conformité : défendre les réglementations européennes d’accessibilité dès la conception, en traduisant les exigences réglementaires et spécifiques à chaque marché en besoins techniques concrets. Accompagner les clients et créer de la valeur : être l’expert de confiance des clients sur l’expérience agent, en défendant une configuration native de la plateforme plutôt que des développements sur mesure. Rester les mains dans le cambouis, de la livraison à l’accompagnement : vous impliquer sur l’ensemble du cycle de vie du développement produit (PDLC), des sessions de discovery avec les agents aux boucles de feedback, et produire les supports qui favorisent l’adoption côté clients. (À noter : des déplacements chez les clients, par exemple à Bruxelles, sont à prévoir, environ 1 à 3 par mois au début, puis 1 à 2 par trimestre.) Ce que vous apporterez Idéalement, vous avez : Une expertise centres de contact et UX : une solide expérience de la responsabilité de parcours utilisateurs de bout en bout pour des outils opérationnels très sollicités (par exemple des postes de travail d’agents), avec une vraie pratique de la recherche utilisateur, de la cartographie de parcours et des tests d’usabilité auprès d’agents et de superviseurs. Une connaissance de l’accessibilité européenne et de l’intégration de plateformes : une bonne maîtrise des standards d’accessibilité européens, ainsi qu’une expérience avérée d’intégration de produits avec des plateformes tierces et des écosystèmes de fournisseurs complexes. Une expérience de delivery client et d’expansion de marché : un historique de mise en œuvre ou de localisation d’un produit pour des clients entreprise externes, en menant les solutions de zéro à la mise en production : discovery, configuration et conduite du changement. description: Location: Munich / Frankfurt – hybrid Type: Full-time Level: Senior Reporting to: Co-founder & CRO About Nebuly Nebuly is a fast-growing, VC-backed startup building the platform that proves the ROI of enterprise AI. But most companies can't answer a basic question: is this spend actually working? Every enterprise deploying AI agents is asking the same question: is this actually delivering value? Today, almost none of them can answer it. The signal that could answer it is right there — millions of conversations happening every day between employees, customers, and these agents — but it's unstructured, high-volume, and invisible without the right infrastructure. So the ROI question stays unanswered, not because the answer doesn't exist, but because no one can see it. Nebuly makes that signal visible. It sits on top of any enterprise AI deployment, turns those conversations into a clear answer — is this working, and where — and connects the dots back to ROI. title: Senior Sensor Engineer (f/m/d)
description: About TACTILIA At TACTILIA, we are building the industry-ready robotic hand that closes one of the biggest gaps in Physical AI. Spun out of Schunk, the global market leader in gripping technology, we combine a decade of robotic-hand expertise and real industrial access with the speed and ambition of a deep-tech startup. This isn't a research project waiting for its first customer. We already have a product, customers are ready to use it, and we are launching now. Your work will directly shape the electronics, actuators, and embedded systems that make that possible. You will join at the moment when the hard engineering questions become real product decisions: how do we make a highly capable robotic hand reliable, manufacturable, serviceable, and simple enough to deploy on a real shop floor? The Role As a Senior Sensor Engineer (Tactile & Proprioception) at TACTILIA Robotics, you will build the neural architecture of physical touch and spatial awareness that gives our robotic hands human-like dexterity. You will own the complete sensing architecture—from evaluating tactile technologies and proprioceptive layouts to designing readout electronics, calibration matrix algorithms, and real-time sensor pipelines. Fitting high-density sensing skins, force feedback, and position tracking into a tight hand envelope means balancing signal integrity, low latency, and mechanical durability under high cyclic wear. You will work closely with Mechanics, Electronics, and Software to turn raw physical contact into clean, reliable data for real-time robotic control. What you will do: Own the sensing architecture. Lead the evaluation, selection, and overall design of tactile and proprioceptive sensing systems across fingers, palm, and joints—built for modularity across product variants, not a one-off prototype. Develop tactile array hardware. Design and prototype high-resolution tactile sensors (optical, capacitive, piezoresistive, or magnetic) tailored for space-constrained, contact-rich finger pads and palm surfaces. Engineer proprioceptive feedback. Implement joint- and drive-level feedback mechanisms, including high-precision position/angle sensing, strain gauge force bridges, load cells, and tendinous tension tracking. Design readout electronics & AFEs. Build low-noise analog front-ends (AFEs), signal conditioning circuits, and local readout hardware optimized for minimal latency, wide dynamic range, and high immunity to electromagnetic interference (EMI). Build calibration & processing pipelines. Implement automated calibration protocols, thermal/drift compensation matrix algorithms, and feature extraction (e.g., slip detection, contact point estimation) to feed clean telemetry to the software stack. Characterize & validate on real hardware. Own sensor testing on custom rigs—evaluating dynamic response, force linearity, hysteresis, spatial resolution, and long-term mechanical wear over hundreds of thousands of cycles. Drive sensor manufacturing & yield. Partner with specialized suppliers on Design for Manufacturing (DFM) for flexible/rigid-flex PCBs, molded tactile skins, and elastomeric components, ensuring high assembly yield and second-sourcing. Work across the whole team. Tight loop with Mechanics (for load paths and physical packaging), Electronics (for board interfaces), and Software (for state estimation and closed-loop grasp control). What you bring: Degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechatronics, Physics, Sensorics, Robotics, or a related field. 5–10 years of experience developing sensor hardware, mechatronic instrumentation, or sensor fusion systems, including at least one product taken into series production. Deep domain expertise in tactile sensing modalities (e.g., optical tactile/GelSight style, piezoresistive, capacitive) or high-density proprioceptive feedback (encoders, strain gauges, load cells). Proven experience in analog circuit design, signal conditioning (AFE), active filtering, and high-SNR data acquisition for physical sensors. Hands-on experience with sensor calibration techniques, thermal/hysteresis modeling, signal processing, and standard communication buses (SPI, I2C, CAN). Practical experience designing or integrating flexible PCBs, molded elastomers, or miniaturized mechatronic assemblies into tight physical envelopes. A strong hardware mindset: you enjoy lab bring-up, sensor characterization on test rigs, and tracing physics-to-signal anomalies with scopes and logic analyzers. Fluent in English; German is a plus, not a requirement. Bonus: Background in real-time embedded C/C++ firmware or ROS/ROS2 for sensor data processing and filtering. Experience with tactile algorithms for slip prediction, texture recognition, or contact shape estimation. Experience with soft robotics, stretchable electronics, or conductive polymers. Knowledge of Machinery Regulation, ISO/TS 15066, and sensor design for collaborative applications. The next chapter of robotics won't be built in a lab. It will be built by people who care about what happens when technology meets the real world. At TACTILIA, you'll work on one of the hardest open problems in robotics: giving machines the dexterity, reliability, and robustness they need to interact with the physical world at industrial scale. The technology is taking shape. The team is being built. And the standards for robotic hands and their skills are still wide open. That means your decisions will have a lasting impact — not just on a product, but on what comes next for Physical AI. Build the hand. Define the standard. Shape what comes next. If you're excited by the challenge of building robotic hands that work reliably in the real world, we'd love to hear from you. Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Product Manager, Flora
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><h3>Locations: Austin, Lisbon, San Francisco, NYC, or London</h3> <h3>About the Role</h3> <p>Search is being rebuilt around AI. People increasingly get answers from AI instead of a list of links, agents run dozens of searches to answer a single question, and <a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/agentic-web/">more than half of the traffic reaching sites on Cloudflare is now automated</a>. Search is shifting from a destination to a utility, and Cloudflare is building the search layer for this agentic Internet.</p> <p>Agentic Search at Cloudflare gives agents everything they need to find information, whether it lives in a customer’s own data or on the open web. It spans two products: AI Search for internal data, and Web Search API for the open web.</p> <p><a href="https://developers.cloudflare.com/ai-search/">AI Search</a> (internal data), <a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/ai-search-ga/">now generally available</a>, is the <a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/ai-search-agent-primitive/">search primitive for applications and agents</a>. It is a fully managed indexing and retrieval pipeline built on <a href="https://developers.cloudflare.com/workers-ai/">Workers AI</a>, <a href="https://developers.cloudflare.com/vectorize/">Vectorize</a>, <a href="https://developers.cloudflare.com/r2/">R2</a>, and <a href="https://developers.cloudflare.com/browser-run/">Browser Run</a>. Developers connect a website or R2 bucket, or upload their own files, and query them with natural language through a Workers binding, REST API, or MCP server. Under the hood: continuous indexing, hybrid vector and keyword retrieval, reranking, metadata filtering, native multimodal (image) embeddings, and OCR for scanned documents. We use it to power search on our own blog and developer docs.</p> <p><a href="https://developers.cloudflare.com/web-search/">Web Search API</a> (external data), <a href="https://developers.cloudflare.com/changelog/post/2026-10-02-introducing-web-search-api/">now in open beta</a>, gives agents real-time web context with a single API call. It runs on <a href="https://developers.cloudflare.com/ai-gateway/">AI Gateway</a>, so every search gets the same logging, analytics, billing, and access controls as model inference. Developers can choose from <a href="https://developers.cloudflare.com/web-search/providers/">multiple search providers</a> and always get results back in one normalized format.</p> <p>Your mission in this role is to make Cloudflare the default place developers and agents go to search, across both their own data and the open web, and eventually in a single call. You’ll also help build a search ecosystem that works for AI companies, site owners, and creators alike.</p> <h3>What You’ll Do</h3> <ul> <li>Talk directly with developers, AI companies, publishers, and customers every day.</li> <li>Own the strategy, roadmap, and execution for Agentic Search (AI Search and Web Search API), from ingestion and indexing through retrieval, ranking, and answer generation.</li> <li>Define and measure what “good search” means, including relevance, freshness, latency, and cost, and build the evals that improve it with every release.</li> <li>Scale AI Search for the workloads that matter most, like multi-tenant platforms, enterprise agents, and website search, with support for billions of documents, rich media, and built-in observability.</li> <li>Take Web Search API and shape what comes next: provider partnerships, search and page extraction in one call, blending web and private data,</li> <li>Own pricing and packaging, and make our products first-class for agents through MCP, agent-friendly APIs, and templates like <a href="https://developers.cloudflare.com/ai-search/how-to/nlweb/">NLWeb</a>.</li> <li>Partner with engineering, ML, and product teams across <a href="https://developers.cloudflare.com/workers-ai/">Workers AI</a>, <a href="https://developers.cloudflare.com/vectorize/">Vectorize</a>, <a href="https://developers.cloudflare.com/ai-gateway/">AI Gateway</a>, <a href="https://developers.cloudflare.com/browser-run/">Browser Run</a>, and <a href="https://developers.cloudflare.com/ai-crawl-control/">AI Crawl Control</a>, as well as Marketing, DevRel, BD, Sales, and Support.</li> <li>Represent Cloudflare at conferences, community events, and customer and partner meetings.</li> </ul> <h3>Examples of Desirable Skills, Knowledge, and Experience</h3> <ul> <li>Proven experience as a PM, EM, or founder shipping search, information retrieval, data infrastructure, or developer platform products. You’ve led teams to ship before and can point to impact.</li> <li>Deep understanding of how search works end to end: crawling, indexing, chunking, embeddings, hybrid retrieval (BM25 + vector), query rewriting, reranking, and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG). You understand the tradeoffs between relevance, freshness, latency, and cost.</li> <li>Experience defining and measuring search quality, including offline evals, relevance judgments, metrics like recall, MRR, and NDCG, and online experimentation.</li> <li>Fluency in the modern AI ecosystem: LLMs, text and multimodal embedding models, agents, tool calling, and MCP. You’ve built with them yourself and know where they break.</li> <li>Hands-on ability to write code and use AI and the Internet to learn new things fast. You’ve built a RAG pipeline or an agent that searches the web, and you have opinions about what made it good or bad.</li> <li>Deep empathy for developers and understanding of their workflows, pain points, and how they adopt new tools and platforms.</li> <li>Understanding of the web publishing ecosystem: crawlers, bots, SEO and answer engine optimization (AEO), and the changing economics of AI search for content creators. Comfortable working where technology, business, and policy meet.</li> <li>Experience with usage-based pricing, two-sided marketplaces, or partner and business development relationships, including build-vs-partner decisions, is a plus.</li> <li>Exceptional communication and collaboration skills. You can translate between ML research, infrastructure engineering, and business stakeholders, and align diverse teams on goals.</li> <li>Passion for design details and polish. You raise the bar for sweating the details.</li> <li>External presentation skills. You can walk into a room of developers or AI company leaders and build trust and credibility.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Compensation</strong></p> <p>Compensation may be adjusted depending on work location.</p> <ul> <li><span data-sheets-root="1">For Seattle/NYC/California based hires - Estimated annual salary of: $172,000 - $215,000</span></li> <li><span data-sheets-root="1">For SF/Bay Area based hires - Estimated annual salary of: $179,000 - $224,000</span></li> <li><span data-sheets-root="1">For Lisbon based hires - Estimated annual salary of: €68,000 - €85,000</span></li> </ul> <p><strong>Equity</strong></p> <p>This role is eligible to participate in Cloudflare’s equity plan.</p> <p><strong>Benefits</strong></p> <p>Cloudflare offers a complete package of benefits and programs to support you and your family.  Our benefits programs can help you pay health care expenses, support caregiving, build capital for the future and make life a little easier and fun!  The below is a description of our benefits for employees in the United States, and benefits may vary for employees based outside the U.S.</p> <p><strong>Health & Welfare Benefits</strong></p> <ul> <li>Medical/Rx Insurance</li> <li>Dental Insurance</li> <li>Vision Insurance</li> <li>Flexible Spending Accounts</li> <li>Commuter Spending Accounts</li> <li>Fertility & Family Forming Benefits</li> <li>On-demand mental health support and Employee Assistance Program</li> <li>Global Travel Medical Insurance</li> </ul> <p><strong>Financial Benefits</strong></p> <ul> <li>Short and Long Term Disability Insurance</li> <li>Life & Accident Insurance</li> <li>401(k) Retirement Savings Plan</li> <li>Employee Stock Participation Plan</li> </ul> <p><strong>Time Off</strong></p> <ul> <li>Flexible paid time off covering vacation and sick leave</li> <li>Leave programs, including parental, pregnancy health, medical, and bereavement leave</li> </ul> <p> </p><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.</span></p> <p><a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/protecting-free-expression-online/"><strong>Project Galileo</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.</span></p> <p><strong><a href="https://www.cloudflare.com/athenian/">Athenian Project</a></strong><span style="font-weight: 400;"&gt

description: L’entreprise Notre client est un acteur de référence dans les infrastructures numériques et l’hébergement de données. Garantir la maîtrise des activités à risque : travaux électriques, en hauteur, en espaces confinés, par point chaud, manutentions, produits chimiques. Définir les objectifs de réduction de l’empreinte environnementale avec les équipes techniques et RSE. title: Customer Engineer, Korea
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><p><strong>Available Locations: Seoul, South Korea, Singapore</strong></p> <p><strong>What you will do as a Customer Engineer</strong></p> <p>The Customer Engineer (CE) is the core driver of our technical go-to-market strategy: a trusted technical advisor and primary architect of the customer journey. You will bridge the gap between technical strategy and business value—guiding enterprise clients from initial pre-sales technical validation through onboarding, deployment architecture, and full lifecycle expansion. Sitting within the GTM organization and reporting to a Customer Engineering Leader, you will not hand off your customers once an initial agreement is reached. Instead, you will operate as a quota-carrying technologist, leveraging AI-augmented workflows to eliminate administrative toil so you can focus on high-value architectural design and driving measurable business outcomes across the entire customer journey.</p> <p><strong>Key Responsibilities</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Technical Validation: </strong>Partner closely with Account Executives to lead technical deep-dive discovery, capture business requirements, and map complex customer infrastructure - DNS, CDN, Zero Trust, Network Security, Workers - to fit-for-purpose Cloudflare architectures and bespoke solutions. . Define, scope, success criteria, and technical evaluations plans for Proof of Concepts (PoCs) and Technical Validations. Deliver tailored technical presentations, architectural diagrams, and demonstrations that show how Cloudflare solves specific performance, security, and reliability challenges. Proactively address complex technical objections, security compliance questions, and edge-case architectural requirements during the sales cycle. Take accountability for a suitable solution deployment strategy (Customer, Partner or Cloudflare Professional services) being an integral part of all proposals.</li> <li><strong>Customer Adoption & Value Realization: </strong>Provide oversight to technical onboarding and implementation, but not execute the implementation, serving as the primary executive and engineering contact for the customer. Design structured migration and onboarding blueprints tailored to the customer’s environment (e.g. DNS migrations, Zero Trust rollouts, WAF tuning guidance), and act as the lead consultant for customer engineering teams, walking them step-by-step through configuration best practices.  Partner with Account Executives to own discovery, demos, onboarding, technical health, risk, and expansion strategy. Proactively monitor customer health scores and telemetry to ensure rapid time-to-value, resolve integration bottlenecks, and reduce deployment risk.</li> <li><strong>Commercial Accountability & Expansion: </strong>Carry a variable quota tied directly to new business acquisition and/or ongoing account growth. Be commercially accountable for ensuring deep platform adoption, retaining revenue, and identifying strategic cross-sell and up-sell opportunities based on product usage data. Lead technical Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) to translate platform capabilities into return on investment for C-level executives.</li> <li><strong>Trusted Advisory: </strong>Act as a trusted technical advisor throughout the entire customer lifecycle, maintaining a continuous, deep relationship with key stakeholders from initial onboarding through maturity, renewal, and expansion. Provide thought partnership on architecture, AI control layers, security posture, and deployment confidence. Identify potential deployment risks or integration bottlenecks early, and provide remediation strategies to de-risk customer outcomes. </li> <li><strong>AI Orchestration & Workflow Automation: </strong>Leverage AI agents, Large Language Models (LLMs), and internal platforms to automate routine tasks such as RFP/Security Questionnaire responses, sandbox provisioning, basic telemetry monitoring, and internal/external documentation, reclaiming your time for strategic customer advisory.</li> <li><strong>Education & Enablement:</strong> Partner closely with the Enablement Team to design, build, and govern technical resources. Define, document, and educate both internal teams and customers on deliverables such as Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), architectural best practices, and technical guides to continuously raise the technical baseline across the organization.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Minimum Qualifications</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience: Experience in a customer-facing technical role, such as Solutions Engineering, Customer Engineering, Professional Services,  Sales Engineering, Technical Account Management, or as a Forward Deployed Engineer (years of experience required will vary based on Associate, Senior, Staff, or Principal leveling).</li> <li>Architectural Mindset: Ability to white-board, design, and articulate complex enterprise network and security architectures clearly.</li> <li>Consultative & Advisory Skills: Excellent communication skills with the ability to translate deeply technical concepts into business outcomes for both hands-on engineers and C-level executives.</li> <li>Commercial Mindset: Proven track record of operating in a quota-carrying or revenue-aligned environment, with a strong understanding of SaaS metrics, business value translation, and enterprise sales cycles.</li> <li>Communication: Exceptional presentation and stakeholder management skills, capable of bridging the gap between deep technical implementation details and high-level C-suite business strategy.</li> <li>Technical Breadth: We do not expect every candidate to be an expert in every domain. Qualified candidates will demonstrate depth in at least four of the technical areas below:</li> <ul> <li>Internet fundamentals: Deep understanding of how the Internet works, including OSI Model layers 1–7, BGP, GRE, TCP/UDP, DNS (authoritative and recursive), HTTP(S), and SSL/TLS.</li> <li>Security: Expertise in the security of Internet properties, including WAF, Bot Management, Firewalls, Rate Limiting, (M)TLS, Zero Trust, and SASE concepts.</li> <li>Performance: Expertise in the performance of Internet properties, including speed, latency, caching, video streaming, HTTP/2, and TLS 1.3.</li> <li>AI Proficiency: Familiarity with prompt engineering, AI-assisted scripting and log analysis, LLM utilization, and workflow automation to augment everyday CE workflows.</li> <li>Coding/Scripting: Proficiency in Python, JavaScript, Bash, Lua, Go, or similar languages to write custom integration scripts, API connectors, and edge computing functions.</li> <li>Developer Platform Fluency: Experience designing, building, deploying or scaling applications using RESTful/GraphQL APIs, SDKs, webhooks, and developer tooling in cloud-native environments. Familiarity with infrastructure-as-code (Terraform, Pulumi), CI/CD pipelines, and observability for developer-led deployments.</li> </ul> </ul> <p><strong>Strongly Preferred Qualifications (The "Good-to-Haves")</strong></p> <ul> <li>Technical Enablement: Track record of creating and delivering technical enablement - workshops, code samples, documentation, or developer onboarding - that accelerates customer adoption of complex platforms. </li> <li>Applied AI Knowledge: Experience with LLM orchestration, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) architectures, and model-access controls.</li> <li>Regulatory Knowledge: Understanding of regulatory requirements such as PCI DSS, HIPAA, and SOC 2.</li> <li>Hyperscaler / Digital Native Background: Talent coming out of hyperscalers, digital natives, distributed systems environments, or startups is strongly valued for its deeper cloud fluency and advanced architecture depth.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Education</strong></p> <p>Undergraduate or graduate degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field. </p> <p><strong>Travel</strong></p> <p>This role may require travel up to 20–50% to attend customer meetings, conferences, industry events, and in-person team collaboration.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.</span></p> <p><a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/protecting-free-expression-online/"><strong>Project Galileo</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.</span></p> <p><strong><a href="https://www.cloudflare.com/athenian/">Athenian Project</a></strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.</span></p> <p><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"><strong>1.1.1.1</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: We released</span><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"> <span style="font-weight: 400;">1.1.1.1</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;

description: <div class="content-intro"><p><span style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif;"><strong>Who we are</strong></span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 300; font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif;">Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 300; font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif;">Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. alerts</li> <li>Lead information security incidents and employee insider investigations by developing the incident response strategy, lead the execution through incident closure, while providing incident updates to key stakeholders throughout the incident</li> <li>Deliver security guidance clearly and concisely for incident response and insider threat initiatives</li> <li>Coordinate the in our on-call rota covering weekends</li> </ul> <p><strong>Minimum requirements for the role:</strong></p> <ul> <li>5+ years of experience in Security Incident Response</li> <li>Ability to communicate investigative findings and strategies to technical staff, executive leadership, and legal</li> <li>Ability to build scripts or tools to support Samsara’s investigation processes, with proficiency in Python</li> <li>Mentor and train security operation engineers on data collection, analysis, and reporting technical analysis</li> <li>Practical experience acting as a lead during security incident response, including monitoring and triaging alerts, and coordinating across teams</li> <li>Understanding of analysis and forensics techniques on macOS, Windows, and Linux</li> with the potential to work outside standard business hours, including late evenings, when responding to high-severity incidents as part of our global incident response team.</li> <li>This role will be part of our EMEA so your hours will be aligned to the UK. As an operational time you may be expected to work flexible hours around this to support the load of the team</li> </ul> <p><strong>An ideal candidate also has:</strong></p> <ul> <li>2+ years of experience working on insider threat initiatives or employee investigations</li> <li>Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Security, or a related field - or relevant industry experience</li> <li>GIAC Certified Incident Handler (GCIH) or similar Certification</li> <li>Familiarity with common security frameworks and standards, including NIST Cybersecurity Framework, ISO 27001, FedRAMP</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>Total Rewards</strong></p> <p>At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. You will learn how technology becomes customer value, how software businesses grow, how products are brought to market, and how commercial decisions are made. This is not a rotation program where you shadow senior leaders. From day one, you carry real responsibility.</p> <h2>What You'll do</h2> <p>The Software Track is designed to build the next generation of software business leaders at Hilti – Business Owners, Business Directors, Segment Managers and ultimately Senior Management Team members. If you want a structured path to running a business, this program is built for that outcome.<br><br>The program places you inside one of two business units:<br><br>Construction Software: Home to Fieldwire (Field Software for project and workforce management), ON!Track (asset management), and 4PS (construction business management). You will work directly with customers, product teams, and business leadership across Europe and beyond.<br><br>Fastening & Protection Solutions: Where design & engineering software for structural connections (e.g. PROFIS Engineering Suite), MEP supports and passive fire protection systems are developed and brought to market across a global customer base of structural and mechanical engineers.<br><br><br>For the Construction Software business unit, the program is structured to provide a balanced foundation in customer and market exposure, software product understanding, and business experience, while giving you the opportunity to work with at least two software products during the program:</p> <ul> <li>​Year 1: Begin with a 12-month sales assignment, developing direct customer insight and understanding the business challenges addressed by our software solutions.</li> <li>​Year 2: Undertake three rotations of 3–6 months each across product and business teams, including exposure to an international project.</li> </ul> <p>​For the Fastening & Protection Solution business unit, the program provides exposure to product management , software development, exposure to customers and start-ups and international project experience:</p> <ul> <li>​Year 1: Begin with a 12-month product management assignment, building product understanding and market insight.</li> <li>​Year 2: Undertake three rotations of 3–6 months each, involving international projects that broaden your business perspective and global exposure.</li> </ul> <p>You will have a dedicated senior mentor from the start, direct exposure to executive leadership, and a peer cohort of Global Trainees across all Hilti business tracks globally.</p> <h2>What You’ll Bring</h2> <p>You are close to graduating or have recently completed a Master's degree - your degree is likely to be in construction management, civil engineering, or mechanical engineering with a focus on construction, Computer Science, or also Business study programs with an affinity for Software and construction. What matters more than your degree subject is the combination of traits below:</p> <ul> <li>Global mobility - you are willing and able to relocate internationally, multiple times. A global thinker who is keen for diverse cultural experiences.</li> <li>Digital and AI orientation - you think natively in digital workflows, comfortable with software tools, and know the power and potential of AI.</li> <li>Language - you are fluent in English and/or German, Dutch, French, Spanish or Italian. </li> <li>Commercial instinct - you are drawn to how businesses grow, how customers make decisions, and how products create.</li> <li>Low ego, high drive - you take the work seriously and yourself lightly. You seek feedback, move fast, and are energised by ambiguity rather than unsettled by it.</li> <li>You are at the start of your career and have maximum three years of junior work experience.</li> </ul> <h2>What’s In It for You</h2> <p>​​Show us what you can do, and in return, we promise you the experience of a lifetime. We offer you a transformative journey filled with learning, growth, and invaluable experiences that will shape your perspective and personal and professional development. On top of that, you’ll also take part in some fascinating courses and events:</p> <ul> <li>Introductory Global Summit: Experience 4 days at our global headquarters in Liechtenstein, featuring the presence of our Executive Board and Global Senior Leadership. The summit offers a comprehensive overview of our business, while fostering soft skill development and meaningful collaboration with fellow program participants.</li> <li>Social Project Summit: 7 days dedicated to building a better future, with contribution to a hands-on, high-impact community project. This experience offers the chance to immerse yourself in a different culture while actively improving living conditions for those in need.</li> <li>Leadership Summit: An enriching learning journey in partnership with a renowned business school, featuring online modules and collaborative projects with fellow program participants. The experience concludes with a 5-day on-campus summit to deepen insights and to foster business and leadership skills.</li> </ul> <h2>Why Hilti</h2> <p>Hilti is a global leader in construction innovation, with more than 34,000 team members across 120 countries. Guided by our purpose, Making Construction Better, we’re driven to keep learning, growing, and finding new ways to make a lasting impact. Here, you’ll be empowered to use your strengths, work with a global and inclusive team, and take on meaningful challenges. At Hilti, you’ll have the chance to make your ideas, achievements, and growth real through purpose, passion, and teamwork.<br><br>Learn more about our recruitment process: https://careers.hilti.group/en/candidate-interview-preparation/</p> <h2>Commitment to Inclusion</h2> <p>​​At Hilti, inclusion is a key focus in how we work, lead, and grow together. We are committed to embracing diversity of thought and creating an environment that is inclusive of everyone, everywhere. We continuously strive to ensure every voice is valued and every team member feels empowered to contribute. By building on this foundation, we strengthen our teams, our innovation, and our impact, making construction better together.<br><br>​Exciting software journey: You will dive into the fast-paced world of our construction software business, gaining exposure to innovative digital solutions that are transforming one of the world's largest industries.<br>​<br>​Global cross-team collaboration: You will work with colleagues worldwide and get guidance from a dedicated mentor as you grow in your career.<br><br>​We hire for a career, not for a position. If you are looking for long-term career prospects and opportunities to grow, this is the perfect start.​<br><br>​Are you ready to jumpstart your career? Our hiring process is designed to help you showcase your skills and experience. The process has multiple steps and requires a longer period of time:</p> <ul> <li>It all starts with your application and a video interview.</li> <li>Get connected with our HR team in an online interview.</li> <li>Get ready to flex your problem-solving muscles with our online Business Case Round.</li> <li>Impress our Business Line Managers with your presentation skills and insights during the next round.</li> <li>And, if you make it to the end, you'll receive an invitation to our Assessment Center.</li> </ul> <p>​Exciting, right? Let's get started!</p> <p><strong>4PS is part of the Hilti Group</strong>, which gives our people access to international opportunities and development programs within the wider Hilti organization. This vacancy is part of Hilti’s Global Trainee Program. Interested in joining the program? Please submit your application directly via <a href="https://careers.hilti.group/de-ch/stellenangebote/19051-en/global-trainee-program-outperformer-software-business-track-m-f-x/">Hilti Careerpage</a><br><br>​The Assessment Center will take place in Liechtenstein at Hilti Headquarter on December 1st and 2nd, 2026. Applications will be reviewed in the order they’re received, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible since there are limited spots for the Assessment Center!​<br><br>Learn more about our recruitment process:<br><a href="https://careers.hilti.group/en/candidate-interview-preparation/" target="_blank"><br>Candidate Interview Preparation</a></p> <p>​​For further questions, please feel free to contact Vanessa Furtner ----- and (My LinkedIn).<br>​<br>*For non-EU / EFTA citizens: Please state your eligibility status to work in EU or UK countries and note that if you do not own a valid work permit, Hilti cannot guarantee your final employment due to authority regulations.​</p> <section class="section-image js-animate"> <div class="container-fluid"> <div class="row"> <div class="col-md-6 col-lg-7"> <div class="slant-outer"> </div> </div> </div> </div> </section> Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

description: <div class="content-intro"><p>Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital.
