title: Strategic Account Director, Industrials (EMEA)
description: <div class="content-intro"><h2><strong>About Sayari: </strong></h2> <div> <p>Sayari is the judgment infrastructure for trustworthy AI in economic security and commercial risk. The Sayari Commercial World Model resolves 11.7B+ primary-source records from 250+ jurisdictions forming the ground truth of global commerce. A Judgment Ontology, encoding over a decade of investigative tradecraft, and Superconductor, an agentic orchestration platform, deliver AI that reasons like an expert analyst, shows its work, and traces every finding to its source. Trusted by U.S. Customs and Border Protection, HM Revenue & Customs, and Fortune 500 enterprises, Sayari is used by thousands of professionals across 35+ countries to secure supply chains and dismantle illicit networks. Headquartered in Washington, D.C., with offices in London, Singapore, Tokyo, and Tel Aviv.</p> </div></div><h2><strong>The Role</strong></h2> <p>We are hiring a Strategic Account Director to take Superconductor to tier-1 industrials across EMEA. Some of these accounts already use Sayari. Others are new, and you will win them with your experience, your network, and your existing book of business.</p> <p>You will be among the first to sell Superconductor into this vertical, with a Forward Deployed Engineer and an established global organization behind you. Targets are multiyear agreements of $2M+, with adoption extended across each account’s adjacent buying centers.<br><br></p> <h2><strong>What You Will Do</strong></h2> <ul> <li><strong>Win new key logos:</strong> use your network and book of business to open tier-1 industrial accounts, and take each from first conversation to signed multiyear agreement. Build your own pipeline through your network, targeted outreach, and practitioner communities.</li> <li><strong>Grow existing accounts:</strong> take Superconductor into tier-1 customers that already use Sayari, moving them from a single use case to enterprise-wide deployment across the Commercial World Model and Superconductor agents.</li> <li><strong>Map the buying centers:</strong> build relationships across supply chain and procurement, trade compliance and sanctions, legal, risk, investigations, and IT. Think Chief Procurement Officers, Chief Supply Chain Officers, Heads of Trade Compliance, Chief Risk Officers, Chief Compliance Officers, and General Counsel.</li> <li><strong>Prove, then scale:</strong> work with Customer Success, Solutions Engineering, and the forward-deployed engineers and analysts dedicated to your accounts to get Superconductor workflows into production with top customers, then use those results as references to unlock further budget.</li> <li><strong>Shape the playbook and roadmap:</strong> refine how we position and sell into industrials, and bring buyer feedback to Product and Engineering.</li> <li><strong>Forecast accurately:</strong> run a structured pipeline (MEDDPICC, Challenger, or Miller Heimann) and give leadership a forecast they can plan against.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What You Bring</strong></h2> <ul> <li>15+ years in large-cap industrials (for example aerospace and defence, automotive, chemicals, capital goods, or energy equipment), at or near C-suite level, with a verifiable network in the sector.</li> <li>An existing book of business and relationships with tier-1 industrials that you can bring to Sayari.</li> <li>A record of closing multimillion-dollar, multiyear agreements, through both new key logos and expansion of existing accounts, that you can walk through in named detail.</li> <li>Depth in supply chain, procurement, trade compliance, and risk, including supply chain due diligence rules, forced labour import restrictions, sanctions, and export controls.</li> <li>Executive presence: you can explain data provenance and AI reasoning to non-technical senior stakeholders and be treated as a peer.</li> <li>Command of structured sales methodology in multithreaded deals involving procurement and legal review.</li> <li>Interest in agentic AI and the ability to explain what it can and cannot yet do. You do not need to be technical.</li> <li>Willingness to travel up to 25% across EMEA.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Nice to Have</strong></h2> <ul> <li>German speaker</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Why Sayari</strong></h2> <ul> <li><strong>Uncapped earnings:</strong> commission with accelerators on expansion revenue and no bonus caps.</li> <li><strong>A product that shows its work:</strong> agentic AI that traces every finding to a primary source.</li> <li><strong>Seniority:</strong> you are the senior domain voice on an established sales team, with room to shape how the vertical is worked.</li> </ul> <div> </div> <div><em>Sayari is an equal opportunity employer and strongly encourages diverse candidates to apply. title: Senior Product Marketing Manager, Sales Enablement (AI & Research)
description: <h1 style="text-align: center;"><span style="font-family: tahoma, arial, helvetica, sans-serif; color: rgb(126, 140, 141);">Senior Product Marketing Manager, Sales Enablement (AI & Research)</span></h1> <p style="text-align: center;"><span style="font-family: tahoma, arial, helvetica, sans-serif; color: rgb(126, 140, 141);">Team: Marketing</span></p> <p style="text-align: center;"><span style="font-family: tahoma, arial, helvetica, sans-serif; color: rgb(126, 140, 141);"><em>  Prolific</em></span></p> <p><span style="font-family: tahoma, arial, helvetica, sans-serif;">Prolific isn’t just enabling AI innovation – we’re redefining it. While foundational AI technologies are becoming commoditized, Prolific’s human data infrastructure provides the high-quality, diverse data required to train the next generation of AI models. Through our platform, we empower researchers and companies to access a global, ethically curated participant base, ensuring cutting-edge AI research and training grounded in inclusivity and precision.</span></p> <p style="text-align: center;"> </p> <p style="text-align: center;"><span style="font-family: tahoma, arial, helvetica, sans-serif; color: rgb(126, 140, 141);"><em>The role</em></span></p> <p>T<span style="font-family: tahoma, arial, helvetica, sans-serif;">his is a brand new role, and you’ll be the first person to do it at Prolific.</span></p> <p><span style="font-family: tahoma, arial, helvetica, sans-serif;">Right now, the insight that could help us win more deals is scattered. We have valuable learnings about why we win, why we lose, and why deals stall, but they aren’t turned into the pitch, proof and materials that sellers use every day. You’ll fix that. You’ll become the person who knows our market position inside out and turns it into tools that help sellers win.</span><br><span style="font-family: tahoma, arial, helvetica, sans-serif;">This is a revenue role. It sits at the point where product marketing meets sales enablement, across both our AI and research businesses. You’ll dig into win-loss, competitive intelligence and customer proof, then turn it into pitch decks, one-pagers, battlecards, case studies and training that reps use on their next call. You’ll also help new AEs and SDRs get up to speed faster.</span></p> <p><span style="font-family: tahoma, arial, helvetica, sans-serif;">You’ll be measured on win rate, sales cycle length, rep ramp time and how well equipped our sellers are in front of a buyer.</span></p> <p><span style="font-family: tahoma, arial, helvetica, sans-serif;">Our AI PMM leads strategic lab and enterprise AI pursuits, and our vertical PMMs tailor messaging for specific audiences. You own the foundation they all build on: the shared, trusted system of resources every other deal runs on.</span></p> <p> </p> <p style="text-align: center;"><span style="font-family: tahoma, arial, helvetica, sans-serif; color: rgb(126, 140, 141);"><em>What you’ll bring to the role</em></span></p> <ul> <li style="font-family: tahoma, arial, helvetica, sans-serif;"><span style="font-family: tahoma, arial, helvetica, sans-serif;">6+ years in an enablement-facing role (product marketing, sales enablement or competitive intelligence) at a B2B company</span></li> <li style="font-family: tahoma, arial, helvetica, sans-serif;"><span style="font-family: tahoma, arial, helvetica, sans-serif;">Experience enabling sellers across more than one product or product line, at a startup, scale-up or enterprise</span></li> <li style="font-family: tahoma, arial, helvetica, sans-serif;"><span style="font-family: tahoma, arial, helvetica, sans-serif;">Experience doing the full job, not just the final slides: you’ve gathered the data and insight yourself, then turned it into materials sellers use</span></li> <li style="font-family: tahoma, arial, helvetica, sans-serif;"><span style="font-family: tahoma, arial, helvetica, sans-serif;">Enablement you’ve built that measurably moved win rate, ramp time or deal velocity. You can show who used it and what changed</span></li> <li style="font-family: tahoma, arial, helvetica, sans-serif;"><span style="font-family: tahoma, arial, helvetica, sans-serif;">Hands-on experience running buyer interviews. You ask about past behaviour, not hypothetical opinions, and you can get a lost buyer to tell you the real reason</span></li> <li style="font-family: tahoma, arial, helvetica, sans-serif;"><span style="font-family: tahoma, arial, helvetica, sans-serif;">Comfort with data: you can pull from a CRM and call-intelligence tools, build an analysis or business case, and defend your conclusions</span></li> <li style="font-family: tahoma, arial, helvetica, sans-serif;"><span style="font-family: tahoma, arial, helvetica, sans-serif;">Clear writing for busy readers: short, specific and easy to act on</span></li> <li style="font-family: tahoma, arial, helvetica, sans-serif;"><span style="font-family: tahoma, arial, helvetica, sans-serif;">Credibility with sellers and senior leaders, and the ability to get sales, product and customer success to act without managing any of them. You’ll spend a lot of time with sales</span></li> </ul> <p> </p> <p style="text-align: center;"><span style="font-family: tahoma, arial, helvetica, sans-serif;"><em>    <span style="color: rgb(126, 140, 141);">What you’ll be doing in the role </span></em></span></p> <ul> <li style="font-family: tahoma, arial, helvetica, sans-serif;"><span style="font-family: tahoma, arial, helvetica, sans-serif;">Build and own sales enablement across AI and research: onboarding, ongoing training and launch readiness (with the AI PMM), plus a single source of truth that reps actually use</span></li> <li style="font-family: tahoma, arial, helvetica, sans-serif;"><span style="font-family: tahoma, arial, helvetica, sans-serif;">Audit what exists today, decide what stays and what goes, and set up a way to keep it current</span></li> <li style="font-family: tahoma, arial, helvetica, sans-serif;"><span style="font-family: tahoma, arial, helvetica, sans-serif;">Build and maintain the core sales toolkit: pitch narrative, decks, one-pagers, discovery guides, battlecards, objection handling, white papers and business-case tools</span></li> <li style="font-family: tahoma, arial, helvetica, sans-serif;"><span style="font-family: tahoma, arial, helvetica, sans-serif;">Design and run our win-loss programme: buyer interviews after closed-won, closed-lost and no-decision outcomes, combined with CRM and call data and a regular readout to leadership. You’ll also run one outreach calendar for every AI buyer interview, including the AI PMM’s, so no buyer is asked twice</span></li> <li style="font-family: tahoma, arial, helvetica, sans-serif;"><span style="font-family: tahoma, arial, helvetica, sans-serif;">Own competitive intelligence against data labelling vendors, research panel providers and in-house alternatives, including a live view of competitor pricing and positioning that feeds the AI PMM’s category point of view</span></li> <li style="font-family: tahoma, arial, helvetica, sans-serif;"><span style="font-family: tahoma, arial, helvetica, sans-serif;">Turn findings into specific changes, such as a new talk track, a revised discovery question or a pricing recommendation, then check whether the change moved the number</span></li> <li style="font-family: tahoma, arial, helvetica, sans-serif;"><span style="font-family: tahoma, arial, helvetica, sans-serif;">Own customer proof: case studies with AI and research customers, a sourced library of proof points, the reference programme for live deals, and advocacy through quotes, reviews and speakers</span></li> <li style="font-family: tahoma, arial, helvetica, sans-serif;"><span style="font-family: tahoma, arial, helvetica, sans-serif;">Sit in on sales calls every week and feed deal-level evidence into product: feature gaps, blockers and pricing friction, ranked by revenue impact</span></li> <li style="font-family: tahoma, arial, helvetica, sans-serif;"><span style="font-family: tahoma, arial, helvetica, sans-serif;">Define and report the numbers: win rate, competitive win rate, deal velocity, rep ramp time and content usage, including the AI segment win rates the AI PMM is measured on. Work with RevOps to clean up CRM fields for loss reasons and competitor.</span></li> </ul> <p> </p> <p style="text-align: center;"><span style="font-family: tahoma, arial, helvetica, sans-serif; color: rgb(126, 140, 141);"><em>Why Prolific is a great place to work</em></span></p> <p><span style="font-family: tahoma, arial, helvetica, sans-serif;">We've built a unique platform that connects researchers and companies with a global pool of participants, enabling the collection of high-quality, ethically sourced human behavioral data and feedback. This data is the cornerstone of developing more accurate, nuanced, and aligned AI systems.</span></p> <p><span style="font-family: tahoma, arial, helvetica, sans-serif;">We believe that the next leap in AI capabilities won't come solely from scaling existing models, but from integrating diverse human perspectives and behaviors into AI development. By providing this crucial human data infrastructure, Prolific is positioning itself at the forefront of the next wave of AI innovation – one that reflects the breath and the best of humanity.</span></p> <p><span style="font-family: tahoma, arial, helvetica, sans-serif;">Working for us will place you at the forefront of AI innovation, providing access to our unique human data platform and opportunities for groundbreaking research. Join us to enjoy a competitive salary, benefits, and remote working within our impactful, mission-driven culture.<br><br></span></p> <p style="text-align: center;"><br><br></p> <p style="text-align: center;"><span style="font-family: tahoma, arial, helvetica, sans-serif; color: rgb(126, 140, 141);"><em>Links to more information on Prolific</em></span></p> <p style="text-align: center;"><span style="font-family: tahoma, arial, helvetica, sans-serif;"><a href="https://www.notion.so/prolific/dbc97f2b3ff24f1bb6fa834a2c9c3283?v=4f874e88e46a4f54afd8bf62f1db19ed&p=9f2c1de05dfa43338d48c20362bfead1&pm=c">Benefits </a></span></p> <p style="text-align: center;"><span style="font-family: tahoma, arial, helvetica, sans-serif;"><a href="https://www.notion.so/prolific/dbc97f2b3ff24f1bb6fa834a2c9c3283?v=4f874e88e46a4f54afd8bf62f1db19ed">External Handbook</a> </span></p> <p style="text-align: center;"><span style="font-family: tahoma, arial, helvetica, sans-serif;"><a href="https://www.prolific.com/">Website </a></span></p> <p style="text-align: center;"><span style="font-family: tahoma, arial, helvetica, sans-serif;"><a href="https://www.youtube.com/@JoinProlific">Youtube</a>

You will work across high-performance backend services, developer-facing frontend tools and SDKs, infrastructure, and observability to help customers deliver personalized content experiences in a performant, reliable, and developer-friendly way.</p> <p>You will bring a proactive approach to problem-solving, a high sense of ownership, and a continuous improvement mindset. description: <div class="content-intro"><h3><strong>A</strong><strong>BOUT TIDE</strong></h3> <p>At Tide, we help SMEs save time and money in the running of their businesses by not only offering business accounts and related banking services, but also a comprehensive set of highly usable and connected administrative solutions, from invoicing to accounting.</p> <p>Tide is transforming the small business banking market and now supports over 2 million members globally across the UK, Germany and France.</p> <p>Using advanced technology, all solutions are designed with SMEs in mind. With quick onboarding, low fees and innovative features, we thrive on making data driven decisions to serve our mission: to help SMEs save time and money so they can get back to doing what they love.</p> <p><strong>Tide facts:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Tide is available for UK, German and French SMEs</li> <li>Over 2 million members globally and rapidly growing</li> <li>Over $300 million raised in funding</li> <li>3,000 Tideans globally</li> <li>We have offices in Central London, with a member support and technology centre in Sofia, Bulgaria, technology centres in Serbia, Romania, Lithuania and Hyderabad and offices in Gurugram, New Delhi, Berlin, Paris and Luxembourg</li> </ul></div><h3>ABOUT THE TEAM:</h3> <p>Cards is one of the largest revenue lines at Tide. The domain owns everything that happens on the card: issuing and processing across the UK, EU and India, each with its own processors, card schemes and regulators.</p> <p>This includes prepaid, debit, multi-currency and team cards, alongside products such as Apple Pay and Google Pay tokenisation, 3DS, card controls and settlement.</p> <p>The teams are cross-functional, working closely with product, design, commercial and operations. Engineering comprises three teams, with engineers based in Bulgaria, Lithuania and India.</p> <h3>ABOUT THE ROLE:</h3> <p>As Head of Engineering, Cards, you will lead the engineering organisation across the UK, EU and India, shaping the next phase of the Cards platform.</p> <p>With the core platform transformation largely complete, your focus will be on:</p> <ul> <li><strong>Product and member experience:</strong> Partnering with Product and Design to improve card experiences, including tokenisation, payment journeys, team controls and reducing false declines.</li> <li><strong>AI-led engineering:</strong> Embedding AI coding agents across the software development lifecycle to improve engineering productivity, delivery speed and quality.</li> <li><strong>Platform and commercial ownership:</strong> Completing the transition from our legacy processor, strengthening partner relationships and driving improvements in cost efficiency and unit economics.</li> </ul> <p>You will set the technical direction, develop engineering leadership and ensure the platform remains reliable, scalable and commercially sustainable.</p> <p>As Head of Engineering, Cards, you will:</p> <ul> <li>Lead and develop engineering managers and senior engineers across distributed teams.</li> <li>Define the technical strategy and architecture for the Cards domain.</li> <li>Drive reliability, scalability and cost efficiency across card issuing and processing.</li> <li>Embed AI-assisted and agentic development practices across engineering teams.</li> <li>Partner with Product, Design and Commercial teams to prioritise and deliver the roadmap.</li> <li>Own technical relationships with card processors and schemes, including integrations and certifications.</li> <li>Strengthen engineering capabilities, particularly at Staff and senior IC levels.</li> <li>Collaborate with other engineering leaders across Payments on shared infrastructure.</li> </ul> <h3>WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR:</h3> <p>We are looking for an experienced engineering leader with a strong technical foundation and a track record of leading large, distributed engineering organisations.</p> <p><strong>Experience and background</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience leading engineering managers and large engineering teams.</li> <li>Strong experience in cards, payments or banking, with a deep understanding of card issuing, processing and card scheme operations. Experience on either the issuer or processor side is a strong plus.</li> <li>Experience building and operating distributed engineering teams across multiple locations.</li> <li>Proven ability to improve engineering delivery, productivity and quality.</li> <li>Experience partnering with Product, Commercial and Finance leaders on business outcomes and unit economics.</li> <li>Experience managing third-party technology providers and strategic partnerships.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Technical expertise</strong></p> <ul> <li>Strong understanding of microservices, event-driven architecture and cloud-native systems.</li> <li>Experience with relational databases, distributed systems and large-scale transaction processing.</li> <li>Ability to challenge architectural decisions and engage in technical and production-level discussions.</li> <li>Hands-on experience with AI coding agents and their application across the software development lifecycle.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Leadership</strong></p> <ul> <li>Ability to set technical direction and drive execution through engineering leaders.</li> <li>Strong commercial acumen and data-driven decision-making.</li> <li>Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills.</li> <li>A strong focus on developing engineering talent and building high-performing teams.</li> </ul> <h3>OUR TECH STACK: </h3> <p>Java and Spring Boot microservices running on AWS, with PostgreSQL as our primary datastore. We use SNS/SQS for asynchronous and event-driven messaging. Observability is Coralogix. CI/CD runs through GitHub with automated testing and security scanning. Mobile is Flutter, web is Angular.</p> <h3>WHAT YOU’LL GET IN RETURN:</h3> <p>Our location-specific employee benefits are designed to cater to the unique needs of Tideans:</p> <ul> <li>Competitive Compensation – Competitive salary and share options.</li> <li>Time Off – Generous annual leave on top of bank holidays.</li> <li>Parental Leave – Paid maternity, paternity, and adoption leave to support your family journey.</li> <li>Sabbatical – Extended unpaid and paid leave options after completing milestone years with Tide.</li> <li>Access to salary sacrifice benefits – like Nursery (could save up to 47% on fees!) and Cycle to Work discounts.</li> <li>Health Insurance – Comprehensive Private family insurance plan.</li> <li>Life & Accident Cover – Comprehensive accidental and life insurance protection.</li> <li>Mental Wellbeing – Access to therapy sessions, courses, meditations, and workshops.</li> <li>Retirement Planning – Build your retirement fund faster with Tide’s pension scheme on eligible earnings.</li> <li>Volunteering & Development Days – Paid days annually for volunteering or personal growth.</li> <li>Learning & Development – Annual budget for books, courses, coaching, and more.</li> <li>WOO (Work Outside the Office) – Work from abroad for up to 90 days annually.</li> <li>Home Office Setup – Contribution towards setting up your home office</li> <li>Laptop Ownership – Keep your old laptop and get a new one when it’s time for a replacement.</li> <li>Snacks & Meals – Daily breakfast spread with all-day coffee, tea, and juices.</li> </ul> <h3>TIDEAN WAYS OF WORKING</h3> <p>At Tide, we champion a <strong>flexible workplace </strong>model that<strong> </strong>supports both in-person and remote work to cater to the specific needs of our different teams. </p> <p>While remote work is supported, we believe in the power of face-to-face interactions to foster team spirit and collaboration. title: VP Engineering, Ongoing Monitoring
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3><strong>A</strong><strong>BOUT TIDE</strong></h3> <p>At Tide, we help SMEs save time and money in the running of their businesses by not only offering business accounts and related banking services, but also a comprehensive set of highly usable and connected administrative solutions, from invoicing to accounting.</p> <p>Tide is transforming the small business banking market and now supports over 2 million members globally across the UK, Germany and France.</p> <p>Using advanced technology, all solutions are designed with SMEs in mind. With quick onboarding, low fees and innovative features, we thrive on making data driven decisions to serve our mission: to help SMEs save time and money so they can get back to doing what they love.</p> <p><strong>Tide facts:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Tide is available for UK, German and French SMEs</li> <li>Over 2 million members globally and rapidly growing</li> <li>Over $300 million raised in funding</li> <li>3,000 Tideans globally</li> <li>We have offices in Central London, with a member support and technology centre in Sofia, Bulgaria, technology centres in Serbia, Romania, Lithuania and Hyderabad and offices in Gurugram, New Delhi, Berlin, Paris and Luxembourg</li> </ul></div><h3><strong>ABOUT THE ROLE</strong></h3> <p>Tide is hiring a VP of Engineering to lead the engineering organisation behind Ongoing Monitoring. You will report directly to the Chief Data and Technology Officer. Ongoing Monitoring protects our members by detecting fraud, financial crime and regulatory risk across every transaction Tide processes. The engineering, data science and platform capability behind it is one of the most technically demanding estates at Tide.</p> <p>You will be accountable for the engineering strategy, organisation and execution across all Ongoing Monitoring value streams: real-time transaction monitoring for bank payments fraud, acquiring fraud, Anti Money Laundering, Counter Terrorist Financing, sanctions and prohibited activities monitoring, and the tooling our financial investigators depend on. That means ML models in production, agentic AI inside regulated workflows, and multi-market screening infrastructure that stands up to regulatory scrutiny.</p> <p>This role sits at the intersection of regulated risk operations, near real-time platform engineering and applied AI. Our first line operations teams are the primary internal customer, our second line sets the risk appetite, and our regulators set the bar. We need someone who can raise detection quality and reduce fraud losses while driving the cost of monitoring per member down, and scale agentic solutions where a wrong answer has consequences for a member and for Tide.</p> <p>As VP Engineering, Ongoing Monitoring you will:</p> <ul> <li>Set the engineering strategy for Tide's fraud, financial crime and ongoing monitoring platforms</li> <li>Lead engineering across backend, frontend, data science, ML engineering and analytics engineering, primarily based in Hyderabad with product leadership split between Hyderabad and London</li> <li>Lead managers and senior engineers, and build the leadership bench underneath you</li> <li>Work with multiple stakeholders across risk, operations, business, design, product and engineering</li> <li>Own the Decision Engine and Decision Intelligence Platform as shared capabilities, unifying domestic and international payment flows</li> <li>Own the model lifecycle end to end, from development through backtesting, shadow deployment and staged rollout to production performance monitoring</li> <li>Scale agentic AI in regulated workflows, including migrating Ongoing Monitoring agents onto Tide's shared agentic infrastructure and holding the line on our agentic governance framework</li> <li>Deliver measurable risk and efficiency outcomes: lower fraud losses, higher automated alert throughput, and a falling ongoing monitoring cost per member</li> <li>Build the operating model that connects first line operations, second line risk and compliance, payments and acquiring engineering, KYX, AI Platforms and data science leadership behind one roadmap</li> <li>Apply principles so we build once, deploy globally, and keep market-specific logic isolated</li> </ul> <p>This is one of the most important engineering roles at Tide. Ongoing Monitoring is where we prove that trust scales, across every transaction we process. You will shape how quickly we protect our members, how confidently we enter new markets under our own licences, and how far applied AI can compound into a lasting advantage in a regulated environment.</p> <h3>WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR</h3> <ul> <li>Experience leading engineering organisations in fraud, financial crime, risk or another real-time decisioning domain</li> <li>Strong track record of turning platform investment into measurable outcomes across fraud detection and mitigation, unit economics reduction and workflows automation</li> <li>Experience taking machine learning from development into production at scale, and owning model performance once live and fast iteration of model development </li> <li>Experience operating in a regulated environment, working with second line risk and compliance functions and with regulators</li> <li>Strong judgement across organisation design, delivery, platform strategy, data architecture and technical quality</li> <li>Ability to lead distributed teams across multiple markets and align several functions behind one roadmap, operating model and set of priorities</li> <li>Experience deploying AI or agentic systems inside regulated workflows, with a clear view on governance, evaluation and human oversight would be a bonus</li> </ul> <h3>WHAT YOU’LL GET IN RETURN</h3> <p>Our location-specific employee benefits are designed to cater to the unique needs of Tideans: </p> <ul> <li>Competitive Compensation –  Competitive salary and share options.</li> <li>Time Off – Generous annual leave on top of bank holidays.</li> <li>Parental Leave – Maternity, paternity, and adoption leave to support your family journey.</li> <li>Sabbatical – Extended unpaid and paid leave options after completing milestone years with Tide.</li> <li>Health Insurance – Public health insurance plan.</li> <li>Retirement Planning – Public pension scheme on eligible earnings.</li> <li>DeutschlandTicket via Spendit - Employer funded free, unlimited travel throughout Germany on all local public transport (not valid in ICE, IC/EC).</li> <li>Urban Sports Club Membership - Employer funded M membership to help you live a healthy and active lifestyle.</li> <li>Mental Wellbeing – Access to therapy sessions, courses, meditations, and workshops.</li> <li>Volunteering & Development Days – Paid days annually for volunteering or personal growth.</li> <li>Learning & Development – Annual budget for books, courses, coaching, and more.</li> <li>WOO (Work Outside the Office) – Work from abroad for up to 90 days annually.</li> <li>Home Office Setup – Contribution towards setting up your home office.</li> <li>Laptop Ownership – Keep your old laptop and get a new one when it’s time for a replacement.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>TIDEAN WAYS OF WORKING</strong></h3> <p>At Tide, we champion a <strong>flexible workplace </strong>model that<strong> </strong>supports both in-person and remote work to cater to the specific needs of our different teams. </p> <p>While remote work is supported, we believe in the power of face-to-face interactions to foster team spirit and collaboration. Our offices are designed as hubs for innovation and team-building, where we encourage regular in-person gatherings to foster a strong sense of community. </p> <div id="message-list_1777351501.983109"> <div> <div> <div> <div> <div> <div> <div> <div> <div> <div> <div><span style="color: rgb(255, 255, 255);">#LI-AC1 #LI-Remote</span></div> </div> </div> </div> </div> </div> </div> </div> </div> </div> </div> </div><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>TIDE IS A PLACE FOR EVERYONE</h3> <p>At Tide, we believe that we can only succeed if we let our differences enrich our culture. title: Principal AI Engineer
description: <p><strong>WHO WE ARE </strong></p> <p>Zeta Global (NYSE: ZETA) is the AI-Powered Marketing Cloud that leverages advanced artificial intelligence (AI) and trillions of consumer signals to make it easier for marketers to acquire, grow, and retain customers more efficiently. Through the Zeta Marketing Platform (ZMP), our vision is to make sophisticated marketing simple by unifying identity, intelligence, and omnichannel activation into a single platform – powered by one of the industry’s largest proprietary databases and AI. Our enterprise customers across multiple verticals are empowered to personalize experiences with consumers at an individual level across every channel, delivering better results for marketing programs. Zeta was founded in 2007 by David A. Steinberg and John Sculley and is headquartered in New York City with offices around the world. To learn more, go to <a href="https://www.zetaglobal.com">www.zetaglobal.com</a>.</p> <h2>Key Responsibilities</h2> <p>•    <strong>Technical strategy and architecture. </strong>Define the AI/ML architecture and technical roadmap across the portfolio. Identify shared capabilities, establish clear interfaces, and guide build-versus-buy decisions while respecting product-specific requirements.</p> <p>•    <strong>Predictive ML and optimization. </strong>Lead advances in prediction, targeting, ranking, bidding, pacing, and personalization. Guide feature development, training, calibration, and serving, addressing sparse signals, delayed outcomes, and changing data distributions.</p> <p>•    <strong>Agentic frameworks and agents. </strong>Design reusable orchestration, tool integration, retrieval, state and memory, and multi-agent coordination. Build workflows for campaign planning, insights, recommendations, and execution, with explicit permissions, human approval where needed, and recoverable failure handling.</p> <p>•    <strong>Portfolio integration. </strong>Partner with Predict, Agentic Frameworks, Email DSP/SSP, and agentic teams to connect models, data, and services through well-defined APIs and shared evaluation practices. Turn successful patterns into reusable components and practical migration paths.</p> <p>•    <strong>Production engineering. </strong>Own critical designs and implementations across data pipelines, training, deployment, and inference. Establish MLOps and LLMOps practices for reproducibility, versioning, automated testing, observability, and safe rollouts and rollbacks.</p> <p>•    <strong>Evaluation and business impact. </strong>Define offline benchmarks and online experiments tied to advertiser outcomes. Evaluate prediction quality, calibration, agent task completion, tool accuracy, latency, and cost; use A/B testing and incrementality methods where appropriate.</p> <p>•    <strong>Reliability and responsible AI. </strong>Set standards for service performance, drift detection, data quality, and incident response. Build privacy-aware data access, auditability, and protection against prompt injection, data leakage, and unintended agent actions.</p> <p>•    <strong>Technical leadership. </strong>Partner with engineering, data science, product, and business leaders to turn ambiguous needs into deliverable plans. Lead design and code reviews, mentor senior engineers, and resolve technical decisions across teams.</p> <h2>Required Qualifications</h2> <p>•    <strong> </strong>12+ years of relevant software engineering and applied ML experience, or equivalent demonstrated expertise, including substantial ownership of production ML systems and technical leadership across multiple teams.</p> <p>•    <strong> </strong>Deep expertise in predictive ML for ranking, recommendation, classification, or optimization, with strong foundations in statistics, experimentation, model evaluation, and the full model lifecycle.</p> <p>•    <strong> </strong>Hands-on experience delivering LLM applications and agentic workflows to production, including tool use, retrieval, orchestration, evaluation, guardrails, and operational monitoring.</p> <p>•    <strong> </strong>Proven ability to architect distributed, high-throughput, low-latency systems and make sound trade-offs across model quality, infrastructure cost, and operational complexity.</p> <p>•    <strong> </strong>Strong Python skills and proficiency in Java, Go, or a comparable backend language; experience with PyTorch or TensorFlow, SQL, and large-scale data or streaming systems such as Spark and Kafka.</p> <p>•    <strong> </strong>Experience with cloud infrastructure, preferably AWS, containerization, CI/CD, model serving, and production observability; familiarity with relational, NoSQL, caching, and retrieval systems.</p> <p>•    <strong> </strong>Ability to influence without direct authority, communicate architectural decisions clearly, mentor experienced engineers, and translate business objectives into measurable technical outcomes.</p> <h2>Preferred Qualifications</h2> <p>•    <strong> </strong>AdTech experience across DSPs, SSPs, real-time bidding, audience modeling, identity, attribution, or measurement; relevant experience in recommendation systems or marketplaces is also valued.</p> <p>•    <strong> </strong>Experience with causal inference, uplift modeling, contextual bandits, constrained optimization, or online learning in production.</p> <p>•    <strong> </strong>Experience with privacy-aware identity and audience systems, email advertising, or integrating ML capabilities across multiple products.</p> <p>•    <strong> </strong>Experience optimizing model and LLM inference, selecting and adapting models, or building reusable ML and agent platforms adopted by multiple teams.<br><br></p> <p><strong>PEOPLE & CULTURE AT ZETA</strong></p> <p>Zeta considers applicants for employment without regard to, and does not discriminate on the basis of an individual’s sex, race, color, religion, age, disability, status as a veteran, or national or ethnic origin; nor does Zeta discriminate on the basis of sexual orientation, gender identity or expression.  </p> <p>We’re committed to building a workplace culture of trust and belonging, so everyone feels invited to bring their whole selves to work. We provide a forum for employees to celebrate, support and advocate for one another. Learn more about our commitment to diversity, equity and inclusion here:  <a id="menur45rm" class="fui-Link ___1q1shib f2hkw1w f3rmtva f1ewtqcl fyind8e f1k6fduh f1w7gpdv fk6fouc fjoy568 figsok6 f1s184ao f1mk8lai fnbmjn9 f1o700av f13mvf36 f1cmlufx f9n3di6 f1ids18y f1tx3yz7 f1deo86v f1eh06m1 f1iescvh fhgqx19 f1olyrje f1p93eir f1nev41a f1h8hb77 f1lqvz6u f10aw75t fsle3fq f17ae5zn" href="https://zetaglobal.com/blog/a-look-into-zetas-ergs/" target="_blank">https://zetaglobal.com/blog/a-look-into-zetas-ergs/</a> </p> <p><strong>ZETA IN THE NEWS!</strong></p> <p><a href="https://zetaglobal.com/press/?cat=press-releases">https://zetaglobal.com/press/?cat=press-releases</a> </p> Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Social Media Senior Manager
description: <p><strong>Your wellbeing, our mission. Join a company shaping a healthier world.</strong></p> <p><strong>GET TO KNOW US</strong></p> <p>At Wellhub we're revolutionizing workplace wellness. Our platform connects employees worldwide to the best partners for fitness, mindfulness, therapy, nutrition, and sleep—all in one simple subscription. Headquartered in NYC with team members in Europe, North America and South America, we’re on a mission to make every company a wellness company.</p> <p>We believe work should be fulfilling, inspiring, and balanced. Here, you’ll find a team that values wellbeing, collaboration, and different perspectives, where passion and creativity push boundaries to create real impact. Your contributions will help shape a healthier, more balanced world for you and millions of people globally. </p> <p><strong>Join us in redefining the future of wellbeing!</strong></p> <p> </p> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><strong>THE OPPORTUNITY</strong></span></p> <p>We're looking for a Senior Manager of Social Media who will own the shaping and execution of our UK social media strategy and lead social media managers across all European markets where Wellhub operates. As the most senior Social Media professional in Europe, you'll be the regional lead for the team and the primary social media partner for senior stakeholders.In this role, you'll partner closely with our Senior Director of Global Social Media to bring the UK strategy to life—creating platform-specific content, developing cultural relevance, supporting local influencer and ambassador programs, and elevating Wellhub's presence across key platforms like Instagram, TikTok, LinkedIn, YouTube, and emerging channels.You're someone who lives and breathes social. You understand UK culture deeply. You know how to move fast, test fearlessly, and capture moments in real time. You have a video-first mindset and love being behind—and occasionally in front of—the camera.You'll combine hands-on UK ownership with European team management, stakeholder leadership, and accountability for regional alignment and performance. Your creativity, agility, and understanding of UK social trends will shape how consumers, partners, and companies experience Wellhub.</p> <h1><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><strong>YOUR IMPACT</strong></span></h1> <ul> <li>Shape and Execute the UK Social Media Strategy.</li> <li>Shape, localize, and operationalize Wellhub's social media strategy for the UK market.</li> <li>Build regionally relevant content plans tailored for B2C, B2B, and B2P audiences.</li> <li>Support Wellhub's GEO efforts through content strategy, partnering with relevant teams and European social media managers to align content priorities and strengthen brand authority and discoverability across the region.</li> <li>Manage the editorial calendar for the UK and ensure seamless alignment with global priorities, launches, campaigns, and cultural moments.</li> <li>Lead Social Media Managers Across Europe.</li> <li>Manage, coach, and develop social media managers across all European markets where Wellhub operates, setting clear objectives, supporting professional growth, and enabling local ownership.</li> <li>Set regional priorities with the Senior Director of Global Social Media, align local plans with global strategy, and establish regular planning and performance reviews.</li> <li>Share insights and successful formats across countries, resolve competing priorities, and represent the European social team in global discussions.</li> <li>Create High Impact Video First Content Concept, script, shoot, and edit content optimized for Reels, TikTok, YouTube Shorts, and LinkedIn.</li> <li>Capture spontaneous, social-worthy moments at local events, content shoots, and partner activations.</li> <li>Work with creative and production colleagues to bring fresh ideas to life.</li> <li>Drive Cultural Relevance.</li> <li>Identify UK cultural trends, memes, humor, and moments that Wellhub can authentically participate in.Adapt global narratives to fit the UK social landscape and audience expectations.</li> <li>Monitor competitor activity and industry trends to keep Wellhub culturally and creatively ahead.</li> <li>Lead Local Ambassador and Influencer Execution.</li> <li>Support the development and execution of influencer and ambassador programs in the UK</li> <li>Partner with creators and wellness influencers who authentically represent the Wellhub brand.</li> <li>Manage briefings, content feedback, deliverables, and performance tracking.</li> <li>Lead Stakeholder Relationships Across Europe</li> <li>Act as the most senior Social Media representative in Europe and the primary partner for regional leadership, country leaders, and senior marketing, sales, people, PR, and partner stakeholders.</li> <li>Build alignment on social strategy, priorities, and expectations across European markets.</li> <li>Guide decisions, constructively challenge requests, and resolve escalations while protecting local relevance and global brand consistency.</li> <li>Collaborate with UK marketing, sales, people, PR, and partner teams to amplify locally relevant moments.Work closely with the global creative team to align content quality, storytelling, sonic identity, and brand voice.</li> <li>Support country leaders and internal spokespeople with social content, thought leadership, and engagement guidance. </li> <li>Own Measurement Optimisation and Insights.</li> <li>Track and report on performance metrics across awareness, engagement, growth, and sentiment.Test new formats, creative variations, and posting strategies to continuously improve results.</li> <li>Conduct social listening to understand audience behavior and guide content direction.</li> <li>Review performance across European markets with local social managers and turn shared learnings into regional recommendations and improvements.</li> <li>Community Engagement and Brand Advocacy</li> <li>Oversee proactive community management across the UK channels—engaging in conversations, responding to comments, and cultivating brand advocates.</li> <li>Ensure alignment with global crisis and response protocols.</li> </ul> <h1><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><strong>WHO YOU ARE</strong></span></h1> <ul> <li>You have 7+ years of experience in social media, content creation, or digital marketing—ideally in fast-moving B2C or lifestyle brands.</li> <li>You're fluent in UK social culture, humor, trends, and how different audiences behave online.</li> <li>You have excellent English writing and editorial skills.</li> <li>You're a video-first creator who is comfortable planning, shooting, editing—and occasionally stepping in front of the camera.</li> <li>You're obsessed with social platforms: their algorithms, nuances, and emerging formats.</li> <li>You understand how to speak to diverse audiences—consumers, HR leaders, corporate buyers, wellness partners.</li> <li>You're highly creative, but also organized and able to manage calendars, workflows, approvals, and reporting.</li> <li>You have experience managing and developing social media teams across markets, with the judgement and autonomy to serve as the senior regional lead.</li> <li>You can influence senior stakeholders, explain your recommendations, manage difficult conversations, and align regional priorities with local needs.</li> <li>You excel in ambiguous, fast-paced environments and aren't afraid to test new ideas.</li> <li>You're a collaborative team player who values feedback, teamwork, and cross-functional partnership.</li> <li>You're proactive, curious, and passionate about wellbeing and digital storytelling.</li> </ul> <p>We recognize that individuals approach job applications differently. We strongly encourage all aspiring applicants to go for it, even if they don't match the job description 100%. We welcome your application and will be delighted to explore if you could be a great fit for our team. </p> <h1><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><strong>WHAT WE OFFER YOU</strong></span></h1> <p>With thoughtful benefits, emotional wellbeing resources, and a culture that empowers you to take ownership of your role and your wellbeing, we create an environment where you can thrive in all dimensions of your life. Our benefits include:</p> <p><strong>WELLHUB:</strong>  Free Gold membership with access to onsite gyms and studios, digital fitness programs, and online wellness resources for meditation, nutrition, mental wellbeing support, and more! Add up to three family members to your plan, ensuring access to wellness for those who matter most to you.</p> <p><strong>HEALTHCARE:</strong> Health and dental insurance. </p> <p><strong> </strong><strong>FLEXIBLE SCHEDULE: </strong> Flexibility for us isn’t just about where we work—it also means being able to shape how and when we get things done. Together with their leaders, employees define schedules that align with their time zones, team needs, and personal routines.</p> <p><strong>PAID TIME OFF:</strong> We know how important it is to take time away from work to recharge. description: <div class="content-intro"><p>Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.</p></div><p><strong>ABOUT THE ROLE</strong></p> <p>We are looking for an experienced and detail-oriented <strong>Senior Payroll Specialist (APAC) </strong>to join our team in Sydney. In this role, you will take full ownership of our APAC payroll operations, primarily focusing on our growing Australian footprint (~300 employees) alongside smaller regional entities across Asia.</p> <p>This is a high-visibility, technical role. You will initially run Australian payroll using Employment Hero while collaborating with third-party accounting partners across the region. Concurrently, you will play a central role in our migration to Workday, transitioning our Australian payroll fully in-house for a targeted July go-live. Once live, you will own the end-to-end processing directly in Workday.</p> <p>This position demands strong technical knowledge of Australian taxation, equity reporting (pre/post-IPO), salary packaging, shadow payroll, and termination compliance.</p> <p><strong>KEY RESPONSIBILITIES</strong></p> <ol> <li style="font-weight: bold;"><strong>End-to-End Payroll Operations & System Migration</strong></li> </ol> <ul> <li>Support the transition of Australian payroll from Employment Hero to Workday (target go-live: July), assisting with data validation, UAT, and parallel payroll runs.</li> <li>Once implemented, take full ownership of processing end-to-end payroll directly within Workday.</li> <li>Oversee and coordinate smaller regional payrolls across Asia, working closely with local third-party providers.</li> <li>Act as the primary point of contact for all employee payroll enquiries, delivering exceptional employee support.</li> </ul> <ol> <li style="font-weight: bold;"><strong>Specialised Calculations, Compensation & Benefits</strong></li> </ol> <ul> <li>Incentive Compensation: Verify bonus payments and calculate appropriate foreign currency conversions for payroll integration.</li> <li>Terminations: Calculate and process all termination payments (voluntary, involuntary, redundancies, PILON, annual leave accruals), ensuring accurate tax treatments, tax-free thresholds, and Employment Termination Payment (ETP) codes are strictly applied.</li> <li>Benefits & Expense Reimbursements: Review and administer vendor-based employee expense reimbursements, executing accurate gross-up calculations for benefits, where applicable.</li> <li>Salary Packaging: Manage the end-to-end setup, ongoing deductions, and termination adjustments for novated leases.</li> <li>Superannuation: Manage employee super choice elections, including setting up and validating new superannuation funds directly in Workday.</li> </ul> <ol> <li style="font-weight: bold;"><strong>Global Mobility & Shadow Payroll</strong></li> </ol> <ul> <li>Partner with our Global Mobility team and external tax partners to process complex shadow payroll calculations for inbound and outbound cross-border remote/mobile employees.</li> <li>Ensure correct withholding and reporting of PAYG and state payroll tax for international assignees.</li> </ul> <ol> <li style="font-weight: bold;"><strong>Tax, Equity (ESS) & Statutory Compliance</strong></li> </ol> <ul> <li>Manage equity tax reporting for RSUs and stock options, including verifying and filing annual Employee Share Scheme (ESS) statements and reports with the ATO.</li> <li>Reconcile, verify, and complete all month-end and year-end statutory requirements, including Single Touch Payroll (STP Phase 2) finalisations, Superannuation Guarantee contributions, and state-by-state payroll tax returns.</li> <li>Perform regular payroll audits, support Australian Government statutory payroll reporting, reconciliations, and variance analyses in close partnership with the Finance and Accounting teams.</li> </ul> <p><strong>REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS</strong></p> <ul> <li>5+ years of hands-on Australian payroll experience managing high-volume corporate payrolls (300+ employees).</li> <li>Australian Regulatory Mastery: Deep functional knowledge of Australian employment standards (Fair Work Act, NES, Modern Awards), ATO withholding rules, Superannuation Guarantee, and state payroll taxes.</li> <li>Equity Compensation: Proven experience reporting RSUs and stock compensation in Australia, ideally across both pre-IPO and post-IPO environments (including ESS annual reporting).</li> <li>Terminations & ETPs: Extensive practical experience calculating complex terminations (genuine redundancies, invalidity, notice periods) and applying proper ATO tax caps and treatments.</li> <li>Salary Packaging & Benefits: Direct experience setting up and administering novated leases and superannuation funds.</li> <li>Global Mobility: Direct experience running shadow payroll for inbound and outbound cross-border employees.</li> <li>Employee-Facing Support: Demonstrated experience serving as the lead, employee-facing point of contact for complex payroll and benefits enquiries.</li> </ul> <p><strong>PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience processing payroll in Workday or other cloud-based payroll systems.</li> <li>Experience coordinating small international payrolls across the broader APAC region (e.g. South Korea, Japan, Taiwan).</li> <li>Experience in supporting WGEA reporting.</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p><span data-contrast="auto">The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, If you are passionate about solving problems that have real impact and working on systems that directly contribute to achieving national strategic priorities for Australia and its allies, we want you to join Anduril's Maritime Division and help us build the future of defence capability.</p> <h2>ABOUT THE JOB</h2> <p>We are looking for a Division Operations Senior Associate to join our rapidly growing Maritime Division Operations team in <strong>Sydney, Australia</strong>. Our goal is to fundamentally reshape the way future peer to peer conflicts are fought by developing next generation undersea and surface capabilities, such as our XL-AUV, Copperhead, and Seabed Sentry platforms.<br><br>This is an operator role, not an advisory one. Built it.</li> <li>You love solving complex, ambiguous, cross-functional problems in a people-centric way, and can point to a time you drove alignment across teams with competing priorities without direct authority</li> <li>You're a clear, structured communicator, in writing and in the room, with senior leaders and engineers alike</li> <li>You manage stakeholders at every level, from engineers and technicians on the floor to program managers, functional leads, Directors, and executives, plus partner teams in the U.S. You build trust, tailor your message to the audience, manage up, push back when needed, and keep people aligned when you aren't in the room</li> <li>You're highly competent with AI tools (e.g. Claude, ChatGPT, Copilot) and use them every day to analyse data, draft, research, and build. title: Director AI Platform Engineering
description: Our client is building a new AI Engineering & Platform team in Germany to support the next generation of AI-powered media, localization, automation, and workflow capabilities. The Director, AI Engineering & Platform will lead this team and will be responsible for building, operating, and evolving the technical foundation for production AI services across our client. This is a senior hands-on leadership role for someone who can build and run a high-performing engineering team, deliver complex AI platform and integration projects, and provide technical direction across cloud infrastructure, model deployment, AI services, agentic workflows, and production operations. The role will lead a hybrid engineering team based primarily in Germany while also managing and collaborating with engineers in other our client locations, including the United States. In addition to leading delivery and operations, this person will continuously evaluate emerging AI technologies, model providers, open-source frameworks, agentic workflow patterns, and industry capabilities. They will be expected to make clear recommendations on where our client should build, buy, partner, or integrate in order to improve speed, quality, cost, automation, and product differentiation. RESPONSIBILITIES: Build, lead, mentor, and develop a distributed AI engineering team across Germany and other our client locations. Experience recruiting, hiring, and standing up the full AI/ML engineering organization from scratch: applied ML engineers, MLOps/platform engineers, data engineers, integration engineers, etc. Lead development, hosting and ongoing improvement of our client’s cloud-native training and inference platform (compute, storage, orchestration, model serving, monitoring, cost management) for our client’s NLP technology for MT, ASR, and TTS in production. Own technical delivery for our client’s AI platform, model-serving, workflow automation, and applied AI engineering initiatives. Lead architecture,execution, deployment and SLA performance for scalable AI services, including inference platforms, training environments, deployment pipelines, observability, and operational support. Own infrastructure cost efficiency (GPU utilization, training vs. inference cost trade-offs, autoscaling) as a first-class, ongoing responsibility rather than a one-time setup task. Evaluate internal and external AI technologies on an ongoing basis, including commercial models, open-source models, agentic frameworks, orchestration tools, and vendor platforms. Recommend when our client should build, buy, partner, or integrate with third-party AI capabilities. Guide teams responsible for cloud infrastructure, DevOps, AI platform operations, applied AI engineering, and model integration. Establish engineering standards, operating rhythms, delivery practices, documentation expectations, and technical review processes. Establish and drive MLOps practices: continuous improvement across AI engineering practices, reproducible training pipelines, model versioning and registry, automation, CI/CD, monitoring, automated quality evaluation, testing, and release management. Support adoption of AI capabilities across our client applications and workflows through reusable platforms, services, APIs, and technical patterns. Create clarity around priorities, risks, technical tradeoffs, delivery timelines, and resourcing needs. Ensure the team can operate production AI systems independently through strong documentation, runbooks, monitoring, incident response, and knowledge sharing. Partner with U.S. and European stakeholders across engineering, product, operations, localization, media workflows, and business leadership. Partner closely with the leaders of our client’s localization business lines to understand where current MT/ASR/TTS quality falls short and translate that into a prioritized technical roadmap. Ensure AI systems are reliable, secure, maintainable, cost-conscious, and aligned with production business needs. Represent AI/ML technology capability and constraints to executive leadership; contribute to the company's overall technology and product strategy. QUALIFICATIONS: [10+] years in software/ML engineering, including [4+] years in a technical leadership role owning both people management and architecture/system-design decisions. Direct, hands-on experience with model training/fine-tuning, evaluation methodology, and production deployment (not solely API-consumer experience). Proven experience designing and operating production ML infrastructure at scale: training pipelines, model serving/inference, GPU resource management, and MLOps tooling, on at least one major cloud provider (AWS, GCP, or Azure). Experience in distributed training, Slurm/HPC, Kubernetes, Docker, Terraform, or similar infrastructure technologies. Track record of building a technical team from scratch to a functioning, multi-workstream organization, including recruiting, leveling, and distributed team design across locations and time zones. Demonstrated ability to translate business/product requirements from non-technical stakeholders into a technical roadmap, and to communicate technical trade-offs to executives in business terms. Significant experience leading engineering teams responsible for cloud platforms, AI/ML systems, data platforms, workflow automation, or production software systems. Strong technical background in cloud architecture, software engineering, platform engineering, DevOps, or AI/ML engineering. Experience with agentic workflows, LLM orchestration, model evaluation, RAG patterns, or AI-enabled automation platforms. Experience evaluating commercial and open-source AI models or vendor platforms. Experience delivering production systems that require reliability, monitoring, automation, security, and operational ownership. Strong understanding of modern AI architectures, model-serving patterns, APIs, data pipelines, and applied AI integration. Ability to evaluate technical options, make pragmatic recommendations, and communicate tradeoffs to both technical and non-technical audiences. Experience leading complex technical programs from planning through production deployment and ongoing operations. Ability to work effectively with U.S.-based leadership while operating independently from Germany. PREFERRED EXPERIENCE: Experience with speech, language, localization, dubbing, media workflows, ASR, MT, TTS, or content-processing systems. Prior experience in media, localization, entertainment technology, or a related content-production industry — direct exposure to subtitling, dubbing, or content compliance workflows is a strong plus. Familiarity with content-security frameworks used by major studios and broadcasters (e.g., MPA content security best practices, Trusted Partner Network) and what they require of vendor/internal systems. Prior experience taking over or migrating away from a third-party AI/ML vendor relationship, including contract wind-down and knowledge-transfer. Experience in media, entertainment, localization, post-production, or content supply chain environments. Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Staff Fullstack Engineer
description: Deep Tech Recruitment is partnering with a Speedinvest venture-backed European AI company building the modern software backbone for specialist pharmaceutical and chemical manufacturers. Its mission is to strengthen the resilience of essential European supply chains by helping manufacturers overcome skilled labour shortages, respond faster to disruption and reduce the operational risk created by ageing ERP systems, spreadsheets and fragmented knowledge. The business is developing an AI-native operating environment that provides consistent data and intelligent workflows across order management, production planning, materials planning and procurement, while retaining the human oversight required in regulated industries. The company The company is building an AI native software backbone for specialist manufacturers, initially across mission critical pharmaceutical and chemical supply chains. Many of these businesses still run critical order, planning and procurement processes through ageing ERP systems, spreadsheets and knowledge held by a small number of experienced employees. The product combines workflow automation, AI agents and human approval to help operational teams respond faster while maintaining accuracy, traceability and compliance. The engineering team works close to customers, including visits to operational environments, to understand how work happens and turn it into dependable software. The role As an early staff engineering hire, you will help shape the platform from its first production versions. This is a hands on full stack role with strong backend ownership. You will work directly with the founders, influence architecture and engineering standards, and stay close to the users whose workflows you are improving. Why consider it You will have meaningful influence over the architecture, product and early engineering culture. The technical work combines AI enabled systems, enterprise integration and demanding operational constraints. The product supports essential European industries where software reliability and human judgement both matter. The package includes a competitive base salary and meaningful early stage equity through a VSOP. What you will do Build end to end product features with TypeScript, Node.js, React and Next.js. Design and evolve backend services, APIs and system architecture for complex operational workflows. Model and optimise data in PostgreSQL, with attention to reliability, performance and auditability. Develop multi step AI agent workflows with validation logic, evaluations, monitoring and human approval points. Integrate with enterprise systems including ERPs, communication tools and document platforms through REST APIs and other interfaces. Support cloud and on premises deployments, working directly with customer IT teams where required. Build secure, traceable workflows suitable for regulated environments and contribute to audit readiness and compliance documentation. Join customer conversations, understand real operating constraints and translate them into product and technical decisions. Help establish the engineering culture, technical bar and practical ways of working for the team as it grows. What AI native means here The company uses external language models and coding agents to build and ship software faster. The role involves engineering reliable AI enabled workflows around those models. It does not involve training foundation models or conducting AI research. Strong software engineering judgement remains central, particularly around evaluation, failure modes, observability and human oversight. What you bring Around 3 to 5 or more years of experience building and operating production software. Strong backend engineering skills with Node.js, API design and system architecture. Solid PostgreSQL experience, including data modelling and query optimisation. Experience integrating REST APIs and external systems. The ability to work across the stack using JavaScript or TypeScript and React or Next.js. A hands on approach. You can reason about architecture and still write, test and ship production code. Fluent English for technical collaboration and customer conversations. The willingness to work with the team from the Berlin office five days a week. Useful additional experience Enterprise software or products built for regulated, high security environments. LLM integrations using providers such as OpenAI, Anthropic or Google, including evaluation and monitoring. ERP integrations such as SAP, Microsoft Dynamics 365 or Infor. Cloud infrastructure, DevOps and connections to on premises or legacy systems. German language skills for direct customer communication. Strong product and UX instincts, or experience working with design systems. How the team works High ownership and direct access to the founding team. Fast iteration informed by customer workflows and operational reality. Clear expectations, practical decision making and space to shape how engineering is done. A long term product build with the opportunity to grow into broader technical leadership as the team expands. Interview process The process combines founder & engineering conversations with practical technical assessment. title: Strategic Account Executive - France
description: France-based | French required | English required | Additional languages are a plus | Approximately 30% travel About Rescale Rescale is pioneering the future of engineering and scientific discovery. As the leader in digital engineering, we help the world’s most advanced organizations develop better products faster through intelligent automation, applied AI, data management, and access to the world’s largest network of engineering and R&D applications. Rescale brings together elastic, enterprise-grade HPC with advanced modeling and simulation, agentic engineering, AI Physics, and the software and data workflows that connect them. Our customers use Rescale to modernize R&D, accelerate simulation, automate engineering processes, and turn engineering data into faster, better decisions across industries including automotive, manufacturing, aerospace, energy, life sciences, and semiconductors. Joining Rescale means becoming part of a diverse, collaborative, and mission-driven team solving complex challenges that traditional HPC alone cannot address. The Role We are looking for a high-performing Strategic Account Executive to lead direct enterprise sales and account growth across France. This is an entrepreneurial, field-based role focused on building and expanding strategic relationships with key and enterprise accounts. You will own a defined portfolio of named accounts, create demand, develop executive relationships, win new business, and expand Rescale’s footprint from foundational HPC into advanced modeling and simulation, agentic engineering, and AI Physics. You will operate as the commercial owner of your territory: setting the account strategy, identifying business problems, building internal champions, creating compelling value cases, and leading complex sales cycles from first engagement through renewal and expansion. This is a direct-sales role, not a channel-led position. You will work closely with Solutions Engineering, Customer Success, Marketing, Sales Development, Product, and Rescale leadership, while retaining ownership of the commercial strategy and outcome. France is a priority market, with particular emphasis on automotive and manufacturing enterprises where engineering organizations are investing in digital engineering transformation. Success requires the ability to sell both into existing strategic relationships and into new enterprise accounts where Rescale can create meaningful business impact. What You’ll Do Own and grow a focused portfolio of strategic key and enterprise accounts across France. Build account and territory plans that identify the highest-value expansion paths, whitespace, executive relationships, and competitive risks. Expand existing Rescale customers by introducing additional capabilities across the platform, from Rescale HPC to Advanced Modeling and Simulation, Agentic Engineering, and AI Physics. Develop new enterprise relationships and win new logos where Rescale’s platform can transform engineering and R&D workflows. Generate pipeline through proactive prospecting, account-based engagement, executive networking, customer insight, and disciplined market development. Engage senior stakeholders across engineering, R&D, simulation, IT, digital transformation, finance, procurement, and executive leadership. Lead the full enterprise sales cycle, including account planning, discovery, qualification, value engineering, business-case development, solution alignment, negotiation, procurement, and close. Position Rescale as a strategic platform for HPC modernization, simulation acceleration, engineering workflow transformation, and AI-driven product development. Articulate how Rescale’s offerings work together: HPC as the scalable foundation; Advanced Modeling and Simulation as the workflow layer; Agentic Engineering as the automation layer; and AI Physics as the intelligence layer that turns simulation data into predictive insight. Build trusted relationships across the customer organization, from end users and technical champions to business sponsors, procurement leaders, and C-level decision-makers. Orchestrate internal teams to deliver coordinated account plans, executive engagement, technical validation, pilots, and commercial proposals. Maintain rigorous Salesforce hygiene, forecast accuracy, opportunity inspection, and pipeline coverage, with clear weekly visibility into commit, likely, best case, and risk. Represent Rescale in customer meetings, industry events, and executive forums across France, with travel expected at approximately 30%. What Success Looks Like Consistent achievement and overachievement of quarterly and annual revenue targets through a healthy mix of account expansion and net-new enterprise business. Durable growth within strategic accounts, including broader adoption of Rescale’s platform and expansion into new teams, workloads, geographies, and use cases. A high-quality, self-generated pipeline across automotive, manufacturing, and other engineering-intensive industries. New enterprise logos and meaningful strategic wins in the French market. Executive-level credibility with customers navigating HPC modernization, simulation, AI, and digital engineering transformation. Clear customer value cases that connect technical outcomes to business priorities such as faster product development, higher engineering productivity, improved infrastructure flexibility, and better R&D economics. Consistent operating discipline, urgency, ownership, resilience, and transparency in a high-growth environment. Who You Are An entrepreneurial enterprise seller who creates opportunity rather than waiting for inbound demand. Equally comfortable expanding an established strategic account and opening a new enterprise relationship. A strong hunter with the persistence and commercial judgment to create access, build consensus, and win competitive deals. Confident engaging technical practitioners while earning credibility with senior business leaders and executives. Resilient and resourceful in long, complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles. Commercially disciplined and accountable for your number, account strategy, forecast, pipeline quality, and execution. Consultative, curious, and able to translate complex technology into compelling business outcomes. Collaborative and low-ego, with the influence to mobilize cross-functional teams without losing ownership of the result. Motivated by the opportunity to help define a new category at the intersection of cloud HPC, digital engineering, automation, and AI. Key Qualifications 5+ years of success in enterprise or strategic account sales, ideally selling complex technical, cloud, SaaS, platform, engineering, or scientific-computing solutions. Demonstrated success growing enterprise accounts and/or winning new business in France. Experience selling to large organizations in automotive, manufacturing, industrial technology, engineering software, simulation, HPC, cloud, or adjacent technology environments. A track record of managing long, complex, multi-threaded enterprise sales cycles from discovery through close and expansion. Ability to engage credibly with engineering, R&D, IT, digital transformation, procurement, finance, and executive stakeholders. Strong skills in consultative discovery, value selling, negotiation, executive communication, and closing. Experience using Salesforce or a similar CRM with disciplined opportunity management and forecasting. Excellent written and verbal communication skills in French and English . Additional languages are an advantage. Strong organization, prioritization, and account-planning skills. Must be based in France and able to travel regularly to customer sites and industry events across the country. Why Rescale Rescale serves many of the world’s most advanced engineering organizations and is helping define the next generation of digital engineering. For the right sales leader, this is an opportunity to shape strategic accounts in a category where cloud HPC, advanced simulation, agentic engineering, and AI Physics are converging to change how products are designed, tested, and brought to market. If you are energized by building executive relationships, creating demand, expanding strategic accounts, and helping engineering organizations move from traditional infrastructure and fragmented workflows to an intelligent digital engineering platform, this role offers significant strategic and commercial upside.
