title: Senior Business Controller (Operations)
description: Would you like to work closely with the business as a Senior Business Controller and use your financial expertise to make a real impact on decisions? You will bring financial structure and insight, while keeping a forward-looking perspective: where can we improve, which decisions will make a financial difference, and what will they mean for our results? HG is a compact, international organisation. This means considerable responsibility, direct contact with decision-makers and room to drive change yourself. We are therefore looking for someone who takes ownership, works pragmatically and is not afraid to challenge existing ways of working. You will be based at our head office in Almere. Hybrid working opportunities are limited: regular office attendance is important in this role because of the close collaboration with Finance, Operations and other stakeholders. You will also travel to the United Kingdom or Germany several times a year. About the role As Senior Business Controller, you will be responsible for business control within Operations and will also support our subsidiaries in the United Kingdom and Germany. You have a clear vision of what the best operational business control model looks like and have proven experience in realizing this. The Senior Business Controller plays a key role in strengthening financial control, transparency and decision-making across Operations. The scope covers procurement and product costing, as well as warehouse and transport operations. Working closely with Finance, Procurement and Operations, the Senior Business Controller translates operational developments and improvement initiatives into clear financial insights and P&L impact Our business is undergoing significant change. HG has recently changed its logistics service arrangements, consolidating most local warehouses into one central location as part of a cost-saving initiative. At the same time, a new ERP system is being implemented. This creates an interesting and dynamic environment in which existing budget models, cost allocation models, reporting and financial processes need to be further developed to reflect the new operating model and provide a solid basis for financial control and decision-making. What you will do Your responsibilities will include: Owning the operational cost lines between Net Sales and Contribution Margin for the whole group and . act as a strong Finance business partner to the Chief Operating Officer and his team, translating operational developments into actionable financial insights; Identifying and driving continuous improvements to the operational business, improving insights while reducing costs. Being the financial business partner for the country managers in the UK and Germany, including reviewing commercial deals and business cases. Analyzing budget versus actuals and explaining significant variances. Developing a clear understanding of budgeted versus actual purchase prices and identifying the key drivers behind price variances. Providing insight into raw material and purchase price developments and translating these into expected P&L impact. Quantifying and tracking the financial impact of Procurement and product-costing initiatives and other savings programmes. Establishing and further developing standard COGS based on expected cost developments. Build a thorough understanding of the warehouse and distribution budget, operational performance and key savings initiatives. Track whether the expected savings from the recently implemented warehouse and transport provider change are being realized in the P&L. Further developing cost allocation models for individual markets, using meaningful drivers, and working towards more complete and reliable management reporting. Ensuring the Operations P&L, budget and actual costs are consistently captured and reported in the same structure. Translating inventory developments into financial impact and creating a clear link between stock levels, budget assumptions and cost allocation. Supporting and improving an efficient month-end closing process, ensuring Operations costs are accurately and consistently booked, allocated and reconciled. E stablish or improve proper accounting entries together with Finance Administration and relevant operational partners. Co-lead the annual budget cycle and budget presentations to the Board. Using and improving Power BI, ERP data and financial processes to reduce manual work and increase transparency. You will report directly to the Chief Financial Officer and work closely with colleagues in Finance, Procurement and Operations. You will also have regular contact with the Germany and UK country managers. This position requires more than strong analytical skills. You will need to explain your insights clearly, engage stakeholders and constructively challenge where necessary. You will be a knowledgeable sparring partner who asks questions, brings structure and takes responsibility from analysis through to implementation. You proactively identify opportunities to improve financial processes, controls, reporting and transparency across Operations. HG is a compact, fast-growing and international organization where you can directly see the impact of your work. This requires ownership, initiative and a pragmatic, results-oriented mindset. The team culture is open, pragmatic and focused on results, encouraging you to bring ideas forward, challenge constructively and take responsibility. Everything we do is guided by our three core values: Aim High, Be Brave, Be Connected. What you bring We are looking for a financially strong, hands-on and improvement-oriented controller who combines analytical capability with a practical understanding of Operations. The ideal candidate is comfortable working across Finance, Procurement and Operations and is able to turn complex cost drivers into clear insights and concrete actions. You bring a proactive mindset, strong stakeholder-management skills and a natural drive to simplify and improve processes. You are comfortable challenging existing ways of working, creating structure in a changing environment and taking ownership from analysis through implementation. You will also have: A completed university master’s degree in Finance, Economics, Business Administration or a related field. A Registered Controller (RC) qualification is a strong advantage. Around 10 years of relevant experience in business control, operations control or a comparable financial role. Experience in a manufacturing environment is important, including knowledge of production processes, procurement and cost calculations. A sound understanding of business control, financial controls and treasury. Experience with ERP systems and an understanding of how financial data and accounting flows are structured. Good knowledge of Power BI. You do not need to build everything from scratch, but you can independently investigate, improve and develop analyses. Experience working with consolidation tools. Strong analytical, communication and stakeholder management skills. A proactive, hands-on and improvement-oriented mindset, with the ability to create structure in a changing environment. Fluency in English. Knowledge of Dutch is desirable, and German is an advantage. Experience with AI tools, such as Copilot. Willingness to travel to the United Kingdom and Germany several times a year. Please note that we do not offer visa or work permit sponsorship for this position. You must therefore hold a valid EU work permit What do we offer At HG, you will not be stepping into a role where everything is already set in stone. Changes in our logistics operations, systems and reporting create opportunities to further professionalize financial control and implement improvements yourself. You can expect: a senior role with broad responsibility and direct influence on financial and operational decision-making; a salary appropriate to the seniority of the role, with an indicative range of €85,000 to €100,000 gross per year; an annual on-target bonus of 25% of your gross annual salary; full-time employment with 30 days of annual leave; a pension scheme; a commuting allowance; a full-time role based at our head office in Almere. Hybrid working is possible on a limited basis, with office attendance being an important part of the role; a dynamic and ambitious working environment where initiative and ownership are valued; a friendly, welcoming team, with a free shared lunch every Monday and monthly social drinks. We are HG HG is a leading European brand in specialist cleaning and maintenance products. We believe a home should be a place where people can live carefree, with confidence in the products they use to care for the spaces and belongings around them. Our products are developed to do exactly what they promise: deliver effective, reliable and specialist cleaning solutions that help consumers solve real household problems. HG’s mission is to help people enjoy their homes without worrying about what might go wrong. We do this through high-quality products, specialist expertise, clear advice and a relentless focus on performance. We are dedicated to delivering superiority, innovation, quality and customer satisfaction. With a strong presence across Europe and beyond, we are continuously investing to make an even bigger impact. HG does what it promises. Do you have any questions? Our colleague Ilse de Groot, Corporate Recruiter, will be happy to answer any questions. You can contact her at . Would you like to apply for the senior business controller position at HG? You can apply directly by uploading your CV. We aim to respond within 5 working days. Acquisition in response to this vacancy is not appreciated. title: Post-doctorante ou Post-doctorant en transmission et détection sur fibres à cœurs creux - CDD de 18 mois
description: Qui sommes-nous ? Télécom Paris, école de l’IMT (Institut Mines-Télécom) et membre fondateur de l’Institut Polytechnique de Paris, est une grande école du top 6 des écoles d’ingénieurs généralistes françaises. La Raison d’Être de Télécom Paris est de former, imaginer et entreprendre pour concevoir des modèles, des technologies et des solutions numériques au service d’une société et d’une économie respectueuses de l’humain et de son environnement. Nous recherchons une Post-doctorante ou un Post-doctorant en transmission et détection sur fibres à cœurs creux pour rejoindre le département COMELEC à Télécom Paris. Les fibres à cristaux photoniques à cœur creux (Hollow-Core Photonic Crystal Fibers, HCPCF) ont récemment franchi une étape technologique majeure, avec des pertes de propagation pouvant atteindre 0.1 dB/km à 1550 nm, comparables, voire inférieures, à celles des fibres télécoms standards [1–2]. La lumière se propageant principalement dans l’air, les HCPCF présentent une latence réduite de 30 à 40 %, une dispersion ultra-faible et des non-linéarités optiques négligeables. Ces propriétés uniques en font des technologies particulièrement prometteuses pour les systèmes de télécommunications de nouvelle génération, la distribution quantique de clés (Quantum Key Distribution, QKD) sur longue distance et les applications de détection distribuée. Le projet proposé vise à développer et démontrer la prochaine génération de fibres à cristaux photoniques à cœur creux (HCPCF) pour la transmission de données à haut débit et les applications de détection. La propagation de la lumière dans l’air plutôt que dans le verre permet aux HCPCF d’offrir une latence réduite et des non-linéarités optiques négligeables par rapport aux fibres de silice, répondant ainsi à certains des enjeux majeurs des futurs centres de données et réseaux optiques. Notre ambition est de démontrer une transmission à 400 Gbit/s sur quelques kilomètres à travers des échantillons de fibres issus de nouvelles architectures, et d’étudier le potentiel de ces HCPCF pour des applications de détection. La réalisation de ces objectifs nécessite de répondre à des spécifications exigeantes en matière de guidage monomode, de contrôle de la polarisation, ainsi que de faibles pertes par courbure et par couplage. Deux équipes complémentaires assureront conjointement l'encadrement de ces travaux : le GPPMM, reconnu internationalement pour ses activités de conception et de fabrication de HCPCF [3–5], et le GTO, leader dans la démonstration de systèmes de communication optique et de détection à haut débit [6–8]. Un processus itératif entre la fabrication des fibres et leur caractérisation au niveau système permettra de s'assurer que leurs propriétés répondent aux exigences opérationnelles en matière de transmission et de détection. Sur le plan méthodologique, le projet combinera modélisation numérique, caractérisation et validation expérimentale dans la bande C. Les méthodes de modélisation et de traitement du signal développées au GTO pour le suivi de la polarisation contribueront à évaluer et à optimiser les performances de transmission des HCPCF conçues et caractérisées au GPPMM. À propos du projet PLEIADES Le projet PLEIADES s'inscrit dans le cadre du programme PEPR « Réseaux du futur », financé par l'ANR, et réunit un consortium de 14 partenaires. L'un des axes de travail porte sur les fibres à cœur creux de nouvelle génération et rassemble plusieurs laboratoires académiques, notamment LTCI, XLIM et PHLAM. Vos principales missions seront de : Assurer des missions de recherche dans le domaine de la photonique Assurer des missions d’encadrement et de tutorat Participer à la notoriété de l’Ecole, de l’Institut Mines-Télécom et de l’Institut Polytechnique de Paris Vous êtes titulaire d’un doctorat ou équivalent en génie électrique, communications, photonique, traitement du signal ou dans un domaine connexe. Vous disposez de solides connaissances en systèmes et réseaux de transmission optique ainsi qu’en traitement numérique du signal (DSP) appliqué aux systèmes de communication ou aux capteurs à fibre optique. La maîtrise de MATLAB et/ou Python pour le développement d’algorithmes DSP sera appréciée. Vous manifestez un intérêt marqué pour la recherche appliquée et êtes à l’aise dans un environnement multiculturel, notamment pour encadrer des stagiaires et/ou des étudiants. Une bonne maîtrise de l’anglais est indispensable. Vous disposez également de bonnes qualités relationnelles et pédagogiques, d’un bon esprit d’équipe et d’une capacité à synthétiser et à communiquer des informations complexes. Pourquoi nous rejoindre ? Vous travaillerez dans un environnement en plein développement, agréable, verdoyant et accessible (notamment pour les personnes en situation de handicap) à seulement 20 km de Paris (RER B et C, proximité des grands axes routiers). Vous bénéficierez de : 49 jours de congés annuels (CA + RTT) flexibilité des horaires de travail (en fonction de l'activité du service) télétravail 1 à 3 jours/semaine possible Remboursement abonnement transports en commun à 75% Proximité de nombreuses infrastructures sportives, conciergerie, parking souterrain, restauration interne... A savoir : nos cotisations sociales sont moins élevées que dans le secteur privé Informations diverses : Date limite de candidature : 30 novembre 2026 Type d'emploi : CDD de 18 mois Description de poste ici Rémunération : 36 000 euros brut/an Nos recrutements sont fondés sur les compétences, sans distinction d’origine, d’âge, d'identité de genre et d’orientation sexuel et tous nos postes sont ouverts aux personnes en situation de handicap. title: Senior Embedded Software Engineer
description: At CesiumAstro , we are developers and pioneers of out-of-the-box communication systems for satellites, UAVs, launch vehicles, and other space and airborne platforms. title: Investment Team Intern (m/w/d) - AI Roll-up
description: We are building Germany's leading tax advisory firm. Many business owners want a tax advisor who acts as a true sparring partner: proactive, responsive and strategic. What they often get is a service provider that books receipts and files returns, with little real advice. We're building the alternative. Founded in 2025, Taxforce rethinks tax advisory from the ground up: AI-powered and highly automated, yet personal. We're starting with healthcare professionals, a complex and underserved segment, and we grow both organically and through M&A. This is a €40B market in Germany alone, with processes that have barely changed in decades. AI now enables a fundamental shift, and there are no playbooks yet. We're writing them. We're a small, highly ambitious team in Berlin, backed by €5M from Tenet VC and founded by alumni of Goldman Sachs, Harvard Business School, Bain & Company, Y Combinator and the former Klarna Head of Engineering. The role You join the team that finds, evaluates, finances and integrates the tax firms that join Taxforce. You work directly with our founders on live deals and own your workstreams from first screening to closing and beyond. Tasks Deal sourcing. Build and maintain a pipeline of tax firms that fit our focus, from research and screening to first outreach. Firm analysis. Turn DATEV reports, business analyses, annual accounts and payroll data into a clear picture of revenue, clients, team capacity and profitability. Models and valuation. Build and maintain valuation and financing models in Excel. Due diligence. Prepare and run due diligence workstreams, from data room to question lists. Financing. Prepare materials for banks and financing partners and keep the process on track. Decision papers. Write investment memos and presentations for founders and investors. Post-merger integration. Support the onboarding of acquired firms, from process documentation to cross-firm coordination. Requirements Strong academic background. You have a very good Bachelor’s degree or are enrolled in a Master’s in business, economics, finance or a related field. First deal experience. You’ve interned in M&A, transaction services, private equity, investment banking, corporate finance or consulting. Financial fluency. You understand P&Ls, balance sheets and cash flows and quickly spot what doesn’t add up. Analytical mindset. You turn incomplete information into a clear recommendation. AI-native. You use AI tools to build analyses and models faster. German language skills. Sellers and banks speak German, so we require fluent German (C2) and English. Benefits Work directly with experienced founders. Learn first-hand from a team with backgrounds at Goldman Sachs, Harvard Business School, Bain & Company and Klarna, and from a former Y Combinator founder. Buy-and-build from the inside. See how a group of tax firms is built at an early stage. At the table. Meet sellers, banks and investors and present your own analysis. Ownership from day one. Take on real responsibility early, on live clients, deals and projects. Front-row seat to AI in the real world. See how AI transforms a traditional industry and help build it. Steep learning curve. Work on real problems, ship quickly and build skills that prepare you to start your own company. A path to stay. Strong interns get an offer to continue as working student or full-time. title: Senior Airspace Engineer
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;"><strong>About Electra</strong></span></p> <p><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;">Air travel is about to become something more: more direct, more accessible, and more connected to the places where people live, work and want to be. Every day in the U.S., people make 35 million trips of 50–500 miles, stuck in traffic or routed through crowded hubs. Chances are, you've been one of them. At Electra, we're changing that with the EL9, a nine-passenger, hybrid-electric aircraft that takes off and lands in just 150 feet. Our Ultra Short technology opens up thousands of new places to fly, beyond conventional runways, congested airports and long drives. We're backed by Lockheed Martin, Honeywell and Safran. Operators worldwide have signed intent-to-purchase agreements for the first 2,200 aircraft we produce, and we're moving toward first test flights in 2027.</span></p> <p><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;">Getting a new kind of aircraft airborne takes more than ambition. It takes our kind of bold: people who think big while working in the real world. Who move ideas into action and collaborate without silos. Who put people first and make room at the table for everyone. Who challenge one another without diminishing one another.</span></p> <p><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;">Sound like you? Collaboration with the FAA, NATCA, and industry standards development organizations is central to the role.</span></p> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;">This role requires a deep understanding of how aircraft performance, flight operations, airspace design, VFR/IFR procedures, PBN, RNAV/RNP operations, obstacle evaluation, navigation systems, FAA/EASA regulations, and real-world operational constraints intersect. The successful candidate will translate new aircraft capabilities and operational concepts into safe, certifiable, and operationally useful flight-path infrastructure.</span></p> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;">The ideal candidate understands airspace design and air traffic management concepts, tools, and workflows across congested terminal and en route airspace, and has led or contributed to research translating novel aircraft capabilities into operational procedures. Firsthand experience in procedure design, airspace design, or air traffic control is valuable; working familiarity with the FAA’s 8260-series Orders is expected.</span></p> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;">The engineer will collaborate with Electra and FAA teams through Electra’s Cooperative Research and Development Agreement (CRADA) with the FAA Tech Center, the FAA eIPP program, the Virginia Smart Airspace Program, and the International Test Arena in Norway, as well as through company-led testing and procedure development.</span></p> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><strong>What You’ll Do</strong></span></p> <ul> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Translate EL9 performance characteristics into Ultra Short operational capabilities, including ground footprint, obstacle clearance, and maneuvering.</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Collaborate with aircraft performance engineers to model EL9 capabilities under normal, degraded, and contingency conditions, incorporating system safety analysis to define feasible Ultra Short procedures.</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Develop candidate procedures for novel urban access points and existing airports, taking into account EL2/EL9 Ultra Short performance, instrument procedure design criteria, airport traffic flows, and the obstacle environment.</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Review FAA, EASA, ICAO, and national standards—including fixed-wing, heliport, and vertiport frameworks, demonstrations and simulations to validate operational concepts.</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Synthesize flight test results, lessons learned, and operational insights to inform regulatory workstreams developing Ultra Short policy and standards.</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Support Electra’s commercial and infrastructure partnerships teams in assessing the feasibility of candidate access points in urban settings and at airports.</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Develop thought leadership materials that clearly explain novel Ultra Short operational concepts to regulators, local stakeholders, and airport authorities.</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Represent Electra in FAA, EASA, and ICAO working groups and industry standards development organizations to help shape standards, guidance, and policy for Ultra Short airspace integration and operations.</span></li> </ul> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><strong>What you Bring</strong></span></p> <ul> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Master’s degree or PhD in aerospace engineering, aviation management, airport planning, or a related field.</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">5+ years of experience in airspace management research, policy and regulatory development, airspace or procedure design, or a related domain.</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: title: Account Management Lead - Editions France
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>Our Global Structure</strong></p> <p><br>Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we’re unlocking new possibilities as one global team.</p></div><p><strong>Editions, our network of delivery-only kitchens, is a key differentiator in France commercial ambition. </strong>The Account Management Lead – Editions France role is created as part of a wider reorganisation of the Editions business as part of our regional strategy. The role reports to Paris regional leadership and is designed to combine strategic partner leadership, P&L ownership and organisation building across the Editions network.</p> <p><strong>The Role</strong></p> <p>As <strong>Account Management Lead – Editions France</strong>, you will lead the Editions commercial team for France constituted of Senior Account Managers, Account Managers and Sales Managers. You will be the guardian of the Editions strategy for France, accountable for its coordination and its execution on the ground, growing the performance and profitability of our sites while driving occupancy and the differentiation Editions brings to the French market.</p> <p>You will own a portion of the Editions P&L. That means holding the commercial scorecard for new kitchens, making financial decisions with a clear view of both partner and Deliveroo profitability, and steering your team's portfolio towards sustainable growth rather than volume alone.</p> <p>You will be accountable for the development plan for your team, their success and learning curve at Deliveroo; setting the right KPIs and OKRs to monitor the business. Your role will be commercially focused, however Editions is as much a project management discipline as a commercial one: you will work hand in hand with Food Safety, Compliance, Site Construction, Kitchen Layout, Site Operations, Marketing and the International Editions team to bring kitchens live and keep them performing.</p> <h3><strong>What You’ll Be Doing</strong></h3> <ul> <li> <p>Editions Strategy & Growth</p> <ul> <li> <p>Act as the guardian of the Editions strategy for France, ensuring its coordination across teams and its disciplined execution site by site</p> </li> <li> <p>Lead your team's portfolio strategy, growing the performance and profitability of each Editions site in line with agreed targets</p> </li> <li> <p>Develop the business so that it fits within, and contributes to, the wider regional strategy, bringing the specificity of the French network to regional and international forums</p> </li> <li> <p>Build and deliver joint business plans with restaurant partners, identifying growth and profitability opportunities, defining mutual goals and finding compelling ways to solve them (menu optimisation, virtual brands, pricing, packaging, catchment expansion)</p> </li> <li> <p>Coordinate with the Media team to identify and negotiate revenue opportunities to generate additional value from Editions sites</p> </li> </ul> </li> </ul> <ul> <li> <p>Occupancy & Commercial Performance</p> <ul> <li> <p>Own the occupancy trajectory of the French network, partnering closely with Local teams to positively drive occupancy and secure signed contracts within agreed timelines</p> </li> <li> <p>Own and enforce the Editions commercial scorecard for new kitchens, profitability checks against P&L guidelines, launch package, site specificities, ensuring the process is applied consistently across the team</p> </li> <li> <p>Steer the lead generation and pipeline process, mapping high-potential restaurants and cuisine gaps by site, and mobilising other commercial stakeholders to qualify interest</p> </li> <li> <p>Lead commercial negotiations with business owners and C-suite operators, supporting proposals with a robust P&L rationale</p> </li> </ul> </li> </ul> <ul> <li> <p>P&L Ownership & Governance</p> <ul> <li> <p>Own a portion of the Editions P&L, accountable for revenue, profitability and the financial health of your perimeter</p> </li> <li> <p>Set, own and deliver performance targets across occupancy, partner health, site profitability and Deliveroo output metrics</p> </li> <li> <p>Run a clear operating rhythm on reporting, velocity, sign-to-live, occupancy and sales reviews, and use it to make decisions, not just to describe results</p> </li> </ul> </li> </ul> <ul> <li> <p>Kitchen Launches & Cross-functional Execution</p> </li> <li> <p>Work with Site Managers, Food Safety, Compliance, Site Construction and Kitchen Layout teams to secure the successful build and launch of new kitchens</p> </li> <li> <p>Coordinate with Global team on kitchen implementation, and with Marketing and Operations on launch packages, so that every opening lands on time and performs from week one</p> </li> <li> <p>Manage and oversee project execution end to end, including B2B communication and cross-business-unit workshops</p> </li> <li> <p>Propose process optimisation and automation: Deliveroo moves fast, and you will improve the processes that let Editions scale</p> </li> </ul> <ul> <li> <p>Senior Stakeholder Management</p> <ul> <li> <p>Act as the senior point of contact and face of Deliveroo Editions for top restaurant partners, building trusted, long-term relationships and representing Deliveroo at partner events</p> </li> <li> <p>Establish a strong operating rhythm with partners, including quarterly business reviews and monthly performance check-ins</p> </li> <li> <p>Serve as a trusted advisor to senior stakeholders, providing strategic insights on Deliveroo, competitors and broader industry trends</p> </li> </ul> </li> </ul> <ul> <li> <p>Team Leadership: Support and coach your Account Managers and Sales Managers to build and execute strong commercial and operational plans, and to raise the standard of account management across the Editions network</p> </li> </ul> <div style="min-height: 1.2em; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0;"> </div> <h3><strong>What You’ll Need to Thrive</strong></h3> <ul> <li> <p>7+ years working in commercially focused roles</p> </li> <li> <p>Experience managing medium-sized commercial or account management teams</p> </li> <li> <p>Highly analytical, with proven P&L ownership or strong financial decision-making experience</p> </li> <li> <p>Solid project management skills, with a track record of delivering complex, cross-functional projects on time</p> </li> <li> <p>Mix of both strategy and execution experience</p> </li> <li> <p>Comfortable handling negotiations with business owners or C-suite operators</p> </li> <li> <p>Effective collaborator, able to influence internal stakeholders across functions and geographies, including global teams</p> </li> <li> <p>Relationship-building and communication skills whether face-to-face, through phone or email</p> </li> <li> <p>Adaptable and comfortable working in a rapidly changing environment; proactive and creative problem solver</p> </li> <li> <p>Entrepreneurial mindset with a passion for food and operations</p> </li> <li> <p>You will be in the field often, which will require travel (depending on the needs)</p> </li> <li> <p>Previous general management experience, or experience running your own business would be desirable</p> </li> <li> <p>Fluent in French and English is required</p> </li> </ul> <div style="min-height: 1.2em; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0;"> </div><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>Diversity, Equity and Inclusion</strong><br><br>At Deliveroo, we know that a great workplace reflects the world around us and that true diversity and inclusion make us stronger, more creative, and better at what we do. We’re committed to fostering an environment where everyone can do their best work and feel they belong.</p> <p>We believe in equality of opportunity and welcome candidates from all backgrounds regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, socio-economic background, religion, or belief.</p> <p>If you have a disability or long-term health condition and need support to apply for one of our roles, or require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, you’ll have the opportunity to let us know once you’ve submitted your application. We’ll share details on how to request support so we can ensure you have a fair and equitable experience.</p> <p>If you’re excited about making a real impact in a fast-moving marketplace and growing your career alongside ambitious, supportive teams, we’d love to hear from you!</p> <p><em data-renderer-mark="true"><br>Beware of recruitment scams: DASH Brands will never ask you to pay money or share sensitive financial information during hiring — learn more about DASH Brands' legitimate recruiting process at</em> <a class="_ymio1r31 _ypr0glyw _zcxs1o36 _mizu194a _1ah3dkaa _ra3xnqa1 _128mdkaa _1cvmnqa1 _4davt94y _4bfu18uv _1hms8stv _ajmmnqa1 _vchhusvi _kqswh2mm _2rkolb4i _ect4ttxp _syaz13af _1a3b18uv _4fpr8stv _5goinqa1 _f8pj13af _9oik18uv _1bnxglyw _jf4cnqa1 _30l313af _1nrm18uv _c2waglyw _1iohnqa1 _9h8h12zz _10531ra0 _1ien1ra0 _n0fx1ra0 _1vhv17z1" href="http://careersatdoordash.com/recruitment-scam-awareness" data-renderer-mark="true" data-is-router-link="false" data-testid="link-with-safety"><em data-renderer-mark="true">careersatdoordash.com/recruitment-scam-awareness</em></a><em data-renderer-mark="true">.</em></p></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

title: Head of Product Operations (Core)
description: Atolls is the world's largest community-driven shopping platform, active in 20+ markets. We help millions make smarter spending decisions across discovery, evaluation, and (re-)purchase by connecting people with the right brands and retailers. Our 1,000+ team across 10 countries builds products used every day at global scale, where you'll have real ownership and see your impact. Want to shape the destinations people rely on to shop with confidence? Keep reading. About This Role: We are looking for a Head of Product Operations (m/f/d) to join our Product team in Munich, Madrid, London or Paris with a hybrid work setup. In this role, you will lead and improve the operations that are directly linked to our products. Your work will directly impact our operational integrity notably by enhancing fraud detection, streamlining customer support processes, or managing cash projections. All of which are critical to delivering a trustworthy and seamless experience for our users. This dedicated product operations position was triggered by the launch of new offer types within our product, and the scope of the role will expand as we innovate with our product. Our Benefits: At Atolls, we believe in nurturing both your professional and personal growth. Here's what you can expect: A culture that values personal and professional development, with internal mobility opportunities. A supportive and open-minded team that embraces diverse perspectives and innovative ideas. 32 days of paid vacation plus your birthday off, giving you the time you need to recharge. A flexible hybrid working scheme to balance work and life. Access to a learning budget and internal training to help you grow in your role. Mental health coaching to support your well-being. Regular global and local get-togethers to celebrate successes and build connections. The possibility of taking a sabbatical after three years with the company. A cloud-based company setup, providing flexibility and collaboration opportunities no matter where you are. *These are global benefits that apply to all employees, with additional local perks based on your location. Responsibilities: In this role, you will : Drive end-to-end fraud management and detection strategies across all product types and payment flows . Streamline customer support workflows to improve resolution speed, operational efficiency, and user trust . Oversee the operational maintenance and reliability of coupon auto-apply and app-to-app features. Partner with Finance to forecast and manage cash allocations and liquidity across provider accounts . Work cross-functionally with Product and key teams to translate business needs into scalable operational solutions . Champion AI and automation initiatives to generate operational insights and drive continuous process improvements . Your Profile: We're looking for someone with 3 - 5 years of experience in strategy consulting, mergers and acquisitions, or operations in tech Strategic & Analytical Skills: Strong problem-solving and analytical capabilities, with the ability to break down complex business problems, identify opportunities, and develop scalable solutions. Operational Excellence: Proven ability to design, standardize, and optimize processes across complex or rapidly evolving products and organizations. Leadership & Collaboration: A strong leadership track record Mindset: A proactive and persistent mindset, adaptability in a dynamic environment, and a strong interest in leveraging AI and automation to improve operational efficiency and decision-making. Language requirements: Fluent in English and any other European languages is a plus. Our hiring process: TA Call : Meet one of our Talent Experts and get to know Atolls better. Technical Round : Focus on the technical aspects of the role (Through a Live Case) , and meet your potential manager. Final Round : Meet other Atollians 🏝️ It varies from 1 to 3 interviews *Some processes might slightly change according to needs Ready to apply? title: Head of AI - NLP Healthtech
description: Chez Lifen, nous pensons que les données médicales ont le potentiel de transformer le système de santé. Mais seulement si elles sont accessibles. Plus de données accessibles → moins de charge administrative, une meilleure coordination des soins et des découvertes scientifiques plus rapides. Depuis 2015, notre mission est de libérer ce potentiel. Nos solutions basées sur l'IA permettent aux professionnels de santé de partager les informations médicales sans effort et aux chercheurs d'accélérer les découvertes cliniques : avec un impact sur des millions de patients en France chaque jour. Alors que nous nous préparons à nous développer en Europe, 2 choses déterminent notre succès : nos équipes et notre mission. Aujourd'hui, plus de 150 personnes travaillent depuis nos bureaux et à distance pour libérer le potentiel des données de santé. Nous avons connecté 800 hôpitaux et 150 000 professionnels de santé, et nous ne faisons que commencer. Nous recherchons des personnes qui embrassent la complexité, veulent résoudre des problèmes difficiles et sont prêtes à construire le futur de la collaboration en santé. ⚡ Notre équipe AI La santé est un monde de données complexe, fragmenté et hétérogène. L’IA représente une formidable opportunité de dépasser cette limite structurelle, qui freine l’innovation, l’efficience opérationnelle des hôpitaux et les diagnostics médicaux. Avec les algorithmes d’IA de Lifen, la donnée médicale circule mieux, les soignants consacrent moins de temps aux tâches administratives, les parcours de soins gagnent en fluidité et la recherche clinique peut avancer plus vite. Notre équipe AI travaille à la fois sur des produits qui facilitent la prise en charge des patients au quotidien et sur des projets qui permettent de structurer des données de santé à grande échelle pour accélérer la recherche. Cela veut dire entraîner et faire évoluer nos propres modèles, notamment autour du traitement du langage et des grands modèles de langage, sur des données complexes, hétérogènes et sensibles. L’équipe réunit des machine learning engineers autonomes et exigeants. Elle a déjà construit des fondations solides. Le prochain cap est clair : donner une direction commune aux sujets liés aux soins et à la recherche, faire des choix ambitieux et transformer des avancées techniques en produits utiles. Nous cherchons un·e Head of AI capable de tenir ce rôle de chef d’orchestre : proche des enjeux techniques ; à l’aise avec le produit et le business ; capable de faire grandir une équipe. Le poste est basé à Paris, avec un fonctionnement hybride et une présence régulière attendue aux côtés de l’équipe. 🎯 Ce que tu feras chez nous Définir une stratégie AI lisible et ambitieuse : clarifier les priorités, construire une roadmap, arbitrer entre développement interne, partenariats et solutions existantes, puis donner un cap cohérent aux initiatives liées aux soins comme à la recherche clinique. Faire émerger des produits utiles à partir de sujets techniques complexes : par exemple, améliorer la structuration de documents médicaux pour réduire la charge des équipes de soins, ou rendre des données cliniques exploitables pour faire progresser la recherche. Orchestrer les priorités d’une équipe très transverse : les besoins viennent de plusieurs produits, avec des horizons et des contraintes différents. Tu apporteras le point de vue AI nécessaire pour choisir où investir, ce qui doit être amélioré et ce qui mérite d’être exploré. Faire grandir l’équipe et ses référents techniques : installer des objectifs clairs, du feedback utile et des espaces de décision réels, afin que chacun puisse prendre de l’ampleur sans perdre la qualité d’exécution qui fait la force de l’équipe. Garder l’équipe connectée aux évolutions du domaine : challenger les approches établies, lancer des POC, faire évoluer les pratiques et décider avec pragmatisme quand une nouvelle technologie mérite d’être adoptée. Porter la vision AI de Lifen auprès des équipes Produit, Tech et de la direction, mais aussi auprès de clients, partenaires et de l’écosystème. ⭐️ Ce que nous recherchons Must-have Tu as déjà défini et mis en mouvement une stratégie AI, machine learning dans une entreprise technologique, une scale-up ou un environnement comparable. Tu as au moins deux ans d’expérience de management direct d’une équipe Data, AI, Machine Learning ou Engineering. Tu as une expérience sur le traitement automatique du langage, les grands modèles de langage, l’extraction d’information ou la structuration de données homogènes qui te donne une une crédibilité technique solide auprès de l’équipe. Tu relies naturellement les choix technologiques aux usages, aux utilisateurs et aux résultats attendus pour le produit et l’entreprise. Tu sais embarquer des interlocuteurs techniques comme non techniques. Nice-to-have Tu as déjà travaillé dans la santé, les données cliniques, la medtech, la biotech ou un secteur soumis à de fortes contraintes réglementaires. Tu as collaboré avec des équipes de recherche appliquée, publié, contribué à des conférences ou porté des prises de parole sur des sujets AI. Tu as évolué dans une organisation où les données sont sensibles et où les enjeux de souveraineté, de confidentialité et de conformité font partie des décisions techniques. Soft skills Tu aimes les problèmes qui ne se résolvent pas avec une recette toute faite. Tu es à l’aise dans l’ambiguïté, curieux·se par nature et assez exigeant·e pour remettre en question les habitudes quand elles ne servent plus l’objectif. Tu sais manager des personnes senior : leur donner du cadre, de la reconnaissance et de l’autonomie. Nos valeurs Embrace Complexity : tu sais composer avec des données imparfaites, des contraintes réglementaires fortes et des arbitrages techniques qui changent vite. Bienveillance : tu crées un environnement de confiance, où l’exigence va de pair avec l’écoute, le feedback et le droit de questionner. Real Impact : tu gardes en tête ce que chaque décision peut changer pour les soignants, les chercheurs et, au bout de la chaîne, les patients. 👥 Process de recrutement Échange de préqualification avec Laura, Talent Acquisition Manager, 30 minutes . Nous faisons connaissance, revenons sur ton parcours, tes attentes et les grandes lignes du poste. C’est aussi le moment de répondre à tes premières questions sur Lifen, l’équipe et le contexte. Entretien avec Alexandre, CTO, environ 45 minutes Nous approfondissons ton expérience de management, ta capacité à construire une stratégie AI et ta manière de faire le lien entre technologie, produit et enjeux business. Étude de cas et échanges avec l’équipe AI, environ 1 h 30 En amont, nous te partagerons un cadre de réflexion. Tu présenteras ensuite ton approche à plusieurs membres de l’équipe, lors de deux échanges. L’objectif n’est pas de tester ta connaissance d’une stack précise, mais de comprendre comment tu structures une vision, priorises dans un contexte complexe et crées l’adhésion. Entretien final avec la direction Tech et Research, environ 1 h à 1 h 30 Nous échangeons sur ta lecture des enjeux de Lifen, ton ambition pour l’AI appliquée à la santé et ta capacité à porter cette vision au-delà de l’équipe. title: Principal Thermal-Mechanical Engineer-Munich, Germany
description: About Us We are building Physics AI for hardware design . Our software platform helps hardware designers and physics simulation engineers explore, analyze, and optimize hardware systems, leveraging cutting-edge AI to deliver ultrafast, accurate physics intelligence within the realities of engineering design workflows. Our first product bridges the gap between the accuracy & determinism of traditional simulation and the speed & scaling of AI, and is redefining how the world’s most advanced semiconductors are designed, verified, built, brought to market and integrated in complex systems. Role Overview As a pivotal leader within our European Forward Deployment team , you will drive the adoption of Vinci’s platform among the region's top engineering organizations. In this strategic role, you will build, mentor, and guide a high-performing team of thermal engineers dedicated to engaging prospective customers and demonstrating our software's transformative value. As trusted technical advisors , you and your team will use deep simulation expertise to help enterprise customers validate and optimize complex, real-world designs . Through these collaborative engagements, you will champion Vinci's value proposition by showing how our platform delivers systemic improvements in thermal performance, product reliability, and time-to-market. Leveraging strong fundamentals in continuum mechanics , you will guide analyses of complex physical phenomena, including linear, geometric and material nonlinearities, and contact interactions. Your team will evaluate critical factors such as warpage, stress evolution, thermal cycling, and reliability across advanced semiconductor devices, electronics packages, and wafer-scale systems. You will work closely with customer engineering teams to understand their technical challenges, provide expert guidance, and clearly articulate Vinci’s capabilities in solving real-world problems. You will also serve as a key feedback channel t o product and engineering teams, translating customer insights into actionable inputs that shape product direction and drive continuous improvement. This is a remote role, with close collaboration with Sales, Product, and Engineering in Palo Alto, CA, USA. The role includes moderate travel , primarily within continental Europe. Some infrequent intercontinental travel may be required for discussions and collaboration with the US team . Responsibilities Build, lead, and scale a high-performing team of thermo-mechanical engineers , setting the technical direction, hiring, mentoring team members, and driving field execution across Europe. Collaborate closely with the sales team to lead technical discussions, scope proof-of-concept (PoC) evaluations, and deliver compelling product demonstrations to prospective enterprise customers. Guide customer engineering teams through the evaluation phase by overseeing simulation setup, running complex test cases, and interpreting results to explicitly prove Vinci’s technical and business value. Own customer enablement through onboarding, deployment pipeline and account expansion , providing senior technical guidance, structured training sessions, and advanced troubleshooting. Provide product guidance and feedback, identify customer pain points and workflow bottlenecks , partnering directly with internal product and engineering teams to transform field feedback into critical new product features. Represent Vinci at major industry conferences and semiconductor events , engaging technically with key prospects and partners through technical presentations and live platform demonstrations. Maintain a strong understanding of competitive technologies, industry trends, and market positioning to communicate Vinci’s differentiators effectively. Qualifications (Minimum Qualifications) Education: Degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a closely related technical field. Technical depth: Expert-level mastery of commercial FEA software (e.g., Ansys Mechanical, Abaqus, or equivalent), with 15+ years of hands-on experience in thermo-mechanical simulations— either as a practitioner running simulations or as a technical account manager for commercial physics simulation software. Industry Domain: Deep familiarity with semiconductor electronics packaging, advanced packaging technologies (e.g., 2.5D/3D IC), or foundry ecosystems. Customer Engagement: Prior experience in dedicated customer-facing roles, with a strong ability to build trust and manage engineering client relationships. Automation & Scripting: Practical programming experience using Python or C++ to automate workflows or parse simulation data. Leadership Impact: Proven track record of prior managerial or technical leadership experience, with the ability to scale, mentor, and drive execution across engineering teams. Communication: Elite interpersonal and communication skills, with a proven ability to distill complex physics and simulation results into clear, high-impact narratives for both deep technical panels and business-oriented executives. Preferred (Desirable Differentiators) Multiphysics Breadth: Familiarity with thermal management and cooling solutions and/or Electrical Signal Integrity and Power Integrity (SI/PI) workflows. Commercial Track Record: Direct experience commercializing technical software—ideally electronic design automation (EDA) or CAE simulation tools—into major semiconductor and electronics enterprises. Go-To-Market Experience: Prior experience explicitly within technical pre-sales, application engineering (FAE), or strategic technical sales environments. Emerging Tech Adjacency: Ability to rapidly adopt and champion next-generation, physics-based workflows and AI-assisted design or simulation tools. Why Join Us Not just use AI; be part of a team actively redefining how next-generation silicon and hardware are architected. Work at the absolute convergence of state-of-the-art AI models, fundamental physics, and high-stakes enterprise engineering. Collaborate with world-class engineers and researchers in a fast-moving startup environment. Partner with Finance, Product, Engineering, Data, Operations and external payment partners to resolve scheme pricing, interchange and rule-related questions. You’ll work from our Amsterdam office three days a week. What we're looking for Essentials Experience in payments, acquiring, issuing, card networks, payment infrastructure or a related role, ideally within a global PSP, acquirer, scheme, issuer or fintech. Strong knowledge of card payment economics, particularly Visa and Mastercard interchange, scheme fees, transaction qualification and network rules. Experience translating complex payment rules, fee schedules or network requirements into system logic, configurations and controls. Experience working with payment-cost systems or controls, including interchange tables, scheme fee logic, BIN-based rules, transaction attributes or similar payment configurations. Strong analytical and quantitative capabilities, including experience working with transaction-level data, economic modelling and reconciliation of expected versus actual payment costs. Commercial judgment and the ability to connect payment mechanics to pricing, product decisions and margin optimisation. Exceptional attention to detail and ownership, with the discipline required to manage complex rules where small errors can create meaningful financial impact at scale. Strong cross-functional execution, with the ability to work effectively across Product, Engineering, Finance, Data, Operations and external payment partners. Preferred Experience partnering directly with Visa, Mastercard or other payment networks. Experience applying AI or advanced analytics to rule interpretation, anomaly detection or payment-cost optimisation. You'll thrive here if You own the outcome and you don't wait for permission to fix what's broken. You're comfortable with ambiguity. Give you a problem, not a prescription, and you'll run with it. You have experience at a fintech, payments company, or other highly regulated business. You connect dots across functions and hold the big picture without losing grip on the details. We’re looking for founder-like energy, high integrity and a passion for technology. title: Sales Manager

By automating the repetitive and structuring the complex, we help our partners unlock new opportunities for innovation and growth. You’ll be joining a collaborative team that values curiosity, ownership, and continuous learning. We work in an environment where ideas are heard, support is built-in, and outcomes matter. Everyone here has the chance to make a tangible impact on our products, our customers, and the industry. We've just raised $45M (£33M) in Series B funding from lead investor CommerzVentures, new investor Move Capital, as well as all existing shareholders. This investment round gives us the room to grow with confidence, continue to innovate, and ensure that Artificial remains the first choice for brokers and carriers seeking a smarter way to trade digitally. Join us, and take the chance to be a part of something that will change the landscape of insurance for generations. About the role As Sales Manager at Artificial, you'll own new business growth across specialty (re)insurance carriers, MGAs, and brokers in Germany and the broader DACH region. This is a full-cycle sales role: you'll build pipeline, run the sales process end to end, and close deals with senior stakeholders who are rethinking how their underwriting and claims operations run. Day to day, you'll: Prospect, qualify, and manage a pipeline of specialty (re)insurance carriers, MGAs, and brokers across Germany/DACH (and, over time, wider Europe) Build and manage relationships with senior stakeholders - Chief Underwriting Officers, Heads of Digital/IT, and other economic buyers Run the full sales cycle: discovery, demo (partnering with our Pre-Sales Engineer for technical validation), proposal, negotiation, and close Keep an accurate, disciplined pipeline in the CRM and forecast reliably against quarterly and annual targets Work closely with Marketing, Product, and Customer Success to share market feedback and shape go-to-market strategy for the region and beyond Represent Artificial at industry conferences and broker/carrier events across Europe About you A track record of success in B2B SaaS sales, ideally selling into insurance, financial services, or complex enterprise software Alternatively: UWing/Broking?? Experience selling technical or API-driven products to enterprise buyers, and comfort running a consultative, solution-based sales process Existing relationships or experience within the European (re)insurance market are a strong plus Fluent in German and English Based in Germany, remote, with willingness to travel within Europe as the role requires A consistent history of meeting or exceeding quota An entrepreneurial, self-directed approach — comfortable building process rather than just following it, in a fast-moving Series B environment We especially want to hear from you if you have Collaborative skills with an emphasis on product quality. Experience in insurtech, insurance or related industries. Strong problem-solving skills. Experience in a distributed work environment. We’re proud to be an equal opportunities employer and are committed to building a team that reflects the diverse communities around us. If there’s anything you need to make the hiring process more accessible, just let us know—we’re happy to make adjustments. You’re also welcome to share your preferred pronouns with us at any point. Think you don’t meet every requirement? Please apply anyway. We value potential as much as experience, and we know that raw talent counts. As part of our hiring process, we’ll carry out some background checks. These may include a criminal record check, reviewing your credit history, speaking with previous employers and confirming your academic qualifications. title: Senior Technical Sales Manager - AI-Driven Software Engineering
description: About CREATEQ CREATEQ is a Swiss software engineering company with more than 30 years of experience in delivering custom software solutions and modernizing complex legacy systems. We work with leading international companies across industries such as banking and fintech, insurance, aviation and transportation, telecommunications, and energy. We design, build, and run high-quality software solutions, combining strong engineering expertise, modern technologies, AI-enabled approaches, and proven delivery practices. Our teams work across Java, .NET, PHP, mobile, and web development, helping clients modernize their technology landscapes, improve their software capabilities, and build solutions that are reliable, scalable, and ready for the future. We are fully dedicated to long-term partnerships, working as one organization with our customers and taking ownership from the first idea through to reliable execution and smooth operation. With nearshore delivery centers across Europe, we bring together experienced engineering and delivery teams who combine technical excellence, business understanding, and a strong sense of ownership. People, engineering excellence, and strong client relationships are at the heart of what we do. The opportunity We are looking for an experienced, entrepreneurial Senior Technical Sales Manager to drive new business for CREATEQ with full revenue responsibility. In this role, you will win new clients, shape their entry into AI-driven software engineering, and turn it into long-term engineering engagements delivered by our teams. Many companies still develop software the traditional way, mostly on Java and .NET. They want to benefit from AI-driven development but lack the know-how, processes, and capacity to do so. This is where you come in: you understand the client's starting point, develop the right approach together with them – from assessment and proof of concept to dedicated nearshore teams – and close the deal. You will work closely with management, Business Development, and our engineering leads, and you will be the face of CREATEQ to CIOs, CTOs, and Heads of Engineering in Switzerland [and the DACH region]. What you'll do Build and close your own pipeline with mid-sized and large companies in Switzerland [and the DACH region]. Assess clients' development processes, technology stacks, and AI maturity, and run workshops with engineering teams, IT leadership, and executive management. Develop solution concepts and proposals – from assessment and proof of concept to dedicated nearshore engineering teams. Lead commercial negotiations through to contract signature. Grow existing client relationships and secure follow-on business. Work closely with our engineering leads on team set-up, project kick-off, and quality assurance. Track pipeline, order intake, and revenue against agreed targets and report on progress to management. What we're looking for This is a senior role with clear revenue responsibility. We are looking for someone who has successfully sold IT services before, brings a strong network in the Swiss market, and is equally credible in conversations with developers and with executive management. Requirements At least 8 years of experience selling IT services, software engineering, or nearshore/offshore capacity, including several years with personal revenue responsibility. A proven track record in acquiring new clients and closing multi-year service engagements. A strong network among CIOs, CTOs, and Heads of Engineering in the Swiss market. A technical background (computer science, business informatics, or equivalent practical experience) with a solid understanding of Java and/or .NET environments and modern engineering practices (CI/CD, automated testing, DevOps). A solid understanding of AI-driven software development (AI coding assistants, agentic development tools) and a realistic view of its benefits and limitations. Swiss or EU citizenship, or a valid Swiss work permit. Benefits A key role with direct impact on CREATEQ's growth. An offering that is high on clients' agendas: AI-driven software engineering, delivered by experienced engineering teams. A compensation package with a fixed salary and a performance-based component. description: <p><strong>The role of a Telecommunications Field Engineer at Canonical</strong></p> <p>The telco industry is moving to software-defined services. Canonical Ubuntu is a key platform for telco innovation, and we are growing our team of specialists who work in the industry to accelerate the change.</p> <p>Canonical enables operators and communications service providers to embrace this new world, with a focus on platforms such as Ubuntu, OpenStack, and Kubernetes, and reusable, high quality automation for operations at scale.</p> <p>As part of the Canonical Field Engineering organization, you will lead customers through the design and delivery of OpenStack, Kubernetes, and software-defined networking solutions. Your passion for open-source technologies will enable customers to understand and operate advanced infrastructure substrates to meet the demands of 5G, sovereign AI, and beyond.</p> telco</li> <li style="font-weight: 400;">Architect and implement advanced, resilient Service Provider Cloud and Application solutions</li> <li style="font-weight: 400;">Design and deliver software cases</li> <li style="font-weight: 400;">Learn from customer engagements and drive meaningful product improvements</li> <li style="font-weight: 400;">Shape our roadmap to accelerate our growth in the telco market</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>What we are looking for in you</strong></p> <ul> <li>A thorough technical understanding of the telco NFVi (VIM), NFVO, VNFM and MEC space and key telco the following domains</strong>: Mobile Packet Core (4G/5G), Private Network, Radio Access Network (RAN), Voice, IP Backbone, VAS or OSS/BSS</li> <li>Working knowledge of Linux, Networking, OpenStack and Kubernetes</li> <li>Python software development experience for automation</li> <li>Ability to lead complex projects from start to finish</li> <li>A collaborative, customer-centric mindset with a strong focus on customer success</li> <li>Able to travel up to 25% of the time based on business requirements for events, customer meetings, project delivery</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>Additional optimization, predictive maintenance, unified communication, and customer experience improvement</li> <li style="font-weight: 400;">Exposure to frameworks such as 3GPP, TM Forum ODA, eTOM, ETSI NFV, ONAP, O-RAN, or similar is a plus</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>What we offer you</strong></p> <p>Your base pay will depend on various factors including your geographical location, level of experience, knowledge and skills. In addition to the benefits above, certain roles are also eligible for additional benefits and rewards including annual bonuses and sales incentives based on revenue or utilisation. Our compensation philosophy is to ensure equity right across our global workforce.</p> <p>In addition to a competitive base pay, we provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. Please note that additional benefits may apply depending on the work location and, for more information on these, you can ask in the later stages of the recruitment process.</p> <ul> <li style="font-weight: 400;">Fully remote working environment - we’ve been working remotely since 2004!</li> <li style="font-weight: 400;">Personal learning and development budget of 2,000USD per annum</li> <li style="font-weight: 400;">Annual compensation review</li> <li style="font-weight: 400;">Recognition rewards</li> <li style="font-weight: 400;">40 days annual leave per annum, including public holidays and our All Company holiday periods</li> <li style="font-weight: 400;">Parental Leave</li> <li style="font-weight: 400;">Employee Assistance Programme</li> <li style="font-weight: 400;">Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues at ‘sprints’</li> <li style="font-weight: 400;">Priority Pass for travel and travel upgrades for long haul company events</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>About Canonical</strong></p> <p>Canonical is a pioneering tech firm that is at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world on a daily basis. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do.</p> <p>Canonical has been a remote-first company since its inception in 2004.​ Work at Canonical is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game. We are looking for ambitious, internationally mobile early-career talents with a global mindset who are excited about technology but see their future in business and leadership rather than in a purely technical software career.<br><br>The Software & Digital Business Track of Hilti's Outperformer Program is a two-year accelerated development program that prepares you for a commercial, international leadership career in our software and digital businesses. You will learn how technology becomes customer value, how software businesses grow, how products are brought to market, and how commercial decisions are made. This is not a rotation program where you shadow senior leaders. From day one, you carry real responsibility.</p> <h2>What You'll do</h2> <p>The Software Track is designed to build the next generation of software business leaders at Hilti – Business Owners, Business Directors, Segment Managers and ultimately Senior Management Team members. If you want a structured path to running a business, this program is built for that outcome.<br><br>The program places you inside one of two business units:<br><br>Construction Software: Home to Fieldwire (Field Software for project and workforce management), ON!Track (asset management), and 4PS (construction business management). your degree is likely to be in construction management, civil engineering, or mechanical engineering with a focus on construction, Computer Science, or also Business study programs with an affinity for Software and construction. What matters more than your degree subject is the combination of traits below:</p> <ul> <li>Global mobility - you are willing and able to relocate internationally, multiple times. A global thinker who is keen for diverse cultural experiences.</li> <li>Digital and AI orientation - you think natively in digital workflows, comfortable with software tools, and know the power and potential of AI.</li> <li>Language - you are fluent in English and/or German, Dutch, French, Spanish or Italian. </li> <li>Commercial instinct - you are drawn to how businesses grow, how customers make decisions, and how products create.</li> <li>Low ego, high drive - you take the work seriously and yourself lightly. You seek feedback, move fast, and are energised by ambiguity rather than unsettled by it.</li> <li>You are at the start of your career and have maximum three years of junior work experience.</li> </ul> <h2>What’s In It for You</h2> <p>​​Show us what you can do, and in return, we promise you the experience of a lifetime. We offer you a transformative journey filled with learning, growth, and invaluable experiences that will shape your perspective and personal and professional development. On top of that, you’ll also take part in some fascinating courses and events:</p> <ul> <li>Introductory Global Summit: Experience 4 days at our global headquarters in Liechtenstein, featuring the presence of our Executive Board and Global Senior Leadership. The summit offers a comprehensive overview of our business, while fostering soft skill development and meaningful collaboration with fellow program participants.</li> <li>Social Project Summit: 7 days dedicated to building a better future, with contribution to a hands-on, high-impact community project. This experience offers the chance to immerse yourself in a different culture while actively improving living conditions for those in need.</li> <li>Leadership Summit: An enriching learning journey in partnership with a renowned business school, featuring online modules and collaborative projects with fellow program participants. The experience concludes with a 5-day on-campus summit to deepen insights and to foster business and leadership skills.</li> </ul> <h2>Why Hilti</h2> <p>Hilti is a global leader in construction innovation, with more than 34,000 team members across 120 countries. Guided by our purpose, Making Construction Better, we’re driven to keep learning, growing, and finding new ways to make a lasting impact. Here, you’ll be empowered to use your strengths, work with a global and inclusive team, and take on meaningful challenges. At Hilti, you’ll have the chance to make your ideas, achievements, and growth real through purpose, passion, and teamwork.<br><br>Learn more about our recruitment process: https://careers.hilti.group/en/candidate-interview-preparation/</p> <h2>Commitment to Inclusion</h2> <p>​​At Hilti, inclusion is a key focus in how we work, lead, and grow together. We are committed to embracing diversity of thought and creating an environment that is inclusive of everyone, everywhere. We continuously strive to ensure every voice is valued and every team member feels empowered to contribute. By building on this foundation, we strengthen our teams, our innovation, and our impact, making construction better together.<br><br>​Exciting software journey: You will dive into the fast-paced world of our construction software business, gaining exposure to innovative digital solutions that are transforming one of the world's largest industries.<br>​<br>​Global cross-team collaboration: You will work with colleagues worldwide and get guidance from a dedicated mentor as you grow in your career.<br><br>​We hire for a career, not for a position. description: About the role We are looking for an SAP Integration Architect to own how Finto connects to SAP. title: Data Engineer
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><p><strong>Location: Austin </strong>(Hybrid)</p> <h3><strong>About the team</strong></h3> <p>The Data Intelligence & Analytics organization builds the core data platform and internal products that power decision-making across the company. We design and operate large-scale data systems, own the company’s data lake, ingestion infrastructure, and platform tooling, and develop end-to-end applications that transform complex datasets into fast, reliable, business-critical products used daily by go-to-market, product, and engineering teams. Our work sits at the intersection of data platforms, distributed systems, and product development, giving engineers the opportunity to own meaningful problems across the stack, build specialized data solutions for predictive modeling and machine learning applications, and construct systems that truly run the business.</p> <h3><strong>About the role</strong></h3> <p>We are looking for an experienced Data Engineer to join our Austin team and help scale the development of our internal data products. In this role, you will build data-driven applications that empower teams across the company, including go-to-market, engineering, and product. Because the products we build are initiated and owned by the team, you will be involved end-to-end — from shaping requirements and designing features to implementation and long-term ownership.</p> <p>You will work on building scalable, reliable systems that solve critical business problems, partnering closely with full-stack engineers to develop new features and operate the data pipelines and services behind our applications. Our stack spans multiple languages and technologies, including Go, Scala, and ClickHouse, and continues to evolve. Many of our products also incorporate strong AI components, giving you opportunities to build sophisticated, AI-ready data layers and work with modern AI infrastructure and tools such as vector databases, MCP-based services, and Workers AI.</p> <h3><strong>What you'll do</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Design and implement core components of our data pipelines and services in Go and Scala, with a As well as skills and experience in Treasury and Capital Management, the ability to adapt, be creative and work in a fast paced environment with wider Group colleagues will be essential talents as the business grows.</p> <p>As part of a new and growing team, the Treasury Capital Manager will be responsible for ensuring that Monzo effectively manages its capital and ensuring compliance with regulatory requirements in Europe. Please submit your application as soon as possible to make sure you don’t miss out. </p> <p>#LI-ÉS1</p><div class="content-conclusion"><hr> <p><strong>Equal opportunities for everyone</strong></p> <p>Diversity and inclusion are a priority for us and we’re making sure we have lots of support for all of our people to grow at Monzo. title: Data Center Architect
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><h3><strong>Location: Austin, San Francisco or New York</strong></h3> <h3>About the role</h3> <p>Cloudflare is hiring a Data Center Architect to define and deliver the physical infrastructure behind high-density compute and GPU deployments across our global network. You'll own 3 connected domains: the liquid cooling chain, the low-voltage connectivity layer, and the MV/LV electrical architecture that powers both.</p> <p>This is a senior individual-contributor role spanning architecture, detailed design, technical qualification, design governance, commissioning, and operational readiness. You're Cloudflare's owner-side technical lead in these domains: the person who connects what our hardware needs with what colocation providers, equipment manufacturers, and delivery partners can actually build.</p> <p>Scope runs from a single rack in commercial colocation to multi-megawatt compute deployments.
