title: Principal Product Manager, Acute Care CT
description: The Principal Product Manager, Acute Care CT owns the DeepHealth Acute Care CT Suite end to end, with primary accountability for what to build and shared accountability for getting it shipped. DeepHealth is building the Acute Care CT Suite from the ground up to cover detection, care coordination, and reporting for emergency CT, starting with head CT and expanding to chest and abdomen, where minutes saved in stroke, bleeds, and trauma directly affect patient outcomes. The Principal Product Manager, Acute Care CT shapes the suite from day one: owning the roadmap, translating clinical needs into ML and product work, and driving cross-functional delivery on a subset of the suite from data through customer activation. The role does not write code or own technical software design. Essential Duties and Responsibilities Product Strategy and Roadmap Own the Acute Care CT Suite roadmap and define what to build, defer, or stop based on evidence. Define suite scope across pathology detection modules, software capabilities such as alerting and care coordination, and comprehensive draft reporting. Work with emergency radiologists and neuro/stroke teams to distinguish stated requests from real clinical needs, including time-to-treatment, triage, missed findings, and care coordination. Translate clinical problems into ML work and set model metrics that reflect clinical value, including sensitivity versus false-positive burden. Track the acute care market (including Aidoc, Viz.ai , RapidAI, Nicolab, and peers) and position products with Sales and Marketing. Delivery and Cross-Functional Execution Own delivery end to end on a subset of the Suite, from data to customer activation, including planning, coordination across data, ML, software, QARA, and Support, tracking, and escalation. Run squads for new devices (typically 3 to 9 months), such as ASPECTS detection. Coordinate with QARA on the regulatory impact of each release, including EU MDR and FDA 510(k). Cut scope or move dates when needed, and escalate further as required. Partner with engineering and technical leads without writing code or carrying technical software design. PLEASE NOTE: This is not an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities and requirements of the position described above. Other functions may be assigned and management retains the right to add or change duties at any time. Minimum Qualifications, Education and Experience Bachelor's degree in a technical, scientific, clinical, business, or related field, or equivalent experience (required). 8+ years in product or delivery for medical devices or medical imaging software, with products shipped end to end (required). Knowledge of radiology and emergency department workflows (required). Knowledge of machine learning in Clinical AI (required). Experience running cross-functional delivery across data, ML, software, and QA/RA to fixed dates (required). Fluent English (required). Hands-on use of AI tools (Claude Code, ChatGPT, or similar) in current work (required). Preferred: French language skills. Preferred: Acute care, stroke, or emergency imaging background. Preferred: Experience with SaMD and regulated environments (EU MDR, FDA 510(k)). Quality Standards Communicates, cooperates, and consistently functions professionally and harmoniously with all levels of supervision, co-workers, visitors, and vendors. Demonstrates initiative, personal awareness, professionalism and integrity, and exercises confidentiality in all areas of performance. Follows all local, regional and country laws concerning employment. Follows all DeepHealth policies and procedures. Follows data privacy, compliance, safety and confidentiality standards at all times. Practices universal safety precautions. Promotes good public relations on the phone and in person. Adapts and is willing to learn new tasks, methods, and systems. Reports to work regularly as scheduled; consistently punctual with respect to working hours, meal and rest breaks, and maintains satisfactory personal attendance in accordance with DeepHealth guidelines. Completes job responsibilities in a quality and timely manner. Travel This position requires domestic / international travel up to 10%. Find more English Speaking Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

title: Founding Customer Value Manager (m/w/d)
description: Intro Die Bauindustrie verliert jährlich 1,6 Billionen USD durch Ineffizienzen. Einer der Hauptgründe: Dieselben Fehler wiederholen sich immer wieder , weil entscheidende Informationen noch immer in Papierdokumenten und unstrukturierten Dateien verborgen sind. Genau hier setzt alago an. Wir sind ein Team von 15 Personen und entwickeln KI-gestütztes Projektmanagement für die Baubranche . Bereits heute vertrauen uns mehr als 40 Kunden . Unsere Vision ist es, Risiken in Bauprojekten frühzeitig sichtbar zu machen – damit Großprojekte nicht mehr Jahrzehnte dauern oder scheitern. Wir haben letztes Jahr eine Pre-Seed-Finanzierung von über 1 Mio. € von führenden VCs der Baubranche sowie einem der größten Projektentwickler Deutschlands abgeschlossen. 75 % der Infrastruktur, die im Jahr 2050 existieren wird, ist heute noch nicht gebaut. Lasst uns sie von Anfang an richtig bauen. Tasks Customer Experience ist bei uns kein Support-Ticket-Job. Du besitzt den kompletten Kundenlebenszyklus nach dem Vertragsabschluss — kommerziell, operativ und im Produkt . Damit sitzt du an der Stelle im Unternehmen, an der beide Seiten gleichzeitig sichtbar sind : Du weißt, was Kunden wirklich brauchen und wofür sie zahlen — und du weißt, was das Produkt kann und was es kosten würde, es zu können. Genau daraus entstehen die besten Produktentscheidungen und die besten Deals. Du bist die erste Person in dieser Rolle und baust den Bereich so, wie er in zwei Jahren für dreißig Leute funktionieren muss. 💰 Revenue Ownership Du besitzt einen Kundenstamm mit klarer Umsatzverantwortung: Retention, Expansion, Renewals. Du erkennst, wo ein Kunde mehr Wert ziehen könnte, und machst den Upsell selbst – weitere Nutzer, weitere Projekte, weitere Produkte. Du verhandelst Verlängerungen und Erweiterungen und führst sie bis zur Unterschrift. 🚀 Value Creation über den gesamten Kundenlebenszyklus Du übernimmst den Kunden ab dem ersten Onboarding-Kontakt : Setup, Projektdaten, Konfiguration, Schulung der Teams. Du führst den Rollout vom Pilotprojekt in die Fläche – und sorgst dafür, dass die Nutzung nicht nach vier Wochen einschläft. Du machst Value Reviews mit messbaren Zahlen statt Höflichkeitsterminen und machst sichtbar, was alago dem Kunden konkret gebracht hat. 🛟 Customer Support Du verantwortest unseren Support: Anfragen beantworten, priorisieren, Muster erkennen. Du debuggst Customer Flows in der Software selbst – du reichst ein Problem nicht weiter, du reproduzierst es, grenzt es ein und beschreibst es so, dass es lösbar ist. Du baust Doku, Self-Service und KI-gestützte Antworten so auf, dass dieselbe Frage nicht zehnmal auf deinem Tisch landet. ⚙️ Product Engine – du baust mit Du löst selbst, was sich ohne Engineering lösen lässt : Konfiguration, Datenbereinigung, kleine Automatisierungen und Skripte – mit KI-Tools wie Claude Code oder n8n. Was Code im Kernprodukt braucht, übergibst du so präzise an unser Engineering-Team, dass es schnell gelöst ist. Du verantwortest Integrationen und Datenimporte : Du scopst die Anbindung an Kundensysteme, prüfst, was machbar ist, und bringst Migrationen gemeinsam mit unserem Engineering-Team ins Ziel – damit ein Onboarding Stunden statt Tage dauert. Du bist die Stimme des Kunden im Produktprozess : Du übersetzt, was Nutzer, Projektleitungen, IT und QM wirklich brauchen, in klare, priorisierte Produkt-Inputs – mit Belegen, nicht mit Bauchgefühl – und testest neue Releases aus Kundensicht, bevor sie live gehen. 🏗️ Den Bereich aufbauen Du schreibst die Playbooks für Onboarding, Rollout, Support und Upsell – und automatisierst sie, wo immer es geht. Du entwickelst und betreibst die KI-Agents und Automatisierungen , die Customer Experience bei uns skalierbar machen, statt den Bereich mit Köpfen zu vergrößern. Requirements Muss-Kriterien Du hattest bereits direkten Kundenkontakt in einer verantwortlichen Rolle – du hast Kunden selbst geführt, nicht nur zugearbeitet Du hast Umsatzverantwortung getragen oder Umsatz ausgebaut (Renewals, Upsells, Expansion, Abschlüsse) und kannst das mit Zahlen belegen Deutsch auf C2-Niveau und sicheres Englisch Standort München oder Bereitschaft, dauerhaft von hier aus zu arbeiten Pluspunkte Du hast selbst schon aktiv entwickelt – eigene Projekte, Skripte, Integrationen, ein Side Project, das tatsächlich läuft Du hast schon mit Claude Code (oder vergleichbaren Coding-Agents) echte Sachen gebaut und weißt, wie weit man damit ohne Engineering-Team kommt Du kennst Teile unseres Stacks ( TypeScript, React, Supabase ) schon aus eigenen Projekten Du hast schon in der Baubranche gearbeitet oder hast einen engen Bezug zu ihr Du hast bereits in einem schnell wachsenden Early-Stage-Startup gearbeitet und weißt, wie es sich anfühlt, wenn es noch kein Playbook gibt Du hast schon einmal einen Bereich oder Prozess von null aufgebaut Wie du arbeitest AI-native: Du nutzt KI reflexhaft, nicht gelegentlich. Du hast eigene Agents, Automatisierungen oder Tools gebaut (n8n, Claude Code, Lovable o. Ä.), testest neue Modelle sofort und weißt, was taugt. Systems Thinker: Du siehst das System hinter dem einzelnen Kunden. Beim zweiten Mal baust du den Prozess, der das manuelle Lösen überflüssig macht – und dokumentierst ihn für die nächste Person. Technische Tiefe: Du prüfst Daten, verfolgst Flows, liest Logs und grenzt Probleme sauber ein – und behebst sie, wo es geht, selbst mit KI-Tools . Du bist in der Software zu Hause, nicht nur in der Präsentation darüber. Umsetzung & Ownership: Du bringst Dinge zu Ende, ohne dass jemand nachfassen muss. Wenn du dich nicht in jedem Punkt wiederfindest, aber überzeugt bist, dass du zu alago passt, bewirb dich trotzdem. Entscheidend sind dein Potenzial und deine Lernkurve. Warum alago? Du wirst einer der tragenden Pfeiler dieser Firma Du bist die erste Person für Customer Experience und bestimmst Prozesse, Tools, Standards und Kennzahlen. Was du baust, bleibt. Customer Experience ist einer von sechs, sieben Bereichen, die alago tragen – und du besitzt ihn. Du sitzt am Tisch, wenn die Entscheidungen fallen, die die Firma prägen. Der Weg führt zum Head of Customer Experience mit eigenem Team. Du entwickelst dich in eines der gefragtesten Profile überhaupt KI-Unternehmen suchen händeringend Leute, die Kunde und Produkt zugleich beherrschen – bei Palantir heißt das Forward Deployed Engineer . Du lernst, Vertrauen aufzubauen, schwierige Gespräche zu führen und Kunden über Monate zu messbarem Wert zu begleiten . Ab Tag eins Zugriff auf unsere Codebasis , Pairing mit dem Engineering-Team und echte Code-Reviews. Wer beides kann, hat danach jede Tür offen. Du baust deine eigene Marke – und vervielfachst deinen Marktwert Du begleitest unser Wachstum von 16 auf 30 Mitarbeitende in zwei Jahren . Du knackst den Code, wie Onboarding, Rollout, Support und Upsell vorhersehbar und wiederholbar werden – und nimmst dieses Playbook überallhin mit. Du beschleunigst deine Entwicklung Ob eigene Gründung oder Head of Customer Experience : Halbjährliche Performance-Reviews, konkrete Entwicklungsschritte alle ~9 Monate . Wöchentliche Trainings, erfahrene Coaches und Mentor:innen und eine umfangreiche Bibliothek. Arbeite direkt mit den Foundern Tag für Tag mit Janick (Go-to-Market & Strategy) und Ann-Christin (Product & Domain) . Frühe Phase heißt: viel Eigenverantwortung, kurze Feedback-Zyklen und die Freiheit, in die Rolle zu wachsen, die zu deinen Stärken passt. Zusätzlich Wellpass, zweimal pro Woche Team-Dinner und Unterstützung beim Relocation-Prozess. Arbeitsplatz im WERK1 , einem der aktivsten Startup-Hubs Münchens. Bewerbungsprozess Bewerbung Erstgespräch (30 Minuten) Deep-Dive mit einem Founder (40 Minuten) Case Study (halber Tag vor Ort in München) – z. B. ein hängendes Rollout retten, einen Upsell-Case rechnen oder einen Customer Flow im Produkt debuggen Entscheidung – Rückmeldung innerhalb von 24 Stunden . Wenn es für beide Seiten passt – freuen wir uns sehr auf die Zusammenarbeit! 🎉 Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Controller (w/m/d)

title: Projektmanager (m/w/d) MarTech – Content Supply Chain & Automatisierung | Vollzeit | Hybrid
description: DIU ist IT-Dienstleister für MarTech-Lösungen (Marketing Technology: Technologien, mit denen Marketing- und Content-Prozesse geplant, automatisiert und ausgespielt werden) sowie AI & Cloud Services mit einer über 25-jährigen Tradition. Erfahrung mit KI-gestützter Entwicklung (z. B. Claude Code, MCP, LLM-APIs) oder große Lust, dich darin schnell einzuarbeiten. Verständnis für Content-Prozesse im Marketing sowie für IT-Architekturen, Datenflüsse und Schnittstellen, um mit Entwicklung und Kunden auf Augenhöhe zu sprechen. Erfahrung in Projekten im Konzernumfeld und Sicherheit im Umgang mit vielen Beteiligten. Verhandlungssichere Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift. title: Werkstudent Content Creation & Social Media (m/w/d) - 20h/Woche, bis zu 50% Home Office
description: Über uns book-n-drive ist einer der führenden regionalen Carsharing-Anbieter. Wir ermöglichen Menschen, flexibel auf ein Auto zuzugreifen, ohne selbst eines besitzen zu müssen. Wir möchten zeigen, wie ein Alltag ohne eigenes Auto funktionieren kann – mit Fahrrad, Bus und Bahn und einem passenden Auto, wenn man es braucht. Dafür bauen wir unsere Marketingaktivitäten weiter aus und suchen Unterstützung bei der Erstellung und Veröffentlichung unserer Inhalte. Du hast Spaß daran, Inhalte selbst zu produzieren – nicht nur daran, Konzepte zu entwickeln. Du kannst mit Smartphone oder Kamera gute Fotos und Videos erstellen und diese bearbeiten. Du hast Erfahrung mit gängigen Content-Tools, beispielsweise Canva, CapCut, Adobe Creative Cloud oder vergleichbaren Anwendungen. Du kennst dich mit Instagram und aktuellen Social-Media-Formaten aus. Du hast bereits KI-Tools ausprobiert und möchtest sie kreativ, verantwortungsvoll und produktiv einsetzen. Du kannst verständlich und ansprechend auf Deutsch und Englisch schreiben. Du arbeitest selbstständig, zuverlässig und strukturiert. Du interessierst dich für nachhaltige Mobilität und findest die Idee gut, dass nicht jeder Mensch ein eigenes Auto braucht. Die Möglichkeit, praktische Erfahrung in Contentproduktion, Social Media und KI- gestütztem Marketing zu sammeln. Eine enge Zusammenarbeit mit unserem Growth Marketing & Content Lead. Kurze Entscheidungswege und die Möglichkeit, Ergebnisse deiner Arbeit direkt zu sehen. Eine strukturierte Einarbeitung vor Ort und perspektivisch teilweise mobiles Arbeiten. Ein Unternehmen, das an einer nachhaltigen Alternative zum eigenen Auto arbeitet. Unser Mitarbeiter-Benefit-Programm mit Wellpass, Mitarbeiter-Rabatt und kostenlosen Kaffee und Getränken am Arbeitsplatz. Anschließend übernimmst du zunehmend eigenständig die Produktion und Aufbereitung von Inhalten. Gemeinsam mit unserem Growth Marketing & Content Lead entwickelst du einen regelmäßigen Veröffentlichungsrhythmus und verbesserst die Produktionsabläufe. Interesse? title: Working Student B2G: Public Sector & Research Funding (f/m/d)
description: 01 · Why this role exists This is not your typical student job. B2G sounds boring, until you realise it's money from the state and you help win it. You'll work directly with our B2G Manager and the founders on funding that flows straight into RIZM's cash flow, and you'll see from the inside how the public sector decides and buys. Something most students never get to see. RIZM builds RIZMO, an AI agent that makes energy decisions for industrial companies. Our next lever is the public sector: municipalities, utilities and economic development agencies have to implement heat plans, keep business parks competitive and relieve the grid. We're building B2G as a new business line at RIZM, and we're looking for a working student to help build it from day one. 02 · What you'll do Public funding as a growth channel: Help build the pipeline for Forschungszulage (Germany's R&D tax allowance), EU grants, ERDF (EFRE) and other programmes: scout new calls, prepare applications and keep track of our running programmes. Connect research: Support our research collaboration with Stanford and help turn it into funded projects. Build the machine, AI-first: Set up trackers, automations and AI workflows so our funding pipeline runs with as little manual work as possible. Your ideas count here. Support ReNET-EV: Help with our part of the ERDF project ReNET-EV (grid-friendly energy supply for business parks in the Münster/NRW region): documentation, reporting and the rollout to more municipalities. Get to know municipalities: Research how cities, municipal utilities and economic development agencies decide and buy, as groundwork for our first public-sector customers. Build the data foundation: Collect public and municipal data that makes our models more precise at regional level. 03 · What you bring Studies: You're enrolled in a Bachelor's or Master's programme, e.g. public administration, political science, economics, business, energy, engineering or something similar. Curiosity: The energy transition, municipal heat planning or how public funding works interest you. No prior experience needed. Writing: You write clearly and in a structured way. AI-native: You're curious about AI and enjoy building your own tools and workflows. Ownership: You work independently and like to take responsibility. Languages: Fluent German and good English. 04 · Why you should apply now B2G is a new business line at RIZM. Join now and help shape it from the start. Small team: You'll work actively and day to day with our full-time B2G Manager, not on the sidelines. Real responsibility: In a business line we're building from scratch. Founders: You work directly with them. Insight: Into public funding, research projects and municipal decision-making. Real customers: Our product already runs at industrial customers like BMW and BSH. Flexible hours: They fit around your studies. 05 · One click, then what? For now it's just one small step: press Apply. Here is a sneak peek at what comes next. Your application: Send us your CV and, instead of a classic cover letter, a few honest sentences on these two questions. A mayor gives you 2 minutes. Which energy problem in their city would you tell them RIZM can help with? Research funding sounds dusty to most students, but we think it's not :) How would you convince your friends it's actually cool, in the language you'd really use with them? After that: Intro call: 15 minutes on video to get to know each other. Meet the team: At our office, with the team and one of our founders. Then we decide together. Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Head of SEO & AI Search (all genders)
description: Über uns Wir begeistern und inspirieren Millionen von Menschen! Als innovativer Hybrid aus Social Media Publisher und Social Media Agentur vereint das VS Mediahouse einzigartige Expertise in den Bereichen Content-Kreation, Markenaufbau und Performance-Marketing. Mit einem Team von über 50 Experten in Social Media, Design und Videoproduktion betreiben wir die beliebtesten Social-Media-Marken Deutschlands auf Facebook, Instagram und TikTok. Zu unseren Erfolgsmarken zählen unter anderem VS, Lieblingskollegen und Lieblingsmensch®. Unser tiefes Verständnis für die Dynamik von Social Media und unser Publishing-Know-how ermöglichen es uns, Marken wie Samsung, Schwartau, Bayer und Lexware im Bereich Social Media nachhaltig erfolgreich zu machen. Wir schaffen Verbindungen, erzählen Geschichten und setzen Trends – für echte Wirkung und messbaren Erfolg. Deine Mission Du beherrschst klassisches SEO in der Tiefe, mit mehrjähriger Senior-Erfahrung. Gleichzeitig ist dir klar: Kaum noch jemand sucht heute komplett ohne KI, sei es über ChatGPT, Gemini oder AI Overviews. Diesen Wandel willst du nicht nur beobachten, sondern aktiv gestalten. Klar ist dabei: Ohne solides SEO-Fundament funktioniert auch die beste GEO-Strategie nicht, deshalb bringst du beides mit. Als Head of SEO & AI Search verantwortest du unseren SEO-Bereich strategisch, operativ und wirtschaftlich. Im Zentrum deiner Rolle stehen von Beginn an unsere größten und strategisch wichtigsten Bestandskunden: Hier baust du die SEO- und AI-Search-Strategie neu und mit voller Verantwortung auf Senior-Ebene auf, im direkten Austausch mit der Geschäftsführung des Kunden. Perspektivisch entwickelst du von dort aus den SEO-Bereich für weitere Kunden im Haus. KI spielt dabei eine doppelte Rolle: erstens als Zielsystem, du machst Kunden auch in KI-gestützten Suchsystemen sichtbar. title: Senior Customer Reliability Engineer
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><h2>Available Locations</h2> <ul> <li>Austin, US</li> <li>San Francisco, CA </li> </ul> <h2>About the Role</h2> <p>Cloudflare built its reputation helping build a better Internet, defending millions of sites, giving away SSL and DDoS mitigation when the industry charged premium prices. In an acceleratingly dangerous world, the scope of that mission has changed. We are becoming something more: critical infrastructure. Banks run their payment rails on us. Governments run public services on us. Media companies depend on us during live events. Health systems depend on us to provide care. Reliability for these customers is no longer a feature of our product. It is a mission.</p> <p>Serving that customer base demands a different operating model. Traditional support organizations route tickets. Traditional engineering organizations ship features. Neither alone is enough when the stakes are this high. We are pivoting to something different: a customer-facing engineering organization, directly engaged with our customers at scale. This is work a central dev team cannot do from the inside of the network.</p> <p>The Customer Reliability Engineering function is the spine of that pivot. CRE is SRE applied outward, the same engineering discipline, applied to the reliability of the systems our customers run on Cloudflare. You are the engineer who owns the problems that matter most to the customers who matter most, and you contribute directly to our products and tooling, in partnership with Product Engineering, to hold that standard across the entire customer base.</p> <p>CRE is a rapid response team and a proactive engineering team. You fix things at the edge as they come up, and you help build the product capabilities that identify customer issues before they become a crisis. Both modes are equally core.</p> <p><strong>Rapid response.</strong> When a customer issue surfaces that is high-severity, cross-layer and complex, you are the engineer who answers. You reproduce the defect, isolate the root cause across Cloudflare's infrastructure and the customer's stack, drive the fix with Product Engineering, and confirm resolution. You hold on-call for high-severity incidents as part of a global shift rotation.</p> <p><strong>Proactive engineering.</strong> When no fire is burning, you work with Product Engineering and our platform teams to build the capabilities that make the next fire cheaper or unnecessary: telemetry pipelines that correlate signals across the customer base, detectors that fire before a human notices, diagnostic tooling that scales across hundreds of customers, automation that reduces toil for Customer Support. Every incident you carry generates engineering output that reduces the cost of recurrence. The work compounds.</p> <p>Cloudflare is building CRE as an AI-native function. You will work with and help build agents and tooling that pre-diagnose incidents, surface relevant logs and configuration, and propose fixes with cited evidence. Engineers who ship AI-assisted diagnostics are the ones defining this discipline.</p> <h2>Responsibilities</h2> <h3>Rapid response:</h3> <ul> <li>Own a Sev-1 incident where a large financial services customer sees asymmetric latency from a single POP. Trace it through BGP routing and origin configuration. Produce the fix upstream.</li> <li>Diagnose a recurring WebSocket disconnect that a media customer has been fighting for weeks. Isolate it to a specific interaction between WAF and their origin load balancer. Drive the fix with Product Engineering.</li> <li>Partner with a government customer's SRE team during an active DDoS event. Help them shape their Magic Transit and WAF configuration in real time.</li> </ul> <h3>Proactive engineering:</h3> <ul> <li>Build, with Product Engineering, a distributed tracing capability that correlates Cloudflare edge signals with customer origin metrics so a single query tells the story of a failing request end-to-end.</li> <li>Ship a detector for a class of WAF false positives silently degrading several customers. Get it into production before the next renewal cycle.</li> <li>Prototype an AI agent that takes a new customer case, pulls relevant logs and config, and proposes a root cause with linked evidence. Deploy it internally. Measure whether it makes engineers faster. Iterate.</li> <li><strong>Rapid incident response and root cause analysis.</strong> Own the most complex, high-severity customer issues end-to-end, from first signal through confirmed resolution. Lead deep-dive debugging across the full stack: edge, network, DNS, transport, APIs, application, customer-side configuration. Reproduce defects, validate fixes with Engineering, and confirm customer-side resolution. Produce postmortems other engineers rely on. Hold on-call for high-severity incidents as part of a global rotation that includes weekends.</li> <li><strong>Proactive reliability engineering.</strong> Analyze support and telemetry signals across the customer base to find systemic risks before they become incidents. Contribute monitoring, detection, and diagnostic capability to the core product and the engineering systems that give Customer Support early visibility into customer-affecting issues. Define customer-facing reliability metrics (error rates, resolution times, repeat-contact rates) and drive measurable improvement. Write automation that reduces mean-time-to-detect and mean-time-to-resolve.</li> <li><strong>Cross-functional partnership.</strong> Manage the technical escalation lifecycle with clear ownership and timely communication. Partner with Product Engineering to drive fixes, workarounds, and configuration changes that address underlying gaps. Represent the customer reliability perspective in engineering syncs, incident reviews, and post-mortem processes.</li> <li><strong>Technical leadership and enablement.</strong> Raise the technical floor of Customer Support through pair-debugging, structured knowledge transfer, and shared tooling. Document diagnostic procedures and resolution patterns in runbooks, internal knowledge bases, and AI skills. Share insights from customer-facing incidents to improve product documentation and operational readiness.</li> <li><strong>Product and platform depth.</strong> Maintain deep, current expertise across Cloudflare's product portfolio: edge networking, DNS, CDN, WAF, DDoS mitigation, Zero Trust, Workers, and our developer platform. Anticipate customer impact from new releases and architecture changes. Serve as a go-to subject-matter expert in one or more domains.</li> </ul> <h2>Desirable Skills, Knowledge, and Experience</h2> <ul> <li>Minimum 5 years of hands-on experience in site reliability engineering, escalation engineering, systems engineering, or a comparable deeply technical support / operations role, with at least 2 years in customer-facing environments.</li> <li>Strong foundation in networking and security: <ul> <li>TCP/IP fundamentals: OSI model, IPv4/IPv6 addressing, subnetting, routing, switching.</li> <li>Core protocols: DNS, HTTP/S, TLS/SSL, SMTP, SNMP, NTP.</li> <li>Routing protocols: BGP, OSPF, including path selection and route propagation.</li> <li>Firewall concepts: stateful/stateless inspection, rule sets, NAT, ACLs.</li> <li>VPN and encryption: IPSec, SSL/TLS tunnels, GRE.</li> <li>Zero Trust architecture, network segmentation, modern security models.</li> </ul> </li> <li>Proficiency with observability and diagnostic tooling: packet capture and analysis (Wireshark, tcpdump), log aggregation (Kibana, Elasticsearch), metrics dashboards (Grafana), distributed tracing.</li> <li>Strong scripting and automation skills (Bash, Python) with a track record of shipping tooling that improves reliability and reduces toil.</li> <li>Experience with incident management, postmortem culture, and SLO/SLI-based reliability practices.</li> <li>Excellent written and verbal communication. Able to convey complex technical information clearly to engineers, leadership, and customers.</li> <li>Comfort owning ambiguous, cross-layer problems. Composure under pressure during high-severity incidents.</li> <li>SRE, DevOps, or platform engineering experience with direct customer-facing accountability.</li> <li>Deep expertise at both L3/L4 (network infrastructure) and L7 (application protocols, DNS, HTTP, WebSocket).</li> <li>Expert-level proficiency with Linux command-line tools: curl, dig, git, traceroute, mtr, strace, ss.</li> <li>Data-at-scale analysis using SQL, PromQL, or equivalent.</li> <li>Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure-as-code (Terraform, Pulumi), and container orchestration (Kubernetes, Docker).</li> <li>Track record of building internal tooling or diagnostic utilities that measurably improved team efficiency.</li> <li>Demonstrated technical leadership: mentoring engineers, driving cross-team initiatives, influencing outcomes without direct authority.</li> <li>Experience applying AI/ML to production engineering or operational workflows.</li> <li>Comfort engaging directly with enterprise customer engineering teams, including on calls during incidents.</li> </ul> <h2>Bonus Points</h2> <ul> <li>Active Cloudflare user who understands the platform as a practitioner.</li> <li>Hands-on experience with Workers, Pages, R2, D1, or other developer platform services.</li> <li>Cloud networking and security experience across AWS, Azure, or GCP.</li> <li>Web programming (HTML, JavaScript) and regular expressions.</li> <li>Chaos engineering or formal reliability frameworks (e.g., Google SRE p

description: Über uns book-n-drive ist einer der führenden regionalen Carsharing-Anbieter. Wir ermöglichen Menschen, flexibel auf ein Auto zuzugreifen, ohne selbst eines besitzen zu müssen. Gemeinsam mit Bus, Bahn und Fahrrad schaffen wir eine praktische Alternative zum eigenen Auto. Wir möchten nicht einfach mehr Menschen zum Autofahren bewegen. Wir möchten Menschen dabei unterstützen, ihren tatsächlichen Mobilitätsbedarf flexibel, wirtschaftlich und möglichst ohne eigenes Auto zu organisieren. Dafür entwickeln wir unseren Kundenservice weiter: Neben der zuverlässigen Bearbeitung von Kundenanfragen wollen wir unsere Kunden künftig stärker persönlich begleiten, beraten und langfristig betreuen. Für diese Aufgabe suchen wir eine kommunikative, eigenständige Persönlichkeit, die gerne auf Menschen zugeht, ihre Bedürfnisse versteht und gemeinsam mit ihnen passende Lösungen findet. title: E-Commerce & Product Manager Banking (m/w/d)
description: Für unseren Kunden suchen wir zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt einen engagierten Manager Vertriebskanäle und Produktmanagement (m/w/d) in Vollzeit am Standort Neuss. Unser Kunde ist ein etabliertes, mittelständisch geprägtes Unternehmen aus der Finanzdienstleistungsbranche mit Sitz in Neuss. Das Unternehmen verbindet traditionelle Werte mit innovativen Banklösungen und legt besonderen Wert auf individuelle Kundenbetreuung, digitale Weiterentwicklung und langfristige Geschäftsbeziehungen. Aufgaben Sie entwickeln digitale, mobile und persönliche Vertriebskanäle strategisch weiter. Sie steuern Projekte zur Einführung neuer Bankprodukte und optimieren bestehende Vertriebsprozesse. title: Working Student Communications (f/m/d)
description: 01 · Why this role exists This year, RIZM has created unprecedented savings at our customers. We just aren't telling anyone. If you love telling stories, let's talk. RIZMO is our Agentic Energy Manager: an AI agent that helps industrial companies optimize their energy use and cut costs. We work with BMW, Stellantis, Boehringer Ingelheim and Bitburger. Right now, those success stories stay inside the project team. You'll change that. 02 · What you'll do You'll be our communications all-rounder and work directly with the founders and the go-to-market team. Storytelling: Turn customer projects, technology and energy-market developments into stories that a CFO or plant manager reads to the end. Video: Make short videos about customer projects and RIZMO, from concept and editing through to sign-off with the customer. PR: Pitch stories to business and trade media (Handelsblatt, manager magazin and others), write press releases and prepare interviews. LinkedIn: Plan and write content for our company page, and help the founders and GTM team with their own posts. We don't do Instagram, TikTok or blogs. Our audience is on LinkedIn and reads Handelsblatt. Events: Prepare our presence at trade fairs like E-world and Hannover Messe. That covers materials, booking meetings in advance and following up with the contacts we make. B2B marketing for long sales cycles: Our deals take months and involve many decision-makers. You'll build case studies and one-pagers that support a deal from first contact to signature. 03 · What you bring Student status: You're enrolled at a university. Your field doesn't matter (communications, journalism, business, industrial engineering, energy …) as long as you write well. Languages: Excellent German and good English. Curiosity: Energy, industry and AI interest you. We'll teach you the technical side. Ownership: You work independently, ask when something is unclear, and deliver. Nice to have: Experience with video editing, PR or event organization. Availability: 20 hours per week on-site in Münster or Munich, for at least 6 months, ideally longer. 04 · What we offer Pay: €16 per hour. Real ownership: From day one, you'll help build our communications from the ground up. Short paths: A direct line to the founders and fast decisions. Stories worth telling: Customers everyone knows. 05 · How to apply You love telling stories? Then tell us two. No cover letter needed: What topic could you explain for hours without ever getting bored? What experience from your studies shaped you more than any exam? title: SPS-Programmierer (m/w/d) – Automatisierung & Anlagensteuerung
description: Dein Job für sauberere Luft. Werde Emission Partner. Automatisierung aus dem Saterland. Wirkung weit darüber hinaus. In der Gemeinde Saterland entwickeln und produzieren wir Technologien, die Schadstoffemissionen reduzieren. Unsere Katalysatoren und Systeme kommen dort zum Einsatz, wo Abgase zuverlässig gereinigt und Emissionsgrenzwerte eingehalten werden müssen. Damit moderne Anlagen zuverlässig funktionieren, braucht es aber mehr als Mechanik und Katalysatortechnik. Steuerungen müssen programmiert, Prozesse automatisiert und Maschinen intelligent miteinander verknüpft werden. Und genau hier kommst du ins Spiel. Als SPS-Programmierer entwickelst du die Steuerungs- und Automatisierungslösungen für unsere technischen Systeme und Anlagen. Du programmierst SPS-Software, entwickelst Visualisierungen, parametrierst Antriebe und begleitest Projekte von der technischen Planung bis zur funktionierenden Lösung. Du möchtest nicht einfach Programmcode nach Vorgabe schreiben, sondern verstehen, was deine Software in einer realen Anlage bewirkt? Dann werde Emission Partner. Was du bei uns bewirkst Du gibst unseren Anlagen die Logik, mit der sie zuverlässig funktionieren. Bei uns arbeitest du an der Schnittstelle zwischen Software, Elektrotechnik und realer Anlagentechnik. Du entwickelst Steuerungsprogramme, automatisierst technische Abläufe und sorgst dafür, dass einzelne Komponenten zu einem zuverlässig funktionierenden Gesamtsystem werden. Dabei bleibt deine Arbeit nicht auf dem Bildschirm. Du kannst deine Software an realen Anlagen erleben, Funktionen testen, Optimierungspotenziale erkennen und Lösungen direkt weiterentwickeln. Du entwickelst bestehende Steuerungsprogramme weiter und optimierst automatisierte Abläufe. Du erstellst und programmierst Anlagenvisualisierungen und Bedienoberflächen . Du parametrierst Antriebe und weitere Automatisierungskomponenten . Du übernimmst Verantwortung für Projekte im Bereich Elektro- und Automatisierungstechnik . Du planst und bewertest technische Lösungen und begleitest Projekte von der Aufgabenstellung bis zur Abnahme. Du testest Funktionen, analysierst Fehler und optimierst unsere Steuerungs- und Automatisierungslösungen. Du arbeitest eng mit Elektrokonstruktion, Entwicklung und weiteren technischen Fachbereichen zusammen. Du erstellst und pflegst die erforderlichen technischen Dokumentationen. Du bringst eigene Ideen ein und entwickelst unsere Automatisierungslösungen kontinuierlich weiter. Das bringst du mit Uns ist wichtiger, was du kannst und entwickeln möchtest , als ein perfekter Lebenslauf. Du hast eine technische Ausbildung, Weiterbildung oder ein Studium, beispielsweise aus den Bereichen Automatisierungstechnik, Elektrotechnik, Informatik oder Mechatronik . Du bringst praktische Erfahrung in der SPS-Programmierung mit. Du verstehst automatisierte Anlagen nicht nur als Softwareprojekt, sondern möchtest auch die dahinterstehende Technik verstehen. title: Senior Simulation Engineering – Autonomous Driving, Land Domain (m/f/d)
description: About the role: As Senior Simulation Engineer – Autonomous Driving, Land Domain , you will play a key role in shaping the simulation capabilities that enable us to develop, test, and validate the next generation of autonomous ground systems at scale. You will design and evolve realistic, reliable, and reproducible virtual environments in which our autonomy software can be developed and challenged long before a physical vehicle enters the field. You will take strong technical ownership of simulation systems, architecture, and engineering decisions, helping to define how simulation is integrated into our autonomy development and verification workflows. title: Senior Territory Account Executive
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><h2><span style="color: rgb(230, 126, 35);">Available Locations</span></h2> <p>Spain</p> <h2><span style="color: rgb(230, 126, 35);">About the Role</span></h2> <p>We are seeking a highly accomplished and strategic <strong>Territory Account Executive</strong> to join our <strong>Iberia Sales Team</strong>. title: Staff Backend Engineer - Analytics Instrumentation
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.</em></p></div><p><strong>An overview of this role</strong><br>Analytics Instrumentation is part of the Data Engineering and Monetization (DE&M) group, focused on the collection of Product Usage and Billing event data within GitLab. You’ll build and maintain backend systems that give the company visibility into customer usage patterns across GitLab SaaS and Self-Managed deployment environments. That data directly informs strategic product priorities and strategies. This role offers the opportunity to work on foundational infrastructure that simplifies instrumentation for teams at GitLab, replacing the complexity of multiple language-specific software development kits with a single, unified solution that teams can rely on.</p> <p><strong>What you’ll do<br></strong></p> <ul> <li>Guide the design, implementation, and evolution of a unified data collection systems during working hours, with success measured by timely incident handling, effective root cause analysis, and reliable service restoration.</li> <li>Work across the organization with research and development teams and the enterprise data organization to deliver common solutions, with success measured by adoption across multiple stakeholders.</li> <li>Make technical choices that balance code reviews, design discussions, and clear technical documentation, with success measured by stronger code quality, faster technical alignment, and more maintainable systems.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What you’ll bring</strong></p> <ul> <li>Significant experience working with platform or infrastructure systems in production environments.</li> <li>Strong proficiency in the Go programming language, with experience building and maintaining production services.</li> <li>Strong backend development experience, with the ability to design and deliver scalable, reliable systems serving internal and external customers.</li> <li>Experience guiding technical design and making tradeoffs across system reliability, performance at scale, data quality, and observability.</li> <li>Experience working across team boundaries with product teams, data consumers, and other internal stakeholders.</li> <li>Familiarity with cloud native technologies and open source development practices.</li> <li>A track record of mentoring other engineers and helping teams make clear, well-documented technical choices.</li> </ul> <p><strong>About the team</strong><br>The Analytics Instrumentation team operates at the intersection of Product, Analytics, and customer-facing teams, providing data collection infrastructure that serves engineering teams across GitLab. We’re a distributed team of generalist engineers who tackle complex problems spanning the GitLab codebase, JavaScript, Go, and Python satellite services, data pipelines, and AI tool integration. We collaborate transparently across teams, deliver measurable results through efficient iteration, and build inclusive solutions that respect user privacy. Our work enables data-informed choices and planning across the organization. We’re involved in diverse projects from event data collection and privacy compliance tools to AI-powered analytics frameworks that help GitLab teams learn more about their users.</p> <p><strong> </strong></p><div class="content-conclusion"><h4><strong>How GitLab Supports Full-Time Employees</strong></h4> <ul> <li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/">Benefits to support your health, finances, and well-being</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/time-off-and-absence/time-off-types/#flexible-paid-time-off-pto">Flexible Paid Time Off </a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/company/culture/inclusion/tmrg-tmag/">Team Member Resource Groups</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/stock-options/">Equity Compensation & Employee Stock Purchase Plan</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/learning-and-development/growth-and-development/">Growth and Development Fund</a></li> <li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/#parental-leave">Parental Leave</a> </li> </ul> <p>Please note that we welcome interest from candidates with varying levels of experience; many successful candidates do not meet every single requirement. title: Senior Solution Architect - PKI (m/w/x)
description: Digitale Identitäten, sichere Kommunikation und der Schutz sensibler Daten sind zentrale Voraussetzungen einer modernen digitalen Gesellschaft. Für den IT-Bereich suchen wir einen erfahrenen Senior Solution Architect – Public Trust PKI (TLS & S/MIME) (m/w/d), der die strategische und technische Weiterentwicklung der IT-Systemlandschaft sowie der Public-Trust-PKI maßgeblich mitgestaltet. In dieser Position übernimmst Du eine zentrale Schnittstellenfunktion zwischen Architektur, Entwicklung, PKI-Betrieb und weiteren Fachbereichen. title: Manager Business Development & Market Analysis (m/w/d) | Befristet auf 4 Jahre
description: Wollen Sie Ihre berufliche Zukunft in einem wegweisenden Projekt gestalten? Bei der Deutschen Energy Terminal GmbH (DET) in Düsseldorf erwartet Sie eine spannende Herausforderung. Im Auftrag des Bundesministeriums für Wirtschaft und Energie entwickelt und betreibt die Deutsche Energy Terminal GmbH (DET) die vier schwimmenden LNG-Terminals an der deutschen Nordseeküste, über die LNG vom Schiff in das Gasnetz eingespeist wird. Die sogenannten Floating Storage and Regasification Units (FSRU) sind von entscheidender Bedeutung für die Versorgungssicherheit Deutschlands und damit kritische Infrastruktur mit hohem Risikopotenzial. Wir suchen motivierte Talente, die aktiv an der Gestaltung unseres Verantwortungsbereichs teilhaben möchten. Bewerben Sie sich noch heute und gestalten Sie die Zukunft mit uns! Aufgaben Ihre Aufgabe: Den Markt verstehen, weiterdenken und in Projekte übersetzen Genau hier kommen Sie ins Spiel: Als Manager Business Development & Market Analysis (m/w/d) beobachten und analysieren Sie fortlaufend die Entwicklungen in den internationalen Energiemärkten – von LNG über Gas bis hin zu grünen Alternativen. Sie leiten daraus Empfehlungen für die Ausgestaltung unserer Marktangebote ab und entwickeln Tools zur systematischen Bewertung der Versorgungssicherheit in Deutschland. Sie entwickeln und leiten strategische Projekte zur Nutzung unsere Terminalstandorte. Aktuell begleiten sie beispielsweise eine europaweit ausgeschriebene Konzeptstudie, aus der konkrete Projekte hervorgehen sollen. Diese können thematisch von der synergetischen Nutzung mit Nachbarstandorten über die Umwandlung zu Grün-Terminals bis hin zum Aufbau von CO2-Terminals Umschlagsplätzen an unseren Terminals reichen. Unser Gesellschafter ist das Bundesministerium für Wirtschaft und Klimaschutz (BMWK) und ihre Arbeit ist von besonderem öffentlichem Interesse. Ihre Aufgaben bei uns Analyse von Markttrends rund um LNG, Erdgas und grüne Energieträger – sowohl auf nationaler als auch internationaler Ebene Entwicklung fundierter Marktanalysen und Marktberichte zur Bewertung unserer Marktangebote (z. B. Nachfrageeinschätzung, Preisbildung, Angebotsstrukturen) Entwicklung von Tools zur Bewertung der Versorgungssicherheit, der Diversifizierung der Gasversorgung, von Marktpotenzialen und geopolitischen Einflussfaktoren Unterstützung von Vermarktungsaktionen, insbesondere bei der organisatorischen Vorbereitung und Analyse der Ergebnisse Entwicklung und Leitung strategischer Projekte zur z. B. Terminaltransformation, Entwicklung von strategischen Partnerschaften Koordination von Studien und Ausschreibungen (z. B. Terminalentwicklungen, grüne Infrastruktur) sowie Ableitung konkreter Projektkonzepte Zusammenarbeit mit internen Schnittstellen (Technik, Kommunikation, Regulierung) sowie externen Partnern und Berater:innen Quantifizierung der Kapazitätsentwicklung für LNG-Terminals in Deutschland und international Qualifikation Was Sie mitbringen sollten Ein abgeschlossenes wirtschafts-, ingenieur- oder energiewirtschaftliches Studium Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung oder ausgeprägtes Interesse an Marktanalyse, Energiewirtschaft und strategischer Projektarbeit Erfahrung in der Leitung von Projekten Analytisches Denkvermögen, Freude an der Arbeit mit Zahlen, Marktmodellen und Marktkennzahlen Fähigkeit, geopolitische Entwicklungen einzuordnen und in marktbezogene Empfehlungen zu überführen Strukturierte, konzeptionelle Arbeitsweise mit Erfahrung im Projektmanagement Kommunikationsstärke und die Fähigkeit, komplexe Themen klar und verständlich zu vermitteln Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift Benefits Teilhabe an der Erfüllung einer Aufgabe, die für die Versorgungssicherheit Deutschlands und seiner Nachbarn von entscheidender Bedeutung ist Aus- und Fortbildung Ein dynamisches Umfeld mit abwechslungsreichen Aufgaben und hoher Eigenverantwortung 30 Urlaubstage Homeoffice nach Vereinbarung Wir arbeiten stetig an weiteren Vorteilen für unsere Mitarbeitenden: aktuell bieten wir eine medizinische Gesundheitsvorsorge, die Kostenübernahme des Deutschland-Tickets sowie einen attraktiven Arbeitsplatz als weitere Benefits Bereit, den Energiemarkt mitzugestalten? title: Senior Account Associate - Medical
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>At Real Chemistry, making the world a healthier place isn’t just an aspiration—it’s our everyday reality. Our drive to transform healthcare is informed by our blend of deep scientific expertise, human-centred creativity, and AI-driven insights, fostering a unique environment where innovation thrives and our people are impact-obsessed. As a global agency, we provide a full suite of services across healthcare communications and marketing to our clients, including top players in the pharmaceutical and biotech industries.</p> <p>Our #LifeatRealChem culture is rooted in our people—we believe we are best together and are committed to excellence for both our clients and colleagues. Whether you're a seasoned professional or just starting your career, if you share our passion for healthcare and connection, we invite you to explore our opportunities.</p> <p>Discover your purpose. Embrace innovation. Experience #LifeatRealChem.</p></div><p><strong>Job Summary:</strong></p> <div> <p>Real Chemistry is looking for a Senior Account Associate to join our growing team!</p> <p>As a Senior Account Associate, you will have a strong focus on day-to-day project management and learning how to manage client relationships. You are already able to manage small and medium sized projects from start to finish and will be gaining experience of managing others and delegating. Both clients and your colleagues know they can rely on you to make sensible decisions, and to be efficient and reliable.</p> <p> </p> <p><strong>What you’ll do:</strong></p> <p><strong>Client delivery</strong></p> <ul> <li>Take full responsibility for planning ahead and managing your time, priorities and deliverables across your accounts, proactively seeking guidance from your account leads and line manager, if required; highlight risks to project delivery, as necessary</li> <li>Confidently manage administrative accounts tasks (managing internal & external meeting invites; updating status reports; developing agendas, call notes and timelines, etc.) with minimal senior input</li> <li>Maintain an awareness of projects across your accounts, flagging key updates to your teams in a timely manner along with suggested next steps/solutions</li> <li>Manage small to medium-sized projects from start to end, ensuring that they are delivered to cost and deadline, including managing internal and external resource where required</li> <li>Identify opportunities to delegate effectively (both up and down), matching suitable assignments with more junior team members for their professional development and effective delivery (where applicable)</li> <li>Demonstrate an understanding of your clients’ needs (building an awareness of their strategy and brand) and preferences in your interactions and the delivery of work</li> <li>Lead sections of client calls and face-to-face meetings, providing recommendations and counsel to clients, where appropriate</li> <li>Develop writing skills further; conducting research, drafting the complete first draft, and ensuring content is accurate</li> <li>Demonstrated proficiency on VVPM, capable of uploading, tagging and managing assets through approval</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>Team management</strong></p> <ul> <li>Understand the reasons behind why we are doing the programme and project objectives, and be able to effectively communicate these internally and externally</li> <li>Start to develop your coaching, delegation and briefing (both internally and externally with suppliers) skills, and lead by example; use these approaches to upskill, develop and inspire more junior team members</li> <li>Buddy new AA/SAA starters</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>Financial management </strong></p> <ul> <li>Develop a clear understanding of the relevant RC financial processes (e.g. raising job codes, purchase orders, managing Salesforce opportunities, requesting time moves, etc.) and support your account teams as required</li> <li>Begin to draft budgets, talking your account lead through your rationale</li> <li>Complete your timesheets and expense claims accurately and on time and take an active role in reviewing timesheets across some of your projects</li> </ul> <p><strong>Agency environment</strong></p> <ul> <li>Immerse yourself in the medical communications and pharma industries, and your client companies and therapy areas: engage with every opportunity to establish an awareness of developments, innovations and trends. Look for opportunities to reflect these in your work and flag your ideas to your teams and wider team to raise your internal profile</li> </ul> <p><strong>This position is a perfect fit for you if:</strong></p> <ul> <li>​Our Company values – <em>Best Together, Impact-Obsessed, Excellence Expected, Evolve Always</em> and <em>Accountability with an “I”</em> – really speak to you.</li> <li>You are adaptable, resilient, and OK with adjusting your scope, responsibilities, and focus as we grow. When things change, so do we. We’re always evolving.</li> <li>You are proactive, driven, and resourceful with strong prioritization skills and a desire to dive into the data.</li> <li>You are highly organized self-starter, able to work independently and under tight deadlines.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>What you should have: </strong></p> <ul> <li><u>Relevant degree in a scientific subject</u></li> <li>Previous industry experience</li> <li>Must have at least one year of experience in a professional environment</li> <li>Highly organised with a mindfulness of deadlines, the ability to manage multiple tasks based on priorities and a strong attention to detail</li> <li>Independent thinker confident in taking ownership of assets and material development, but a team player who enjoys collaboration</li> <li>Performs tasks with a sense of urgency and has the confidence to communicate with managers when deadlines will not be met or when issues are foreseeable</li> <li>Strong written and oral communication and presentations skills</li> <li>Open minded and eager to learn – the more you put in, the more you get out!</li> <li>High energy, able to effectively operate in fast-paced, growing and evolving environment</li> </ul> </div> <p> </p> <p> </p><div class="content-conclusion"><p>Real Chemistry is proud to be Great Place to Work® certified; Real Chemistry offers a comprehensive benefit program and perks, tailored to your region. Globally, this includes offices in our key markets with free snacks to keep you running all day long, generous holiday and paid time off, options for private medical, dental, and vison plans, and support in saving for the future. Other perks include mental wellness coaching and support and access to more than 13,000 online classes with LinkedIn Learning.  Learn more about our great benefits and perks and search specific offerings in your region at: <a href="https://www.realchemistrybenefits.com">www.realchemistrybenefits.com</a>.</p> <p><span data-olk-copy-source="MessageBody">At Real Chemistry, we believe we're at our best when we're connected. description: <div class="content-intro"><p><span class="TextRun SCXW142035299 BCX0" lang="EN-US" data-contrast="auto"><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW142035299 BCX0">Resolve to Save Lives (RTSL)</span></span><span data-contrast="none"> is a global health organization that partners locally and globally to create and scale solutions to the world’s deadliest </span><span data-contrast="none">health threats. </span><span data-contrast="none">Millions of people die from preventable health threats. We collaborate to close the gap between proven, life-saving solutions and the people who need them. </span><span data-contrast="none">Since 2017, </span><span data-contrast="none">we’ve</span><span data-contrast="none"> worked with governments and other partners in more than 60 countries to save millions of lives. We work toward a future where people live</span> <span data-contrast="none">longer, healthier lives, communities flourish, and economies thrive. This is an ambitious vision, and it inspires us and our partners to make progress every day.</span><span data-ccp-props="{}"> </span></p></div><p><span class="EOP SCXW70040856 BCX0" data-ccp-props="{}">Resolve to Save Lives (RTSL) works with governments and partners to strengthen and transform primary health care (PHC) to improve health and save lives. Our approach focuses on making PHC more prioritized, proactive and accountable for outcomes, and strengthening how care is organized, delivered, financed and measured. Drawing on expertise across RTSL's portfolio, we bring together solutions in health system resilience and epidemic readiness, digital health and data-driven decision-making, performance measurement and improvement, and sustainable health financing. We apply these capabilities to address priority health challenges, including cardiovascular health, maternal survival and sexual and reproductive health, while strengthening health systems to deliver more equitable, effective and resilient care.  </span></p> <h3><strong><span class="EOP SCXW70040856 BCX0" data-ccp-props="{}">Position Purpose</span></strong></h3> <p>The Director, Maternal & Reproductive Health will provide strategic and technical leadership for RTSL's portfolio to reduce preventable maternal deaths and improve sexual and reproductive health outcomes. The role will lead the development and implementation of a multi-country program that strengthens government capabilities to identify and address barriers to quality care, translate data into action, and deliver measurable improvements in health outcomes.</p> <p>The Director will have overall accountability for the strategy, resources, quality, performance, and results of the maternal survival and reproductive health portfolio, leading a multidisciplinary team and working closely with governments, technical partners, and colleagues across RTSL to design, implement and scale evidence-informed approaches. The role requires deep expertise in sexual, reproductive and maternal health, strong program leadership, and the ability to translate technical evidence into practical, sustainable health system title: Senior Quality Assurance Officer
description: About Vitestro Founded in 2017 in Utrecht, Vitestro is pioneering the future of blood collection with the Aletta® Autonomous Robotic Phlebotomy Device™ (ARPD™) . This groundbreaking medical device combines advanced multi-modal imaging (near-infrared, ultrasound, and Doppler ultrasound) with robotics and AI to perform the entire diagnostic blood draw procedure autonomously. By addressing critical healthcare staffing shortages and improving patient experience, Vitestro is transforming one of the most common and essential medical procedures. With more than 130 team members and growing rapidly, we are scaling our impact. As we placed our first devices with customers, we are now expanding our team to ensure successful implementation and long-term reliability. At Vitestro, we are committed to continuous innovation and improvement. As our Senior QS officer, you focus on the continuous improvement of our quality systems and support the company through the change control process. You review existing quality processes, identify where they can be improved or made more compliant, and help develop practical solutions to make those improvements happen. You also guide colleagues through change control. Rather than executing every change yourself, you ensure people understand and follow the process, ask the right questions, consider the relevant implications, obtain the necessary approvals, and ensure that changes are completed Correctly and on time. This role requires a strong analytical and systematic mindset combined with a pragmatic approach to quality. You should be comfortable identifying problems, but more importantly, finding workable solutions and alternatives. You understand the requirements of working in a regulated environment without approaching quality as simply enforcing rules. You are able to adapt, think creatively and help the organisation find compliant ways forward. First months at Vitestro In your first months, you get to know Vitestro’s quality systems, processes, and the teams working with them. You build a thorough understanding of our Change Control process and start supporting colleagues through changes, helping them consider the right questions and ensuring changes are complete, appropriately approved, and progressing on time. As you become familiar with how we work, you identify opportunities to improve the compliance and efficiency of the Change Control process and develop a clear plan for implementing those improvements. This is what success looks like: After 12 months, you are a trusted partner for colleagues working with our quality systems and Change Control process. You confidently support the organization in executing changes, ensuring they are well considered, appropriately approved, and completed on time. You have improved the Change Control process to strengthen both compliance and efficiency, and have identified and implemented improvements across other areas of the QMS. You combine strong analytical thinking with a pragmatic and creative approach. You don’t just identify where something could be improved; you translate those insights into practical solutions and, when one approach doesn’t work, find alternative ways forward. What You’ll Bring: Strong analytical thinking and the ability to assess existing processes, identify where issues occur and determine how they can be improved. Experience working in a regulated environment. Relevant professional experience that provides an understanding of how quality systems and processes work. A systematic, process-oriented way of working. The ability to identify and develop solutions to quality and process problems. A pragmatic and adaptable mindset, with the ability to think beyond rigid or established approaches while respecting regulatory requirements. The ability to guide colleagues through processes by asking questions, highlighting considerations and ensuring required steps are completed. Bachelor’s degree or higher in engineering, applied sciences, biomedical engineering, or similar technical field Minimum 3 to 5 years experience in Quality Assurance / Quality Systems for medical devices. Nice to have: Experience across multiple organisations or environments, providing exposure to different ways of working. Medical-device experience can be relevant but is not required. Experience with MDSAP How We Work At Vitestro, ownership is not a slogan - it is an expectation. We trust people to take responsibility, make decisions, and drive work forward. We believe breakthroughs happen when talented people combine dedication, accountability, and teamwork. That means: We take initiative rather than wait for direction. We focus on execution and delivering results. We proactively remove blockers and help each other succeed. We challenge ideas, not people. We continuously learn, improve, and raise the bar. We celebrate team success over individual heroics. We move fast, but we do so thoughtfully. We care deeply about quality because the technology we build ultimately impacts patients and healthcare professionals. If you are looking for an environment where you can make a significant contribution, take ownership of meaningful work, and be surrounded by highly motivated colleagues, we'd love to meet you. What we offer Competitive salary including pension plan 25 days of annual leave based on a full-time position Hybrid work model Working together in a high-skilled team with our home base in Utrecht Frequent out-of-work activities with our team, and annual company weekend away. Training budget Opportunity to be key shaper of a new global industry niche: autonomous medical robotics We’re big fans of working from the office – this is where team spirit comes alive. At the same time, we offer flexibility, allowing up to two (out of 5) days of working from home for those who prefer it. Are you excited? We totally understand that and so are we! By joining us, you can play an active role in changing the future of health care. Excited to join our revolution? Then we’d love to hear from you! If you think you've got what it takes, but you don't meet all the requirements - we still recommend you apply. We would love to learn about your interest and experience and consider if you can be a good fit for Vitestro. Nobody is a perfect fit, and we welcome applications with imperfections. We offer a learning environment where we grow together! Find Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

title: Talent Acquisition Intern
description: Our Team We believe travel can create citizens of the world. We spark moments of connection and transformation, giving people the freedom to explore openly and shape their own story. With colleagues from more than 50 countries, our diversity fuels curiosity, insight, and a culture of openness, essential to understanding our travellers and one another. We work in a flexible hybrid model from our Utrecht HQ and our homes across the Netherlands. Just as travel is about discovery, we’re looking for people who want to go one stop further, joining a journey that inspires personal transformation through train travel. We’re looking for: You’re someone with a real interest in people and an energetic team player with drive and a genuine eagerness to learn, especially when it comes to finding and welcoming new talent. You’ll join our People & Culture team and work closely with Talent Acquisition on real recruitment projects, so you gain practical experience from day one. Our P&C team Our P&C team drives engagement and performance. We focus on all elements of People and Culture, including Learning and Development, Recruitment, Employee Relations, Office Management and Employee Experience. Within the team, Talent Acquisition looks after everything from the first job post to a new colleague’s first day, and that’s where you’ll spend most of your time. What you will be doing: Working closely with Talent Acquisition, you’ll gain hands-on experience in: Replying to candidates’ general questions by email, making sure everyone who gets in touch receives a kind, clear and timely answer. Scheduling interviews in close collaboration with our hiring managers, so the process runs smoothly for candidates and interviewers alike. Joining interviews alongside Talent Acquisition, so you can learn how great interviews work and build your own interviewing skills along the way. Creating employer branding banners and visuals that show what it’s really like to work at Interrail. Representing Interrail at recruitment events, such as job fairs and university career days, and helping to prepare and coordinate them. Research recruitment initiatives and AI tools used at other companies, and share ideas we could try ourselves while building your own skills in this area. Over time, taking ownership of hiring our future interns, from posting the role to welcoming them on board. Supporting the wider P&C team with general HR tasks, such as onboarding or answering questions in the HR inbox. Skills and mindset: (Working towards) a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Human Resources, or a related field, or otherwise eligible for an internship (for example, with an orientation year visa). Previous (internship) experience in HR, recruitment or a related field is a plus, but not a must. Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with a warm and clear writing style, as you’ll often be a candidate’s first point of contact. Curiosity about AI and digital tools, and a willingness to experiment. Ability to work well in a dynamic environment. Strong attention to detail and accuracy. Fluent in English. Our offer A monthly internship allowance of €650 (Bachelor’s) or €750 (Master’s). A travel allowance covering your commute to and from the office. 2 days of paid leave per month. We offer a flexible hybrid model that combines remote work with in-office days each week, promoting teamwork and connection. 5 working days from abroad per 6 months internship. A free global travel pass for you and a companion on completion of your internship, so you can explore Europe with your family or friends and share the same experiences as our customers. Joining monthly borrels and other social events. The opportunity to make a visible contribution, alongside gaining valuable experience for your future career. Curious to apply? Apply directly via our website Interrail Careers | Create An Impact . Preferred start date 18 January. We'll ask you to share your resume in English (our business language) and tell us why you're interested in Interrail and this particular role. It doesn't hurt to be creative; we enjoy seeing your personality shine through. As part of the process, we may also ask you to complete a short assessment to showcase your skills. If we think you might be a good candidate, the next step is a relatively informal interview with some of your potential new team members. For you, this is a chance to understand if Interrail is your ideal workplace, and for us, it tells us more about the value you would bring. In the meantime… If you’re curious, why not check us out on LinkedIn and get a feel for our culture, values, and place worldwide? Got questions? Our People & Culture team would be happy to help - just drop us a note at While you're here, explore our travel passes and get inspired for your next journey at Interrail.com . De uitdaging is om deze kennis te vertalen naar duidelijke proposities en gerichte commerciële en marketingactiviteiten. Jouw afstudeeropdracht Tijdens je afstudeerstage onderzoek je hoe het huidige marketing- en propositieproces verloopt: van een eerste idee tot content, campagne, lead en commerciële opvolging. De centrale vraag tijdens jouw afstudeerstage is: Hoe kan Risk Solutions het marketing- en propositieproces zo inrichten dat nieuwe proposities met beperkte capaciteit sneller en consistenter in de markt worden gezet en de zichtbaarheid, vindbaarheid en commerciële opvolging worden verbeterd? Je onderzoekt ook wat er in de markt speelt en hoe andere aanbieders hun oplossingen presenteren. Daarbij verdiep je je onder andere in kredietacceptatie, financiële risico’s, AML, Wwft, KYC en fraudepreventie. description: This is an Atlantic portfolio venture. About the Venture We build brain-inspired computing hardware designed to tackle problems that conventional computing handles badly or not at all. Your mandate is to build the legal function, establish clear decision rights and create the infrastructure that allows the company to scale without unnecessary friction. The remit is broad because we sell sophisticated, regulated hardware internationally and are moving faster than our processes have historically allowed. What you'll do Own corporate governance across our German GmbH and US entity: shareholder and board matters, financing rounds, related-party and conflict-of-interest questions. Lead commercial contracting across hardware sales, licensing, research collaborations, cloud and service agreements, and NDAs. Build the templates and playbook so that standard cases can be handled efficiently. Take ownership of export control and dual-use matters, including EU Dual-Use Regulation, German licensing requirements, US export-control exposure, sanctions and restricted-party screening. Lead our cybersecurity and product compliance agenda, including NIS2, the Cyber Resilience Act and related incident-reporting and conformity requirements. Cover product safety and market access for the hardware itself, including CE marking, EMC, RoHS, REACH and product liability. Manage our IP portfolio: patents, freedom to operate, trade secrets, licensing, technology rights and trademarks. Qualified German lawyer (Volljurist), with fluency in EU regulation. In-house experience at a semiconductor, hardware or deep-tech company, ideally in a start-up or scale-up environment rather than exclusively in a large corporate legal department is strongly preferred. Experience with export control and dual-use questions in a business that actually ships internationally, including an understanding of the difference between licensing and per-transaction screening. Comfortable across a wide surface: corporate, commercial, IP, employment and regulatory. You do not need to be the deepest expert in each area, but you need to know what good looks like and when to escalate. You have built structure inside a company before: templates, approval frameworks, signing authority or something equivalent that outlived your involvement. Familiarity with hardware product regulation, CE marking, RoHS and REACH, or with the evolving EU cybersecurity regime is a strong plus. German and English at working fluency, both written and spoken. Based in or willing to relocate to the company's location in either Dresden or Berlin. title: Marketing Lead
description: Über YLAB Wir bauen die KI, die wir unseren eigenen Kindern geben würden. Kinder wachsen heute mit KI auf.
