title: Professional Services Consultant, Zero Trust
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><h3><strong>Available Locations: </strong></h3> <ul> <li><strong>Austin, TX</strong></li> <li><strong>New York, NY</strong></li> <li><strong>Washington DC</strong></li> <li><strong>San Francisco Bay Area</strong></li> </ul> <hr> <h3><strong>About the role:</strong></h3> <p>Cloudflare provides consultative and hands-on-keyboard implementation and migration services for enterprise customers. As a Senior Zero Trust Consultant within Professional Services, you are a senior individual contributor in the post-sales landscape, responsible for the technical execution of our most complex Zero Trust / SASE solutions and for guiding our customers to get the most value possible from their Cloudflare investment. You are a technical leader in the room — trusted to own the hardest engagements end to end, unblock escalations, and set the standard for how the practice delivers.</p> <p>You are a security and networking specialist with deep, hands-on experience across ZTNA, Secure Web Gateway, DNS filtering, Data Loss Prevention, CASB, Remote Browser Isolation, Cloud Email Security, and the identity and network on-ramps that tie a SASE architecture together. You are equally comfortable designing an architecture, configuring it hands-on-keyboard (including as code), troubleshooting a packet capture, and explaining the outcome to a customer's security leadership.</p> <p>This position has working hours Monday to Friday, 09:00–18:00. Occasionally we support customers over weekends for specific changes that must be done outside their business hours. Less than 15% of travel is expected. Work is performed in English; fluency in Spanish or Portuguese is a strong advantage.</p> <p><strong>Responsibilities:</strong></p> <ul> <li style="line-height: 2;">Plan and deliver timely and organized services for customers, ensure customers see the full value in Cloudflare’s products and advice on product best practices.</li> <li style="line-height: 2;">Gather business and technical requirements, use cases and any other information required to build, migrate and deliver a solution on behalf of the customer and transition the Cloudflare working environment to the customer. Produce a Solution Design, HLD, LLD, databuilds, procedures, scripts, test plans, drawings, deployment plan, migration plan, as-builts, and any other artifacts necessary to deliver the solution and transition smoothly into the customer’s technical teams.</li> <li style="line-height: 2;">Implement changes on behalf of the customer in the Cloudflare environment following the customer's change-management process. Provide guidance to the customer to configure their CPEs and integration points (identity providers, endpoints/MDM, DNS, network on-ramps, SIEM).</li> <li style="line-height: 2;">Troubleshoot implementation issues and collaborate with Customer Support, Engineering, and other teams to drive technical escalations to resolution.</li> <li style="line-height: 2;">Contribute to the success of the organization through knowledge-sharing — internal and external documentation, technical Q&A, and iterating on best practices. Build operational assets such as templates, automation scripts, procedures, and workflows.</li> <li style="line-height: 2;">Lead multi-workstream engagements and act as the senior technical owner for complex deployments; support pre-sales scoping and solution design; and mentor junior consultants, helping scale the practice through reusable intellectual property.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Experience might include a combination of the skills below:</strong></p> <ul> <li style="line-height: 2;">3+ years in a customer-facing technical implementation or onboarding team, security engineering team, security operations center, or other highly technical team, including 3+ years focused on Zero Trust / SASE.</li> <li style="line-height: 2;">Strong command of the OSI model and core protocols: TCP/IP, TLS (including TLSv1.3 and mTLS), DNS, HTTP/2.</li> <li style="line-height: 2;">Deep understanding of Zero Trust technologies: Zero Trust Network Access (ZTNA), Secure Web Gateway (SWG), Remote Browser Isolation (RBI), Data Loss Prevention (DLP), CASB, and Cloud Email Security.</li> <li style="line-height: 2;">Deep understanding of internet and security technologies: forward and reverse proxies with content filtering & DLP, sandboxing, firewalls/NGFW, WAF, bot management, rate limiting, and SSL/IPsec & SSL/TLS VPN appliances and services.</li> <li style="line-height: 2;">Modern identity: SSO via SAML and OIDC, SCIM user/group provisioning and deprovisioning, LDAP/Active Directory, MFA/FIDO2, and the role of the IdP — with hands-on experience on Microsoft Entra ID, Okta, or Ping.</li> <li style="line-height: 2;">DNS in depth: DNS filtering, DoH/DoT, conditional forwarding / split-DNS, internal-zone resolution, and local domain fallback.</li> <li style="line-height: 2;">Endpoints: software distribution and deployment across Windows, macOS, and Linux; Windows and Linux server administration; and client-endpoint troubleshooting across all three platforms.</li> <li style="line-height: 2;">Networking troubleshooting: debugging network connectivity with standard tools (packet capture, DNS/HTTP tracing).</li> <li style="line-height: 2;">Ability to manage a project, work to deadlines, and prioritize between competing demands.</li> <li style="line-height: 2;">Work performed in English; fluency in Spanish or Portuguese is a strong advantage.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Demonstrated technical experience (hands-on-keyboard) with:</strong></p> <p><em>At the senior level we expect these to be hands-on-keyboard — configured, deployed, migrated, or troubleshot in production — not just understood conceptually.</em></p> <ul> <li style="line-height: 2;">Experience working with Reverse & Forward proxies with Content Filtering & DLP technologies</li> <li style="line-height: 2;">Software distribution & deployment in Microsoft, Mac and Linux environments</li> <li style="line-height: 2;">Detailed working knowledge of web based security, network segmentation, security proxies,  Firewalls and NGFWs, SSL/IPSec and SSL/TLS VPN appliances & services, etc</li> <li style="line-height: 2;">Integrating identity providers with enterprise applications end to end — SSO (SAML/OIDC) and SCIM provisioning, group/attribute mapping, and troubleshooting the IdP handshake.</li> <li style="line-height: 2;">Windows & Linux Server system administration</li> <li style="line-height: 2;">Windows, MacOS and Linux client endpoints troubleshooting</li> <li style="line-height: 2;">Experience debugging Network connectivity issues using Network Troubleshooting Tools</li> </ul> <p><strong>Preferred but not mandatory:</strong></p> <ul> <li style="line-height: 2;">Automation / Infrastructure-as-Code: Terraform (ideally the Cloudflare provider), REST APIs, Python/Bash scripting, Git, CI/CD, and policy-as-code.</li> <li style="line-height: 2;">Cloud platforms: AWS / Azure / GCP networking — VPC/VNet, Security Groups / NSG / NACL, cloud-native DNS resolvers (Route 53 Inbound Endpoints, Azure Private DNS), cloud IAM, and deploying connectors in IaaS.</li> <li style="line-height: 2;">SASE on-ramp networking: IPsec/GRE tunnel configuration, BGP, Anycast, network segmentation for Zero Trust, and SD-WAN / MPLS / WAN-optimization background.</li> <li style="line-height: 2;">MDM software distribution (Intune, Jamf).</li> <li style="line-height: 2;">Identity & directory tooling: Microsoft Active Directory, GPO, Entra ID, and Intune.</li> <li style="line-height: 2;">Observability: log export (Logpush) and SIEM integration (Splunk, Microsoft Sentinel, Elastic, Chronicle); Digital Experience Monitoring (DEX).</li> <li style="line-height: 2;">Frameworks & compliance: NIST Zero Trust Architecture; GDPR, DORA, NIS2, ISO 27001, PCI DSS, HIPAA, SOC 2 (FedRAMP if US-government work applies).</li> <li style="line-height: 2;">Certifications: CISSP, CCSP, SC-300, AZ-500, AWS Security Specialty, CCNP/CCIE, CompTIA, or equivalent are a strong plus. Forensic certifications (GCFA, GCFE, GCIA, GCIH) are welcome but not central to this role.</li> <li style="line-height: 2;">Emerging: familiarity with AI security / shadow-AI governance — AI-tool discovery and gating, and AI Gateway concepts.</li> </ul> <h3 class="" data-path-to-node="1"><strong data-path-to-node="1" data-index-in-node="0"><strong class="" data-path-to-node="0" data-index-in-node="0">Application Deadline:</strong> </strong><span class="">January 26,</span> 2027</h3> <h3 class="" data-path-to-node="1"><strong data-path-to-node="1" data-index-in-node="0">Compensation</strong></h3> <ul data-path-to-node="2"> <li> <p data-path-to-node="2,0,0">Compensation may be adjusted depending on work location.</p> </li> <li> <p id="p-rc_453fd7ca19e0bd99-23" data-path-to-node="2,1,0"><span data-path-to-node="2,1,0,0">For SF, SJ, and Bay Area Metro based hires: Estimated annual salary of $163,000 - $224,000</span><span data-path-to-node="2,1,0,2">.</span></p> </li> <li> <p id="p-rc_453fd7ca19e0bd99-24" data-path-to-node="2,2,0"><span class="" data-path-to-node="2,2,0,0">For California - Remote, DC Metro, New York City, NY Metro: Estimated annual salary of $156,000 - $215,000</span><span data-path-to-node="2,2,0,2">.</span></p> </li> <li> <p id="p-rc_453fd7ca19e0bd99-25" data-path-to-node="2,3

title: Content Creator – Gastronomie & Hospitality (H/F)
description: À propos de Culinary Agency Passionné(e) par la gastronomie, la création vidéo et les univers premium ? Vous souhaitez mettre votre créativité au service de belles maisons, de restaurants, d’hôtels et d’acteurs de la gastronomie ? Chez Culinary Agency , nous accompagnons des établissements et des marques d’exception dans leur stratégie de communication et leur présence sur les réseaux sociaux. Dans le cadre du développement de notre activité et de notre portefeuille clients, nous recherchons un(e) Content Creator capable d’imaginer, de produire et de monter des contenus visuels de qualité, avec un véritable sens du détail et de l’esthétique. Vos missions En lien étroit avec les équipes de l’agence et en binôme avec un Content Creator Junior, vous serez au cœur de la production de contenus pour nos clients. 1. Organisation et préparation des tournages Organiser et planifier les sessions de tournage chez nos clients. Préparer les besoins en amont : idées de contenus, séquences, matériel et organisation logistique. Veiller au bon déroulement des tournages et au respect des plannings. 2. Création de contenus vidéo Réaliser des prises de vue directement chez nos clients : restaurants, hôtels, chefs et maisons premium. Imaginer et produire des contenus adaptés aux codes des réseaux sociaux, notamment Instagram et les formats courts (Reels). Mettre en valeur les lieux, les équipes, les produits, les gestes et les expériences à travers un regard créatif et soigné. Être capable de produire un volume important de contenus tout en maintenant un haut niveau de qualité. Être présent(e) sur le terrain environ 3 à 4 jours par semaine pour réaliser les tournages chez nos clients. 3. Montage et post-production Assurer le montage des vidéos et leur adaptation aux différents formats. Sélectionner les meilleures séquences, travailler le rythme et soigner les détails visuels. Organiser et suivre les étapes de montage, en garantissant le respect des délais et des attentes clients. 4. Suivi, coordination et relation client Participer au suivi des stratégies de contenu définies pour les clients. Travailler en binôme avec le Content Creator Junior et coordonner les différentes étapes de production. Être force de proposition et contribuer à faire évoluer la qualité créative des contenus de l'agence. Développer une relation de confiance avec les clients, en étant leur interlocuteur privilégié lors des tournages et en assurant un suivi de qualité. Créer un lien humain fort avec les clients, comprendre leurs attentes et leurs univers, et savoir s'adapter à leurs personnalités. Représenter l'agence auprès de clients et de personnalités de premier plan, parfois connues, et contribuer à construire des relations professionnelles durables. La relation client est une dimension essentielle du poste : votre capacité à créer du lien, à instaurer la confiance et à faire vivre une expérience agréable à nos clients contribuera directement à la réussite des projets. Le profil que nous recherchons Nous recherchons avant tout une personne créative, organisée, rigoureuse et à l'aise sur le terrain , capable de passer rapidement d'un univers client à un autre. Vous vous reconnaissez dans les points suivants : Vous avez une expérience en création de contenu vidéo, tournage et montage. Vous maîtrisez la captation vidéo, notamment avec un iPhone, et connaissez les codes des réseaux sociaux. Vous possédez un véritable œil esthétique et savez identifier les images qui valorisent un lieu, un produit ou une expérience. Vous êtes extrêmement organisé(e), rigoureux(se) et capable de gérer plusieurs productions en parallèle. Vous savez produire du contenu en volume sans sacrifier la qualité. Vous avez un excellent relationnel et êtes à l'aise pour représenter l'agence auprès de clients exigeants. Vous aimez créer du lien, instaurer une relation de confiance et entretenir des relations professionnelles de qualité. Vous soignez votre présentation et adoptez une attitude professionnelle en toutes circonstances. Vous êtes polyvalent(e), autonome et capable de vous adapter à des environnements et des interlocuteurs variés. Une expérience à l'international est un vrai plus , tout comme une sensibilité particulière aux univers de la gastronomie, de l'hôtellerie haut de gamme, du luxe et de l'art de vivre. Ce que nous proposons Localisation : Paris, secteur Saint-Lazare et Paris-centre Présence terrain : environ 3 à 4 jours par semaine chez nos clients pour les tournages. Déplacements professionnels : environ 3 jours par mois , avec des nuitées à prévoir selon les tournages. Vous rejoindrez une agence en plein développement, au sein de laquelle vous pourrez participer à des projets variés, rencontrer de belles maisons et contribuer directement à la qualité des productions. Notre processus de recrutement Nous souhaitons prendre le temps de découvrir votre parcours, votre personnalité et votre potentiel créatif. Premier échange en visioconférence : un entretien de préqualification pour faire connaissance, comprendre votre parcours, vos expériences et vos motivations. Mise en situation : si ce premier échange est concluant, nous vous proposerons un exercice pratique afin d'évaluer votre créativité, votre sens de l'image, votre maîtrise de la vidéo et votre capacité à produire du contenu. Vérification des références : nous pourrons échanger avec certaines de vos précédentes expériences professionnelles. Entretien final avec le CEO : une dernière rencontre pour échanger sur votre vision du poste et votre envie de rejoindre Culinary Agency. Vous avez envie de mettre votre créativité au service de la gastronomie et de belles maisons ? Nous avons hâte de vous rencontrer et de vous accueillir dans notre brigade ! title: Manager Service Operations & AI
description: Ben jij een ervaren IT Operations Manager die niet alleen een supportorganisatie kan aansturen, maar ook kansen ziet om dienstverlening slimmer en efficiënter te maken met AI? Dan hebben wij een interessante uitdaging voor je. Voor Fivespark, een ambitieuze Managed Service Provider in Amstelveen, zoeken wij een Manager Service Operations & AI. In deze veelzijdige functie combineer je operationeel leiderschap met procesverbetering, automatisering en de verdere ontwikkeling van een eigen AI-agent. Je krijgt de verantwoordelijkheid over een team van 12 supportprofessionals én speelt een belangrijke rol in de transformatie naar een steeds verder geautomatiseerde IT-dienstverlening. Over Fivespark Fivespark is een innovatieve Managed Service Provider die bedrijven en overheden ondersteunt met moderne IT-oplossingen. De organisatie werkt aan de Managed Service Provider van de toekomst, waarin automatisering, kunstmatige intelligentie en datagedreven processen een steeds grotere rol spelen. Een belangrijk onderdeel hiervan is Sparkle, een intern ontwikkelde AI-agent die nu al ondersteunt bij ticketregistratie, triage, klantvragen en routering. De ambitie is om Sparkle verder te ontwikkelen tot een volwaardige digitale collega die steeds meer operationele processen zelfstandig en betrouwbaar kan uitvoeren. De organisatie kenmerkt zich door korte lijnen, een informele werksfeer en veel ruimte voor eigen initiatief en verantwoordelijkheid. Wat ga je doen? Als Manager Service Operations & AI ben je verantwoordelijk voor de dagelijkse aansturing en verdere professionalisering van de tweedelijns supportorganisatie. Tegelijkertijd speel je een centrale rol in het ontwikkelen en implementeren van AI en automatisering. Je werkzaamheden bestaan uit vier belangrijke onderdelen. Leidinggeven aan de supportorganisatie Je geeft leiding aan een team van 12 tweedelijns supportmedewerkers. Je coacht en ontwikkelt medewerkers en zorgt voor duidelijke prioriteiten, structuur en samenwerking. Je bewaakt de kwaliteit, capaciteit, continuïteit en prestaties van de dienstverlening. Je signaleert knelpunten en vertaalt deze naar concrete verbeteracties. Doorontwikkelen van AI-agent Sparkle Je bent functioneel eigenaar van Sparkle en bepaalt mede de visie, roadmap en prioriteiten. Je vertaalt operationele uitdagingen naar praktische AI-toepassingen. Je zorgt ervoor dat Sparkle veilig, betrouwbaar en gebruiksvriendelijk functioneert. Je werkt samen met technische specialisten aan de verdere ontwikkeling van deze digitale collega. Processen verbeteren en automatiseren Je analyseert bestaande operationele processen en identificeert mogelijkheden voor automatisering. Je optimaliseert workflows, kennisbanken en werkinstructies. Je zorgt voor een goede samenwerking tussen medewerkers en AI. Je draagt bij aan de ambitie om minimaal 75% van de standaard operationele processen met AI te ondersteunen of volledig te automatiseren. Verandering begeleiden Je werkt samen met Operations, Software Development, Business Consultancy en externe partners. Je begeleidt medewerkers in de overgang naar een meer AI-gedreven manier van werken. Je creëert draagvlak, communiceert helder en zorgt ervoor dat veranderingen daadwerkelijk worden doorgevoerd. Wie zoeken wij? Wij zoeken een operationeel sterke manager die structuur weet aan te brengen, medewerkers kan motiveren en tegelijkertijd vooruitkijkt naar de mogelijkheden van nieuwe technologie. Je begrijpt hoe een IT-supportorganisatie werkt, weet hoe je processen beheersbaar en voorspelbaar maakt en krijgt energie van het continu verbeteren van de dienstverlening. Daarnaast beschik je over: Hbo- of wo-werk- en -denkniveau. Minimaal 5 jaar ervaring binnen Managed Services, ICT Operations of IT Service Management. Ervaring met het aansturing, coachen en ontwikkelen van operationele teams. Goede kennis van ITIL-processen en servicemanagement. Affiniteit met AI, automatisering en digitale innovatie. Sterke analytische en organisatorische vaardigheden. Het vermogen om technische mogelijkheden te vertalen naar concrete operationele verbeteringen. Goede communicatieve vaardigheden en ervaring met verandermanagement. Je hoeft geen AI-developer te zijn. We zoeken juist iemand die begrijpt hoe je AI en automatisering succesvol inzet binnen een operationele IT-organisatie en medewerkers hierin weet mee te nemen. Wat kun je verwachten? Je komt rechtstreeks in dienst bij onze opdrachtgever en krijgt een sleutelrol binnen een organisatie die volop investeert in de toekomst van IT-dienstverlening. Je kunt rekenen op: Een bruto maandsalaris van €4.487 tot €6.494, afhankelijk van kennis en ervaring. Een mobiliteitsbudget van €850 per maand, vrij in te zetten op de manier die bij jou past. Een fulltime dienstverband. Flexibele werkmogelijkheden en ruimte om hybride te werken. Veel zelfstandigheid en directe invloed op de ontwikkeling van de organisatie. Ruime mogelijkheden voor persoonlijke en professionele ontwikkeling. De kans om actief bij te dragen aan innovatieve AI- en automatiseringsprojecten. Een informele en professionele werkomgeving met korte lijnen. Een betrokken team van collega's dat samenwerkt aan verbetering en innovatie. Waarom is dit een interessante functie? Wat deze rol bijzonder maakt, is de combinatie van peoplemanagement, operationele verantwoordelijkheid en AI-innovatie. Je krijgt niet alleen de opdracht om een bestaande supportorganisatie goed te laten functioneren, maar ook om deze klaar te maken voor de toekomst. Daarbij krijg je de ruimte om processen structureel te verbeteren, nieuwe technologie toe te passen en daadwerkelijk invloed uit te oefenen op de manier waarop IT-dienstverlening wordt georganiseerd. Een mooie uitdaging voor een ervaren Service Delivery Manager, IT Operations Manager of Support Manager die toe is aan een volgende stap. Interesse? Wil jij leidinggeven aan een IT-supportorganisatie én een belangrijke rol spelen in de verdere ontwikkeling van AI binnen Managed Services? Dan komen wij graag met je in contact! title: Manager Architect Cloud - Paris
description: <p><strong>Présentation du poste :</strong></p> <p>Concevoir une architecture d’IA, c’est engager une entreprise pour plusieurs années : l’emplacement des données, la gestion des accès, la manière dont un agent passe en production sous le regard des équipes de sécurité. Ces choix structurants, vous les construisez avec nos clients.</p> <p>Tout le reste, ce sont les ambitions fonctionnelles et techniques du client, son cadre réglementaire, son budget, les compétences qu'il peut réellement mobiliser en interne, la gouvernance qu'il veut installer, et un écosystème d'éditeurs qui gravite autour de lui. Votre rôle est de trouver le point d'équilibre entre ces forces, de le faire accepter, puis de le réajuster dès que l'une d'elles bouge.</p> <p>Votre point de départ n’est pas la technologie, mais l’ambition métier. Vous la traduisez en une plateforme data ou agentique pensée pour s’intégrer au système d’information existant, avec son histoire, ses contraintes et ses équipes. Votre rôle ne s’arrête pas à la validation du schéma cible : vous accompagnez les équipes de delivery jusqu’à la mise en production.</p> <p>À titre d’exemple, chez l’un de nos clients, chaque nouvel agent repose désormais sur une plateforme commune qui gère nativement les droits d’accès, le monitoring et les coûts. Chaque cas d’usage s’appuie ainsi sur les fondations posées pour les précédents.</p> <p>Ce poste s’adresse à vous si vous aimez embrasser un système dans son ensemble, prendre les décisions qui engagent et en expliquer les raisons.</p> <p>Artefact est le partenaire de confiance des plus grandes entreprises mondiales pour déployer l’IA : 3 000 AI makers dans plus de 30 pays, plus de 1 000 clients. En France, vous rejoignez le département Engineering (environ 300 personnes, sous la responsabilité du CTO), au sein du chapter AI Architect.</p> <p><strong>Activités et responsabilités :</strong></p> <p>Sur un projet, vous travaillez en étroite collaboration avec les AI Applied Engineers, qui construisent et font tourner ce que vous concevez, et avec les AI Product Managers, qui portent le produit avec le client.</p> <p>Côté client, deux publics sont à convaincre : les directions métier, avec lesquelles vous définissez la cible, et les équipes IT, sécurité, réseau et exploitation, sans l’adhésion desquelles rien ne passe en production. Une architecture qu’elles n’ont pas validée ne dépasse pas le stade du document. Vous êtes aussi l'interlocuteur des achats, de la conformité et des éditeurs qui veulent se positionner.</p> <p>Au sein du chapter, vous relisez les designs de vos pairs, contribuez à faire grandir les architectes et les profils d’ingénierie qui vous entourent, et mettez en commun ce qui fonctionne. Vous travaillez également avec nos partenaires technologiques et les autres équipes d’Artefact.</p> <p><strong>Vos responsabilités :</strong></p> <ul> <li>Traduire les objectifs, les contraintes et les délais du client en une architecture que le métier comme l’IT comprennent, et défendre vos choix devant eux.</li> <li>Concevoir des plateformes data et agentiques, on premise, dans le cloud ou en hybride.</li> <li>Découper les périmètres techniques en fonction de la façon dont les équipes du client sont organisées.</li> <li>Arbitrer entre les options en pesant leur valeur métier, leur coût total, leur conformité, leur dépendance à un éditeur et la capacité du client à les faire vivre.</li> <li>Aider le client à évaluer et à mettre en concurrence des éditeurs, sans parti pris.</li> <li>Préparer les propositions commerciales : cadrer la solution, la chiffrer et construire la roadmap de delivery.</li> <li>Tenir la ligne  pendant le delivery : relire les designs, trancher les arbitrages et réajuster la cible quand le contexte du client change.</li> <li>Faire vivre les patterns de référence et les bonnes pratiques du chapter, et suivre de près les évolutions de l’IA, du cloud et de la data.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Profil recherché :</strong></p> <p>Nous recherchons une personne qui pense comme un consultant et raisonne comme un ingénieur. title: Data Center Operations Engineer
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><p><strong>Available Locations: Boston, MA | Dallas, TX | Salt Lake City, UT  (This role requires you to be onsite 5 days a week in one of our locations)</strong></p> <h1>About the Department</h1> <p>Infrastructure Operations builds and manages the data center infrastructure behind Cloudflare's global network. The organization brings together engineering, operations, hardware and logistics teams that plan, deploy, operate and maintain our footprint in hundreds of cities worldwide. In this role, you'll help extend that footprint with a new generation of data center sites across the United States.</p> <h1>About the Role</h1> <p>We're looking for Data Center Engineers to be the hands, eyes and judgment on the ground at our new sites. title: Founding Strategy & Operations
description: Alassio recherche son (sa) prochain(e) Founding Strategy & Operations ! Missions 🏗️ Alassio en quelques mots En France, la paie et le social comptent parmi les fonctions les plus réglementées qui soient. Entre inflation réglementaire et évolutions légales et conventionnelles incessantes, la conformité est devenue un véritable fardeau pour les cabinets de paie et les services RH : ce fardeau les empêche de se consacrer à ce qui compte vraiment, le conseil et l'accompagnement des salariés, qui en subissent donc eux aussi le poids ; c'est aussi l'un des métiers où l'attrition est la plus forte en France, notamment parce que 60 % du temps des gestionnaires de paie est encore consacré à de la saisie ou à de la relecture manuelle. Pourtant, des solutions technologiques majeures existent : l'IA permet en particulier d'automatiser une très grande partie des tâches les plus pénibles et de valoriser les données sociales. Mais le secteur reste largement à l'écart de cette révolution, et le problème n'est pas seulement réglementaire : le marché était verrouillé par des éditeurs historiques vieillissants, difficiles à quitter faute d'alternative crédible et de moyens pour migrer efficacement. Là aussi, l'IA fait voler ces barrières en éclats et ouvre la voie à une vague d'innovation attendue depuis des décennies. C'est pour y répondre qu'Alassio construit la plateforme de paie et de gestion RH moderne qui manquait à ce marché , au service des cabinets et de leurs clients TPE/PME. Notre ambition est de développer en un temps record : une plateforme collaborative et ouverte , qui s'intègre nativement aux outils des cabinets et de leurs clients, respecte leurs habitudes de travail et fluidifie les échanges entre gestionnaires de paie et entreprises ; l'automatisation de la tenue administrative : collecte des données, paramétrage des évolutions légales et des règles propres à chaque entreprise, génération automatique des rapports et formulaires, traçabilité juridique dynamique et en temps réel, etc. ; la valorisation des données de paie et sociales , pour offrir un conseil social à 360° et enfin répondre efficacement à l'ensemble des attentes des salariés, qui se sont de surcroît largement amplifiées depuis le Covid : gestion contractuelle, pilotage de la masse salariale, avantages salariés, fidélisation des talents, mutuelle… L'objectif : devenir le « People OS » sur lequel les cabinets et leurs clients TPE/PME s'appuient pour gérer l'intégralité de leurs problématiques paie et RH. 🚀 Tes responsabilités Ta mission est de concevoir et faire vivre les systèmes de fonctionnement d'Alassio . Concrètement, tu identifies partout dans l'entreprise ce qui empêche les équipes de travailler à l'échelle (un process défaillant ou absent, un passage de relais flou, une information introuvable, une tâche répétitive que personne n'a pris le temps d'automatiser) et tu le résous de bout en bout : un diagnostic précis, puis un cahier des charges documenté et actionnable, puis l'accompagnement de sa mise en œuvre jusqu'à son adoption effective par les équipes. Une solution que personne n'utilise n'est pas une solution. Tes leviers sont aussi bien managériaux (formalisme interne, rituels, répartition des responsabilités) que produit et techniques (modèle de données, outillage, automatisation des flux de travail), avec un parti pris constant : « Just build it ». Tu mettras en place, avec les équipes concernées, des solutions actionnables et des systèmes qui tournent. 🧭 Tes premiers chantiers Pour te donner une idée concrète, voici le type de chantiers que tu pourrais mener dans tes six premiers mois : Bâtir un réseau national de formateurs et d'intégrateurs certifiés , pour permettre aux cabinets de se former partout en France sans saturer nos équipes à chaque pic de déploiement : modèle économique et tarification, maillage du territoire avec les Sales, parcours de certification et suivi qualité avec l'équipe DnA (Déploiement & Accompagnement), cadre contractuel, et circuit de remontée des demandes des cabinets vers le support et le Product. En bref, tu contribueras à mettre sur pied une place de marché d'intégrateurs et de formateurs Alassio. Fluidifier le parcours d'un cabinet, de la signature à la production : formaliser les passages de relais entre les squads Sales, DnA, Métier & Juridique et Tech (ce qui est transmis, dans quel outil, dans quel délai, et qui tranche en cas de blocage). Ce travail se traduit par la mise en place de workflows au sein de Bedrock, notre OS interne : il rend l'ensemble du contexte d'Alassio interrogeable et permet de transformer quasi instantanément une solution que tu as formalisée en gain concret pour toute l'équipe. Améliorer en profondeur, en coordination étroite avec l'AI Engineer, notre OS Bedrock pour en faire le réflexe par défaut de toutes les équipes : identifier les cas d'usage transverses à plus fort impact, structurer le contexte métier qui alimente l'OS, travailler sur l'hébergement et la dimension collaborative, mettre en place des workflows d'agents déclenchés par événement, tenir à jour le catalogue des commandes, et mettre en place le suivi qui mesure la performance et l'adoption. Profil recherché 🌱 Expérience Au moins 2 ans d'expérience dans des rôles opérationnels (GTM, Ops) ou en conseil en stratégie , idéalement avec une dimension technique, dans des contextes où tu as vu la structure d'une équipe évoluer vite (par exemple une scale-up, ou une refonte organisationnelle chez des clients en conseil) Une compréhension fine des goulots d'étranglement organisationnels et informationnels qui ralentissent les entreprises à mesure qu'elles grandissent, et des transformations que l'IA est en train d'y opérer Le goût des défis techniques et un esprit très analytique, sans perdre ton profil généraliste : tes expériences t'ont amené(e) à croiser les expertises, entre commercial et technique, produit et métier 💎 Qualités Un goût pour l'optimisation et l'organisation : tu aimes que les choses soient claires, que l'information soit facile à mobiliser, propre et maintenable, et tu prends plaisir à produire vite des éléments actionnables Un biais très fort pour l'action : tu repères les problèmes avant qu'on te les signale, et tu ne t'arrêtes jamais au diagnostic Penser à l'échelle : tu conçois dès le départ des solutions capables d'encaisser des montées en charge ×10 ou ×100, tout en restant pragmatique sur ce qui compte à court et moyen terme Processus de sélection Premier entretien avec Tancrède (CEO) : 45 min Étude de cas à partir de situations réelles, à dominante métier, avec Tancrède , Maxime (Head of Sales) et Alexandre (Responsable DnA) : 1 h30 Étude de cas à partir de situations réelles, à dominante technique, avec Hector (COO) et Paul Rousseau (Founding SWE) : 1 h30 Rencontre informelle de l'équipe dans nos bureaux, puis échange séparé avec les fondateurs Deux à troise prises de référence Ce que nous offrons 👊 Une mission unique Tu rejoins une aventure entrepreneuriale en plein passage à l'échelle, sur un marché verrouillé depuis des années. Notre conviction : les bons process libèrent les équipes, les mauvais les étouffent. Ton rôle est précisément de concevoir les premiers, pour que chaque équipe d'Alassio aille plus vite, avec l'ambition assumée de bâtir une référence en matière d'organisation nativement construite autour de l'IA. Le poste a vocation à grandir avec l'entreprise : selon tes envies et ce que tu auras construit, il pourra évoluer vers la direction des opérations, la structuration d'une nouvelle fonction ou le lancement d'une nouvelle activité. 🎁 Rémunération et avantages 💰 Package de 60 à 70K€ + BSPCE 🏥 Mutuelle Alan 🍽️ Carte Swile (titres-restaurant) 💻 Matériel informatique haut de gamme (MacOS, écran incurvé) 🤓 Offsite légendaires ➡️ Prochaines étapes Si la mission te parle, postule via le formulaire de candidature. description: Learning & Adoption Specialist (CDD de 12 mois) Lieu : Paris, France (hybride, trois jours par semaine au bureau) Niveau : senior Équipe : Client Delivery EMEA Contrat : CDD de 12 mois Rattachement : Operating Model Design Lead À noter : Ce poste nécessite un droit au travail déjà acquis dans l’UE. Nous ne pouvons pas proposer de sponsoring de visa, mais nous étudions la question poste par poste : gardez un œil sur notre site carrières pour les opportunités à venir. Merci de postuler en anglais. À propos de Kaluza Kaluza est l’Energy Intelligence Platform : nous transformons la complexité de l’énergie en coordination fluide. Nous aidons les acteurs de l’énergie à relever les défis d’aujourd’hui tout en accélérant la transition vers un avenir propre et électrifié. Notre plateforme orchestre des millions de décisions en temps réel entre les foyers, les équipements, les marchés et les réseaux. title: Senior AI Engineer - Search & Recommendation - Patient Team (x/f/m)
description: Join our mission, join Doctolib! We are looking for a Senior AI Engineer to join the Patient team in Paris. The Patient domain sits at the heart of Doctolib's mission: ensuring everyone has better access to the care they need, receives better care from health professionals, and can actively prevent health problems to improve their wellbeing. You’ll design the search and recommendation engines behind our health companion, helping 100M patients across Europe instantly navigate to the exact care they need while delivering trusted, curated insights at every step. The retrieval and recommendation architecture you own will directly shape how relevant, fast, and trustworthy that experience is for every one of them. Your responsibilities include but are not limited to: Design and build the production search & recommendation architecture: full retrieval, ranking, reranking pipeline with standard and off-the-shelf components (vector search, semantic retrieval, LLM/managed rerankers). Establish strong baselines first (prompts, RAG, model selection) before reaching for custom ML. Build evaluation and observability into every stage, with offline and online evaluation. Set up the data/event feedback loops that drive iteration and feed deeper ML later. Improve search relevance and ranking on Patient facing products , raising result quality Own production quality: latency reliability, monitoring, and maintainability. Partner with ML Engineers and collaborate closely with PMs and SWEs to define, build, and ship AI-powered features that deliver measurable value to users and the business. Who you are Before you read on: if you don't have the exact profile described below, but you feel this job description matches your skill set, we still encourage you to apply. You could be our next team mate if you have: Production deployment : ability to ship algorithms to production (ECS-based service on AWS) Strong analytical mindset: r esult-oriented, patient-first approach Significant experience as a Software or/and AI engineer shipping search or recommendation systems to production. Hands-on experience building end-to-end retrieval: ranking, reranking pipelines and familiar with nDCG, MAP, Recall@k, MRR AI-engineering proficiency : turning foundation models and off-the-shelf components into production systems: embeddings & vector search, semantic retrieval, RAG, LLM-based or managed rerankers (e.g. Vertex AI). You can succeed without training a model from scratch Architecture-first approach : you build the system, baselines, evals, and feedback loops with standard tooling before reaching for custom ML, and know when to partner with ML Engineers to break a ceiling Evaluation & observability built into every stage (retrieval, ranker, reranker) — offline and online eval, A/B testing, position-bias handling, monitoring Production deployment — ability to ship reliable, low-latency services to production (hundreds-of-ms SLAs), with care for data quality and long-term maintainability Now, it would be fantastic if you: Experience at a B2C marketplace (e-commerce, hospitality, travel) Additional ML methodologies: pattern mining, recommendation systems, experimentation, or causal inference Have experience with search engines or information retrieval concepts Have exposure to learning-to-rank or feature engineering (for breaking ceilings later, alongside ML Engineers) Have experience in a healthcare or other regulated domain (GDPR / HDS) Life at Doctolib Tech Our solutions are built on a single, fully cloud-native platform that supports web and mobile app interfaces, multiple languages, and is adapted to country and healthcare specialty requirements. Our stack is composed of Rails, TypeScript, Java, Python, Kotlin, Swift, and React Native. We leverage AI ethically across our products to empower patients and health professionals. Discover our AI vision here . We also invest in open, applied AI research. For example, our DoctoBERT project introduces open-source medical language models trained for French clinical text, with applications in named entity recognition, classification, and retrieval. Read the DoctoBERT practical guide to learn more about how we bring deep AI research into practical healthcare applications. Want to learn more about our tech culture and environment? Visit the Doctolib Tech site . title: Product Design Director - Patient (x/f/m)
description: Product Design Director - Patient (x/f/m) The opportunity Doctolib is a mission-driven healthcare technology company, founded in Paris in 2013. Today, nearly 3,000 people work across Europe to transform the way healthcare is delivered and experienced. More than 500,000 healthcare professionals use Doctolib’s solutions, and the patient app is used by approximately 90 million people across Europe. For patients, Doctolib began as a simple way to find a healthcare professional and book an appointment. We are now building something much more ambitious: an AI-powered Health Companion that helps people navigate care, understand their health and take the right next step throughout their health journey. This means moving beyond a primarily transactional product towards an experience that supports patients before, during and after care, through access to care, health information, patient data, messaging, recommendations, care plans and AI-powered assistance. We are looking for a Product Design Director to help define what this next generation of patient experience should look and feel like. What you will build and lead As Product Design Director, Patient , you will own the design vision and quality bar for Doctolib’s patient experience. You will report to our VP Design and work closely with the Product, Engineering, Medical, Data and Business leadership teams. Your scope will cover the full patient journey, including: access to care, search and booking; patient messaging and teleconsultation; the Patient Health Record and patient context; the app homepage and daily health experience; health content and prevention; recommendations, reminders and care plans; new patient services and subscription experiences; conversational and AI-powered experiences. The current team includes six Senior Product Designers and one Senior Content Designer . You will lead, coach and develop this team while shaping the organisation and operating model needed to support the next phase of the Patient product. Your mandate You will: Define and drive the design vision for the Patient stream, from a high-traffic booking experience to a trusted Health Companion used throughout the health journey. Bridge two equally important challenges: continuing to improve the core access-to-care experience while creating new reasons for patients to return beyond booking. Raise the quality bar for product design, interaction design and content across the patient experience. Stay close enough to the product and the craft to make high-quality design decisions, not only set direction from a distance. Shape AI-native experiences that are clear, useful and trustworthy, including recommendations, conversational interfaces and next-best actions. Establish strong design principles for transparency, explainability, uncertainty, user control and safe escalation in a healthcare context. Build a high-performing design organisation, including hiring, coaching, talent development and second-line leadership. Create effective ways of working across Design, Product, Engineering, Medical, Data and Business. Help scale a coherent experience across countries, languages and different healthcare contexts. Connect design decisions to user behaviour, product outcomes and business impact. What success looks like In your first year, you will have: established a clear and compelling design vision for the Patient stream; raised the quality bar across both core access-to-care journeys and newer Health Companion experiences; helped define a coherent interaction model for AI-powered patient experiences; strengthened collaboration between Design, Product, Engineering and Medical; developed a clear operating model and growth plan for the Patient Design organisation; helped Doctolib increase the value and relevance of the patient experience beyond appointment booking. What we are looking for You are likely to bring: Significant experience leading Product Design, 10+ years in product design including 3+ years in people leadership.. Experience in a consumer product organisation, ideally one used by millions of people. A track record of designing and scaling products across multiple markets, with an understanding of localisation, cultural differences and the balance between global consistency and local relevance. Experience managing at least five Product Designers, ideally a larger organisation including senior individual contributors and managers. Strong product design craft and creative judgement. You can recognise excellent work, make difficult quality trade-offs and stay close enough to the details to raise the standard of the product. Experience connecting design choices to measurable outcomes such as adoption, conversion, engagement, retention, satisfaction or user behaviour. A strong and practical understanding of AI-native product experiences. You have thought deeply about how AI changes interaction design, user expectations, trust, transparency and control. Experience designing with uncertainty, recommendations, personalisation or conversational interfaces is highly relevant. The ability to operate across complex products and stakeholders, while maintaining clarity and momentum. A concise and compelling communication style. You can articulate a clear point of view, align senior stakeholders and inspire teams to move in a new direction. Experience in healthcare or another regulated, trust-sensitive environment is valuable, but healthcare experience is not required. What matters is your respect for domain expertise and your ability to design responsibly in high-stakes contexts. Fluency in English. French or German would be a strong plus. A working style aligned with the Doctolib Playbook: User First, Medical Expertise, Forefront of Innovation, Bold, Drive, Passion, Humility. Why Doctolib, why now? Doctolib gives you the opportunity to work on a consumer product with significant reach, strong European scale and a mission that matters. The patient product already has a large and engaged audience. The next challenge is to make the experience more useful, more contextual and more present in people’s everyday health journeys. You will join at a defining moment: Doctolib is moving from appointment booking towards continuous health support. AI is becoming a core part of the product experience, not an isolated feature. The Patient Design organisation is being strengthened and reshaped. The product must work across multiple European countries, languages and healthcare systems. The design foundations for the next chapter are still being built. This is an opportunity to shape a new category at the intersection of consumer product design, healthcare and AI , and to define how people will discover, understand and manage their health in the future. Doctolib is an equal opportunity employer. We believe diverse teams build better products and improve healthcare for more people. We welcome applications regardless of gender, religion, age, sexual orientation, ethnicity, disability or place of origin. You will work on the foundational layer that powers Consultation Assistant, Phone Assistant, Health Companion, and more: a shared agent runtime, a unified GenAI gateway, and the observability and evaluation infrastructure that makes it all trustworthy — contributing directly to safer, faster, and more reliable AI for patients and care teams across Europe. title: Medior/Senior Full Stack Developer
description: Do you want to work in a dynamic environment where your code really makes a difference? Are you a passionate developer who enjoys tackling complex technical challenges? Join the Customer Champions team and create a world-class app in which all the value of the Momo platform comes together. Help us create reusable, and above all, user-friendly components and interactions that make caregivers love the app. Who is Momo? Momo Medical is a fast-growing and ambitious scale-up, tackling one of the biggest societal challenges: the future of elderly care. Over the next decade, demand for care is expected to double, while 30% of the current workforce is projected to retire. Our innovative solutions aim to reduce the pressure on healthcare workers while improving the quality of care for residents. The most valuable aspects of the role 🚀 Your work defines the way caregivers interact with the app as well as how it looks . All while staying in very close contact with them to understand exactly what they need. ⚓ Work together with many teams , such as production, customer success, and hardware, to translate real-world problems into reliable software. 💛 You contribute to better care for nursing home residents and help reduce the workload for healthcare professionals . 📍 You’re available 32 - 40 hours per week and happy to spend at least 4 days per week with the team in Delft. 🎊 Thursday pizza nights, Friday drinks, team activities, travel allowance, pension plan, and plenty of growth opportunities that match your ambitions. Your key responsibilities As part of a multidisciplinary team you will work on innovative solutions that have a direct impact on healthcare professionals in the Netherlands and abroad. You will have the opportunity to develop your skills, specialize or grow into a team leader role. You can work on the front-end or the back-end, or even better: both! Your key responsibilities include: Maintain and improve the connection between business logic and UI in our Flutter app by employing Bloc and Clean Architecture. Design, build, and maintain TypeScript services that drive the app to thousands of phones simultaneously. . Design event-driven systems that provide the app with the freshest data possible Automate manual workflows and improve reliability through observability, testing, and CI/CD. Mentor teammates, set technical direction, and help prioritize the roadmap. Who are you? You have an advanced skill set of Flutter, Node, and TypeScript , backed by a track record of delivering full-stack features end-to-end in fast-paced environments. You validate your features with automated tests , ranging from unit-tests to fully automated widget tests and end-to-end tests. You’re comfortable modelling data and tuning performance in relational databases such as PostgreSQL. A good level of English is required, and it is a plus if you can speak Dutch. You enjoy collaborating with colleagues across the company and keeping multiple initiatives moving forward. Y ou’re available 32–40 hours per week and happy to spend at least four days a week with the team in Delft. Why join Momo Medical? Because you want to make a difference in healthcare at home and abroad. Because you are excited about a fast-growing scale-up where no two days are the same. And because you want to work with young, enthusiastic and talented international colleagues who all work hard to make healthcare a little bit better every day. Salary: €4,000–5,000 (medior) or €5,000–6,000 (senior) per month based on 40 hours, plus 8% holiday allowance. 30 vacation days per year to pick your own holidays (celebrate Christmas, Eid Al-Fitr, or any other holiday of your choice!). Hybrid working, and a laptop of your choice. Pension plan and travel reimbursement Guided mentorship and clear paths toward tech lead or specialist roles. Provided lunches, weekly company drinks and dinners, and regular team and company events. Reimbursement of travel expenses and a pension plan Good to know Tech at Momo At Momo, we use the following tools: Flutter, Swift, Kotlin, JavaScript, React, TypeScript, Express, Vitest, Node, PostgreSQL, Docker, Testcontainers, GitHub, and AWS. After that, you’ll receive a short take-home assignment that helps us understand how you think, and you get insights into the kind of work we do at Momo. The next step is a chat at our offices in Delft, where we can go more in-depth on the role, the team and the Momo culture. Then, as a final exploration, you’ll have the chance to spend a work-along day with us to experience a day at Momo and to meet more people working on the same mission. When both you and we see the match, we’ll share an offer and start the onboarding process so you can join us in supporting caregivers! Find more English Speaking Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

title: Senior China Research Analyst
description: Datenna is a fast-growing tech scale-up combining cutting-edge OSINT and AI technologies to provide governments with critical insights into China's techno-economic landscape. Our platform transforms open-source intelligence into actionable insights through advanced data processing and analysis. The Role: Do you enjoy turning complex data into strategic insights that drive critical decisions? As a Senior China Research Analyst, you will lead analytical research projects for our government clients. You'll turn their most pressing questions about China's technology, industrial, and defence-industrial landscape into data-driven reports and the datasets behind them. You'll work with Datenna's data on patents, procurement, research funding, and companies, and go beyond it when a question demands, to find the patterns and connections that inform high-stakes policy and security decisions. You'll independently manage several client research projects at a time, from scoping through final delivery, using both qualitative and quantitative analysis across China's corporate, academic, defence, and technology sectors. Client questions often start ambiguous and open-ended, and topics range widely, from advanced materials to semiconductors and aerospace. You'll work through uncertainty, get up to speed quickly on unfamiliar technologies, design creative analytical approaches when the path isn't obvious, and refine your research direction as new information emerges. The role needs strong China expertise, Chinese-language research skills, the ability to work autonomously, and clear communication with senior government stakeholders. Your mission at Datenna: Lead end-to-end research delivery: Take full ownership of research projects, from initial scoping and analysis through to final deliverables. Design the research: Turn open-ended client questions into sound research design, and build new analytical frameworks when standard methods don't fit. Build and analyse the evidence base: Work directly with Chinese-language sources and Datenna's data on entities, patents, procurement, and research funding to map the actors, links, and trends that answer the client's question. Set the quality bar: Review colleagues' deliverables independently, verify findings against the underlying data, and guide Analysts on their research approach. Work with AI, with judgement: Use AI-assisted research tools to work faster and at greater scale. You own the interpretation and verify every output. Contribute to the China Research Lab: The Lab is our exploratory research track. It develops the methods, tools, and data sources that shape where China research at Datenna is heading, and tests them through internal R&D. You will dedicate part of your time to Lab initiatives, such as prototyping a new analytical approach, scouting and testing new sources, or contributing to webinars and publications. Strengthen the data and product: Turn what you learn on client projects into data and product improvements, working with the Product and Data teams. What makes you a great candidate: Core requirements Experience: 5–8 years of professional experience in China-focused research, analysis, or related fields. Deep China expertise: Strong knowledge of Chinese industry, economy, policy, the defence-industrial base, and the technology and research landscape. Analytical excellence: Exceptional pattern recognition and analytical skills to connect the dots between corporate, state, and military actors in China's techno-economic landscape. Comfort with ambiguity: Proven ability to tackle research questions where the analytical path isn't predetermined, designing creative approaches and adapting as you learn. Chinese language proficiency: Professional reading proficiency in Chinese (minimum HSK5, HSK6 preferred) to work directly with Chinese-language sources such as technical literature, patents, procurement notices, and policy documents, and to build and verify Chinese technical terminology for data retrieval. Self-directed project management: Proven ability to independently break down complex research questions, run several multi-week projects in parallel against fixed client deadlines, and deliver high-quality output with minimal oversight. Quality ownership: An evidence-first approach. You trace every claim back to its source records, catch inconsistencies in data and drafts, and review others' work independently and constructively. Communication skills: Strong written and verbal communication, including precise, concise English writing for an international readership. You are comfortable presenting complex analysis to senior government stakeholders and refining requirements through client dialogue. Methodological versatility: Proficiency in both qualitative and quantitative research methods. Technical skills Working proficiency in SQL and/or Python to query, clean, and structure large datasets, plus advanced Excel. Hands-on experience using LLM-based tools in research, with a clear sense of where their output needs human verification. Familiarity with data-quality work such as deduplication and entity resolution. Nice to have Experience in the technology, science, and research sector within governmental organisations, think tanks, or international corporate settings. Background conducting research for external clients or stakeholders. Experience analysing patents, public procurement, research funding, or corporate registry data. Experience collecting web data from Chinese-language sources, or with BI tools such as Metabase. A technical or scientific background (for example materials science, engineering, or physics) relevant to dual-use technology topics. *Please know that applicants may be subject to a screening process.* Work on globally impactful projects in geopolitical intelligence Lead innovation in OSINT and AI technologies Competitive compensation and benefits Dynamic, international team environment Significant growth opportunities in a scale-up When you apply to this position, we will process your personal data according to our Recruitment Privacy Notice . undocumented knowledge by documenting and simplifying legacy systems.</li> <li value="3">Partner with engineering managers and product teams to identify workflow pain points and turn them into well-scoped, measurable improvements.</li> <li value="4">Work with data to show whether changes improve engineering health, and use it to prioritize.</li> <li value="5">Mentor intermediate engineers Engineering.</li> <li value="7">Monitor the health of production systems, troubleshoot incidents, and contribute to root cause analysis.</li> <li value="8">Use artificial intelligence (AI) agents and end to end.</li> <li value="2">Strong proficiency in Ruby, or the ability to become productive quickly.</li> <li value="3">Experience maintaining or modernizing legacy codebases safely.</li> <li collaborative code review.</li> <li value="7">Experience using AI coding assistants to speed up development while critically reviewing their output.</li> <li value="8">Optional experience: Rails; production.</li> </ul> <h2>About the team</h2> <p>Development Health is part of Developer Experience. Our work is mostly internal, and our customers are GitLab team members across an engineering organization of hundreds of engineers.</p> <p>We're all-remote, asynchronous by default, and documentation-driven, in line with GitLab's values of collaboration, results, efficiency, diversity, inclusion and belonging, iteration, and transparency.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><h4><strong>How GitLab Supports Full-Time Employees</strong></h4> <ul> <li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/">Benefits to support your health, finances, and well-being</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/time-off-and-absence/time-off-types/#flexible-paid-time-off-pto">Flexible Paid Time Off </a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/company/culture/inclusion/tmrg-tmag/">Team Member Resource Groups</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/stock-options/">Equity Compensation & Employee Stock Purchase Plan</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/learning-and-development/growth-and-development/">Growth and Development Fund</a></li> <li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/#parental-leave">Parental Leave</a> </li> </ul> <p>Please note that we welcome interest from candidates with varying levels of experience; many successful candidates do not meet every single requirement. title: Dev Experiences and Community Lead (SF)
description: ABOUT SUPABASE Supabase is the Postgres development platform, built by developers for developers. We provide a complete backend solution including Database, Auth, Storage, Edge Functions, Realtime, and Vector Search. All services are deeply integrated and designed for growth. ABOUT THE ROLE Supabase is looking for a Dev Experiences and Community Lead (SF) to help grow and scale our developer community initiatives and industry event programs. You’ll work closely with the Head of Global Events and Field Marketing to build programs that connect Supabase with developers and the broader ecosystem. This includes initiatives such as meetups, workshops, hackathons, and community activations that bring Supabase into the spaces where developers learn, build, and collaborate. As an early member of the events team, you’ll help shape how Supabase shows up in person around the world while building the playbooks and frameworks that allow these programs to scale globally. This role sits within Field Marketing and works cross-functionally across Marketing, DevRel, Partnerships, Sales and Design to support programs that deepen developer engagement, strengthen ecosystem relationships. You will also support programming around Supabase Select, our flagship user conference, including partner and community programming connected to the event. We’re a lean, remote-first team, so this role requires someone who is comfortable operating independently, experimenting with new ideas, and helping build the systems that will power Supabase’s events program as it grows. WHAT YOU’LL DO Own and Scale Community Programs - Scale Supabase developer meetups, workshops, and hackathons globally - Partner with DevRel to align community events with product launches and developer education initiatives - Coordinate community meetups around major industry events and Launch Week - Support community programming connected to Supabase Select - Support the SupaSquad advocate network through community activations Support Industry Event Activations - Support Supabase’s presence at conferences such as AWS re:Invent, KubeCon, Stripe Sessions, Dash, and other events - Coordinate developer-focused side events, meetups, and partner activations around major conferences - Collaborate with Partnerships on co-hosted events Turn Experiments Into Scalable Programs - Build playbooks and frameworks for community and ecosystem programs - Identify opportunities to scale successful initiatives across regions - Standardizing event formats and processes as program grow Collaborate Across the Events Team - Partner with the events team on logistics and execution for community programs - Support promotion and event readiness with Marketing - Help ensure strong attendee experiences and post-event follow-up WHO YOU ARE - 5–7+ years in field marketing, developer marketing, community programs or partner marketing - Experience working with developer communities or technical audiences - Strong project management and organizational skills - Comfortable collaborating cross-functionally - Curious about developer ecosystems and the communities around modern infrastructure - Able to manage multiple initiatives in a fast-moving environment Comfortable working remotely and independently - Willing to travel for events as needed NICE TO HAVE - Experience supporting developer meetups, hackathons, or workshops - Experience with community-led growth or developer advocacy programs - Experience running ecosystem or partner-led event programs WHAT WE OFFER - Fully Remote We hire globally. We believe you can do your best work from anywhere. There are no Supabase offices, but we provide a WeWork membership or co-working allowance you can use anywhere in the world. - ESOP Every team member receives ESOP (equity ownership) in the company. We want everyone to share in the upside of what we’re building together. - Tech Allowance Use this budget to set up your ideal work environment—laptop, monitor, headphones, or whatever helps you do your best work. - Health Benefits Supabase covers 100% of health insurance for employees and 80% for dependents, wherever you are. Your wellbeing and your family’s health are important to us. - Annual Off-Sites Once a year, the entire company gathers in a new city for a week of connection, collaboration, and fun. It’s a highlight of our year. - Flexible Work We operate asynchronously and trust you to manage your own time. You know what needs to be done and when. - Professional Development Every team member receives an annual education allowance to spend on learning—courses, books, conferences, or anything that supports your growth. ABOUT THE TEAM Supabase was born-remote and open-source-first. We believe our globally distributed team is our secret weapon in building tools developers love. - ~400 team members - 60+ countries - 20+ languages spoken - Over $1B raised (including our $500M Series F) - 540,000+ community members We move fast, build in public, and use what we ship. If it’s in your project, we probably use it in ours too. We believe deeply in the open-source ecosystem and strive to support—not replace—existing tools and communities.

description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><p><strong>Available Locations: </strong>Austin, Texas </p> <p><strong>About the role</strong></p> <p>The Demand Planning team sits at the intersection of traffic forecasting, infrastructure strategy, and operational execution. We predict when, where, and how many servers to deploy across Cloudflare's global edge so that customers' traffic stays in-region and they never have to think about infrastructure. This is not a reporting role — it is a planning and engineering role that requires you to build the models, own the data, and translate forecasts into real deployment decisions.</p> <p>As a Capacity Engineer, you will own one or more planning regions end-to-end with light supervision. That means maintaining the models, catching problems before they become incidents, working directly with hardware sourcing and infrastructure teams, and contributing to the data pipelines that feed your planning work. You will be the point of contact for your region — not someone who supports a more senior planner, but someone who runs the work.</p> <p>This is a role for someone with 3-5 years of experience who is ready to operate with real ownership and is actively growing toward full autonomy. You will work alongside senior peers who set team-wide standards, and you will be expected to contribute to cross-regional consistency — not just execute within your own lane. You will also work fluently with AI tooling, including OpenCode AI and MAS agent workflows, as a normal part of how planning gets done on this team.</p> <p> </p> <p><strong>Why Cloudflare/ Why This Team</strong></p> <p>Cloudflare's network spans hundreds of cities and carries a meaningful fraction of global internet traffic — the planning decisions this team makes have direct consequences at that scale. The Demand Planning team is in an active transition from manual planning toward intelligent, automated, AI-augmented capacity systems, and this role puts you at the center of that shift. You will work on problems that are genuinely hard, with teammates who take the craft seriously, in a team small enough that your work is visible and your contributions matter from day one.</p> <h4><strong>What you'll do</strong></h4> <p>- Own one or more edge planning regions end-to-end, producing deployment recommendations with minimal supervision</p> <p>- Maintain and continuously improve regional planning models, incorporating new traffic patterns, hardware generations, and infrastructure changes</p> <p>- Build and maintain data pipelines that feed regional planning — using BigQuery, Python, and Jupyter notebooks to query, explore, and validate planning data</p> <p>- Work directly with hardware sourcing, DCS, and infrastructure teams to translate forecasts into actionable deployment plans</p> <p>- Proactively identify capacity risks in your region and surface them before they require escalation</p> <p>- Use OpenCode AI and MAS agent tooling as a standard part of your daily planning workflow</p> <p>- Contribute to cross-regional consistency efforts alongside peers — shared methodology, shared standards</p> <p>- Participate in planning reviews and communicate forecast outputs clearly to non-technical stakeholders</p> <h4><strong>Desirable Skills, Knowledge, and Experience:</strong></h4> <p>- 3-5 years in an analytical, planning, or technical infrastructure role</p> <p>- Working SQL proficiency — comfortable querying and joining datasets in BigQuery to answer planning questions</p> <p>- Python proficiency — data analysis, scripting, and automation of planning workflows; title: Full-Stack Software Engineer
description: Du entwickelst gerne durch den ganzen Stack, eignest dir selbstständig Neues an und hast ein Auge für gute Benutzeroberflächen? Dann möchten wir dich kennenlernen. Du gestaltest technische Entscheidungen mit, reviewst Code und hilfst uns, unsere Arbeitsweise weiterzuentwickeln. Neben Kundenprojekten hast du die Möglichkeit, an unseren Open-Source-Projekten und eigenen Produkten wie Mapperly und Kreya mitzuarbeiten. Ein Gespür für Design, Layout und Interaktion, du erkennst, wenn etwas noch nicht stimmig ist, und möchtest es verbessern. Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse, mit denen du dich im Team und mit unseren Kunden austauschen kannst. Du musst nicht alle unsere Technologien bereits kennen. Wir schätzen solide Grundlagen, sorgfältige Arbeit und die Bereitschaft dazuzulernen. Das bieten wir dir Überwiegend remote arbeiten: Ein bis zwei Tage pro Woche verbringen wir gemeinsam im Team oder bei einem Kunden. Gute Ausstattung: Ein grosszügiges Gerätebudget, damit du mit einer Ausstattung arbeiten kannst, die zu dir passt. Geförderter öV: Ein Halbtax-Abonnement für den öffentlichen Verkehr in der Schweiz. Erholung: 25 Ferientage pro Jahr und die Möglichkeit, bis zu zwei zusätzliche Ferienwochen zu kaufen. Raum zum Mitgestalten: Du bringst dich sowohl technisch als auch bei der Benutzererfahrung ein. Schick uns deinen Lebenslauf und ein paar Worte darüber, warum du bei riok arbeiten möchtest.
