title: Business Analyst - Enterprise & AI Solutions
description: <div class="content-intro"><h4><strong>Who We Are</strong></h4> <p>WPP Enterprise Solutions designs, builds, and operates the growth systems that competitive businesses rely on. In a world where Al is reshaping how companies drive growth, we lead clients in business transformation and marketing modernization, connecting strategy directly to execution. Our 12,000 experts in engineering and platforms, commerce, consulting, content transformation, CRM, and CX work within a unified global operating unit across 40+ markets. WPP Enterprise Solutions works alongside best-in-class partners including Adobe, AWS, Braze, Google, Microsoft, Salesforce, and Shopify, as well as innovators in AI, to deliver growth solutions tailored to the needs of our clients’ businesses. VML, part of WPP, supports WPP Enterprise Solutions by helping brands activate transformation through creativity and experience.</p></div><h3>Working in technology & innovation with WPP Enterprise Solutions</h3> <p>At WPP Enterprise Solutions Netherlands, we create connected brands to drive growth. Our expertise spans the full customer journey, with deep capabilities in commerce, consultancy, CRM, CX, data, production, technology, content, media and more. We deliver end-to-end solutions for ambitious B2B and B2C brands, supported by the wider WPP network.</p> <p>Our work combines strategy, product thinking, experience design, data, engineering and AI to solve real business problems, from enterprise commerce modernisation and digital shelf excellence to AI-enabled content operations, marketing automation, GEO, workflow orchestration and custom AI agents.</p> <h3>About the team</h3> <p>You’ll join the Product Management & AI Solutions team: the group that bridges business strategy, customer experience and technology to deliver scalable commerce and enterprise solutions. We work closely with UX/CX, Data & AI, SEO/GEO, Content, CRM, Paid and Retail Media, Engineering and Delivery teams.</p> <p>Our ambition is to move beyond isolated skills and build repeatable, outcome-led propositions around commerce growth topics such as Search & Discovery, Personalisation, CRO & Experience Optimisation, Product Data/PIM & Digital Shelf, Content Supply Chain & AI Content Operations, CRM & Lifecycle Growth, Performance & Retail Media, SEO/GEO and Composable Commerce Modernisation. Alongside this, we are growing our applied AI work: shaping and delivering custom AI agents and AI-enabled workflows for clients, from discovery and pilot through to production and continuous improvement.</p> <h3>Why this role exists</h3> <p>Clients are increasingly asking for integrated solutions rather than isolated delivery capacity. They need people who can understand the business problem, shape the product direction, define the right solution, translate it into clear specifications and guide teams through delivery. At the same time, AI is changing how commerce, content, marketing and operations work, creating a need for analysts who can combine structured requirements thinking with product ownership, enterprise technology understanding and the design of AI-enabled workflows and agents.</p> <p>This role is designed for someone who can operate as a strong Business Analyst, step into Product Owner responsibilities when needed, advocate for product thinking inside the organisation and help turn our AI and commerce capabilities into scalable client value. You will work across both our commerce and enterprise product work and our applied AI work. The mix depends on client demand, and we expect the AI share to grow over time.</p> <h3>The role</h3> <p>As Business Analyst, Enterprise & AI Solutions, you bridge business needs, product direction and technical delivery across enterprise digital commerce and martech ecosystems. You analyse business processes, clarify user and stakeholder needs, define requirements and support solutioning across the commerce stack: CMS, Search, PIM/PXM, DAM, ERP, OMS, CDP, CRM, analytics, marketing automation, paid/media platforms and integration layers.</p> <p>You will also work on AI initiatives such as custom AI agents (for example for pricing, search or customer service), content and marketing automation, product/content enrichment, GEO and organic discoverability, AI orchestration and workflow automation. You do not need to be a machine learning engineer or a domain expert, but you must be technically curious and comfortable working with APIs, data flows, automation tools, LLM-based workflows, AI quality evaluation, governance requirements and human-in-the-loop processes.</p> <p>Depending on your experience and the project context, you may act as a hands-on BA, a product-minded discovery partner, a proxy Product Owner or a work stream lead. In all cases, your job is to make ambiguity manageable, decisions explicit and delivery focused on measurable value.</p> <h3>What you will do</h3> <ul> <li>Collaborate with Solution Architects and Product Owners and translate business goals into clear requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, process flows, tech architecture, data flows and integration specifications that delivery teams can act on.</li> <li>Work across commerce, martech and enterprise ecosystems, including CMS, Search, PIM/PXM, DAM, ERP, OMS, CDP, CRM, analytics, marketing automation and media platforms.</li> <li>Identify, shape and specify practical AI, automation and workflow orchestration opportunities across content, marketing, commerce and operational processes, from process mapping and readiness checks to a scoped pilot with a clear business case.</li> <li>Specify AI agents and LLM-based workflows: define the task, data sources, tools and integrations, guardrails, human-in-the-loop steps and escalation paths, plus the evaluation criteria that decide when a solution is ready to go live. After launch, help measure quality, adoption and business impact.</li> <li>Act as a Business Analyst or proxy Product Owner when needed by supporting prioritisation, backlog refinement, sprint planning, UAT, release preparation and stakeholder alignment.</li> <li>Connect business, UX, data, SEO/GEO, content, engineering, legal and delivery teams to make sure solutions are valuable, feasible, scalable and well governed.</li> <li>Help make our AI work repeatable and sellable: contribute to proposals, scoping and estimates, and build reusable assets such as discovery templates, requirement patterns, evaluation sets and playbooks.</li> <li>At the senior end of the role, independently lead workstreams, own parts of the client relationship and coach junior analysts or product team members.</li> </ul> <h3>Who you are</h3> <ul> <li>A structured problem-solver who starts with the business problem, not only the requested feature.</li> <li>A product-minded Business Analyst who can move between discovery, specification, prioritisation and delivery support.</li> <li>Comfortable acting as a proxy Product Owner when a project needs stronger product ownership.</li> <li>Technically fluent enough to discuss APIs, data flows, integrations, platform dependencies and implementation trade-offs with engineering teams.</li> <li>Curious and pragmatic about AI: you use AI tools in your own work and understand the opportunity, but also the need for governance, quality, reliability and human oversight.</li> <li>Comfortable with fast-moving technology: you focus on the problem and the outcome rather than a specific tool, and you pick up new platforms quickly.</li> <li>Strong in workshops, stakeholder alignment and decision-making, with the confidence to challenge constructively.</li> <li>Able to represent the Product Management & AI Solutions team inside WPP and help other teams understand the value of product thinking and applied AI.</li> <li>Commercially aware: you can connect requirements and solutions to client value, efficiency, scalability, conversion, discoverability or operational impact.</li> <li>Collaborative and low-ego, with the ability to work across Commerce, UX/CX, Data, SEO/GEO, Content, CRM, Media, Engineering and Delivery.</li> </ul> <h3>What you’ll need</h3> <h4>The basics</h4> <ul> <li>3-5 years of experience as a Business Analyst, Product Owner, Solution Analyst or similar role, ideally in commerce, martech, enterprise platforms, consulting or a digital agency environment.</li> <li>Experience with digital commerce ecosystems, preferably B2B and/or B2C enterprise environments.</li> <li>Working knowledge of platforms and domains such as CMS, Search, PIM/PXM, DAM, ERP, OMS, CDP, CRM, analytics, marketing automation and paid/media technology.</li> <li>Strong experience writing user stories, acceptance criteria, functional specifications, process flows and integration requirements.</li> <li>Good technical understanding of REST APIs, web platforms, data flows, system integrations and common delivery dependencies.</li> <li>Hands-on familiarity with generative AI tools and a working understanding of how LLM-based solutions behave, including their limitations and how to test the quality of their output.</li> <li>Experience working in Agile delivery environments with tools such as Jira, Confluence or similar.</li> <li>Excellent communication, facilitation, documentation and stakeholder management skills.</li> <li>Fluent professional English.</li> <li>Currently residing in the Netherlands with a valid work permit.</li> </ul> <h3>Bonus points</h3> <ul> <li>Hands-on experience with automation tools such as n8n, Zapier or similar.</li> <li>Experience shaping AI, LLM, agentic or workflow orchestration use cases in a business or delivery context, ideally including at least one that went live.</li> <li>Familiarity with AI and agent platforms such as Microsoft Copilot Studio, Azure AI Foundry, AWS Bedrock, Google Vertex AI or the OpenAI and Anthropic APIs, and with concepts such as retrieval (RAG), tool use and evaluation.</li> <li>Familiarity with AI governance and regulation, such as the EU AI Act, and with responsible AI practices.</li> <li>Experience with search and personalisation platforms, composable commerce, PIM/PXM, CDP, CRM or marketing automation platforms.</li> <li>Experience with GA4, BigQuery, SQL, Python, Postman, Figma, Miro or similar tools.</li> <li>Proficiency in Dutch.</li> </ul> <h3>In return, this is what we offer</h3> <p>You’ll get access to an international network of clients, colleagues, technology partners and resources. We have a listening ear for ambitious ideas, and together we keep stretching our boundaries. We want you to follow the path you’re building, and we invest in your personal development in a dynamic, collaborative workplace.</p> <h2>Our compensation</h2> <ul> <li>A monthly salary between <strong>€4,800 and €5200</strong> gross, depending on your experience, seniority and fit with the role.</li> <li>A gross annual 8% holiday allowance.</li> <li>Access to our commuting package to suit your individual needs.</li> <li>Competitive pension benefits.</li> <li>A choice of a Mac or Windows laptop.</li> </ul> <h2>Our culture</h2> &

title: Business Development Representative
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><p><strong>Available Location: </strong>Dubai, UAE</p> <p><strong>About the Team:</strong></p> <p>In this role, you will contribute to Cloudflare's revenue generation engine by delivering pipeline at scale to the Sales counterparts. You will do this through a maniacal focus on people, process, and tools. The Business Development organization is anchored in a culture focused on the development & training of its employees, incubating talent across the company, teamwork, and celebrating success. With flawless execution, we believe the Business Development organization will be a competitive differentiator for Cloudflare.</p> <p>This is a great opportunity to be a member of our high performing Sales team at a hyper-growth technology company. The Business Development Representative (BDR) will:</p> <ul> <li>Be the first point of contact for customers that need help finding solutions</li> <li>Develop your customer centric sales skills to deliver a stellar customer experience</li> <li>Learn Cloudflare’s products and services in detail</li> </ul> <p>Similar to other roles that Cloudflare, this role has a tenure requirement of 18-24 months before you may be eligible to apply for another role within the company.</p> <p><strong>About the Role</strong></p> <p><strong>Languages required: English</strong></p> <p>This is a great opportunity to be an early member of a high performing sales team at a fast growing technology company. We are looking for ownership-oriented team members with excellent communication skills and technical curiosity. As the Business Development Representative (BDR), you will: </p> <ul> <li>Create excellent customer experiences</li> <li>Learn customer-centric sales skills</li> <li>Become an expert in Cloudflare’s product</li> <li>Team members have opportunities to move into roles across the organization, especially in mid-market sales, customer success, solutions engineering, and sales operations</li> </ul> <p>Day in the Life of BDR at Cloudflare</p> <ul> <li>Own and meet target quota related to number of qualified opportunities, response SLA, value of sales pipeline, and revenue</li> <li>Develop new business opportunities from inbound and marketing-generated leads</li> <li>Discover pain points and use case, map them to broad set of Cloudflare solutions and qualify for Enterprise sales opportunities</li> <li>Work cross-functionally with stakeholders (account executives, marketing, sales operations, fellow BDRs)</li> <li>Report, track, and manage sales activities and results using SFDC</li> <li>Play an active role in the creation and iteration of team processes</li> </ul> <p>Examples of desirable skills, knowledge and experience</p> <ul> <li>2+ years of experience working as a BDR in a similar capacity in technology industry in the Africa & South Africa region (experience in SaaS will be a plus)</li> <li>Self-motivated; entrepreneurial spirit</li> <li>Ability to work as part of a team or independently</li> <li>Analytical, organization and time management skills</li> <li>Comfortable working in a fast-paced, dynamic environment</li> <li>Strong interpersonal communication skills</li> <li>Customer-oriented mindset with empathy and curiosity</li> <li>Aptitude to learn technical concepts/terms</li> <li>Ability to manage multiple tasks/projects simultaneously</li> <li>Experience in Outreach and Salesforce is a plus</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.</span></p> <p><a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/protecting-free-expression-online/"><strong>Project Galileo</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.</span></p> <p><strong><a href="https://www.cloudflare.com/athenian/">Athenian Project</a></strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.</span></p> <p><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"><strong>1.1.1.1</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: We released</span><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"> <span style="font-weight: 400;">1.1.1.1</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our</span><a href="https://developers.cloudflare.com/1.1.1.1/privacy/public-dns-resolver"> privacy commitment</a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs.  More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview process.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations. Please note that any offer of employment may be conditioned on your authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these U.S. export laws without sponsorship for an export license.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.  We are committed to providing equal employment opportunity for all people and place great value in both diversity and inclusiveness.  All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to their, or any other person's, perceived or actual</span> <span style="font-weight: 400;">race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, family care status, or any other basis protected by law. </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">We are an AA/Veterans/Disabled Employer.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare provides reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities.  Please tell us if you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job. Examples of reasonable accommodations include, but are not limited to, changing the application process, providing documents in an alternate format, using a sign language interpreter, or using specialized equipment.  If you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job, please contact us via e-mail at </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">hr@cloudflare.com</span><span style="font-weight: 400;"> or via mail at 101 Townsend St. San Francisco, CA 94107.</span></p></div>

description: Who We Are You've ordered dinner through Just Eat Takeaway. You've bought and sold on OLX. You've paid with PayU. Chances are, you've already used a Prosus company today. Through our investment team, we also back the founders and technologies shaping the future: From robotics and autonomous systems to synthetic biology and frontier AI. You thrive in environments where infrastructure reliability and efficiency directly shape how quickly research reaches millions of users. isolation Keep large distributed training runs healthy: node health checks, NCCL and interconnect debugging, automated job recovery, and checkpoint management Track and optimize GPU utilization and production model serving Deployment & Serving: Deploy LLMs to production using vLLM or SGLang, with CI/CD, model versioning, and safe rollouts and rollbacks Monitor serving latency, throughput, throughput and MFU: parallelism strategies (FSDP, tensor and pipeline parallelism), communication/compute overlap, mixed precision and FP8, activation checkpointing, torch.compile Optimize inference: engineering with focus on GPU workloads Hands-on experience operating multi-node GPU clusters with Kubernetes and/or Slurm, including debugging hardware, networking (NCCL, InfiniBand/RoCE), and job failures Production experience deploying and optimizing LLM inference with vLLM, SGLang, or TensorRT-LLM Proven track record of profiling and accelerating GPU workloads, with measured results in throughput, latency, MFU, or cost Solid understanding of monitoring and observability for GPU systems (Prometheus, Grafana, DCGM, or similar) Naturally curious with a track record of proactively identifying and implementing improvements Preferred qualifications Experience writing custom kernels in Triton or CUDA, and familiarity with fused kernels such as FlashAttention Performance tuning of distributed training frameworks: FSDP, Megatron-LM, or DeepSpeed Experience with low-precision training and inference (**FP8**, INT4) and model compression for production deployment Deep knowledge of GPU architectures: memory hierarchy, tensor cores, roofline analysis Experience with multi-tenant GPU scheduling and fair-share resource allocation Contributions to open-source projects such as vLLM, SGLang, PyTorch, or Triton What we offer Critical infrastructure ownership for high-impact AI projects that are strategically vital to the company, with direct visibility to senior leadership including the CEO State-of-the-art GPU infrastructure: H200 fleet, vLLM serving stack, and the freedom to optimize it end to end Expert ML team who have released top Hugging Face models, published at NeurIPS, and built production systems that will run on your infrastructure Significant autonomy in choosing tools and shaping our infrastructure and performance strategy Modern tooling: Latest ML frameworks, coding assistants, best-in-class development environment Hybrid work model with our Amsterdam office - home to the AI House, bringing together 200+ AI professionals through events and collaborations Competitive compensation, top-spec MacBook Pro, and an environment genuinely built for professional growth and learning If you're excited to own the GPU infrastructure behind cutting-edge LLMs and make every training run and every request faster, let's talk. Why Prosus? At Prosus, your colleagues include 60,000 AI agents… and your job is to figure out what that actually means. We're one of the largest operators of agentic AI on the planet, inside a $100B+ portfolio across 100+ companies and two billion people. title: Data Engineer
description: De IT-afdeling van Den Hartogh (25 collega's) werkt als één team aan de groei en doelstellingen van ons familiebedrijf, verdeeld over clusters als IT Operations, Architecture & Security en Data Integration & Analytics. Als Data Engineer binnen dat laatste cluster help je de business proactief bij het behalen van haar zakelijke en financiële doelen, met data in de breedste zin van het woord. Via applicaties, dashboarding en ad-hocanalyses moderniseer je ons datalandschap, en er is volop ruimte om te innoveren met predictive & generative AI, Data Science en Process Automation (RPA) . Je rapporteert rechtstreeks aan de Teamlead Data Integration & Analytics. Wat ga je doen? Je slaat de brug tussen organisatie en processen enerzijds en techniek anderzijds; Als sparringpartner voor de business til je de managementinformatie naar een hoger niveau, in innovatieve en complexe dataprojecten; Je onderhoudt en breidt onze data pipelines in SQL uit en bouwt een semantisch model ; Je voert ad-hocanalyses uit met SQL (en R) en stimuleert continue verbetering via data- en procesanalyse; Je werkt nauw samen met data professionals om de bruikbaarheid van interne en externe data te verbeteren. Jij bent onze ideale kandidaat als je: Een bachelor of master hebt in Technische Bedrijfskunde, Business IT & Management, Data Science, Analytics of vergelijkbaar; Minimaal 4 jaar ervaring hebt in een vergelijkbare functie én minimaal 4 jaar met SQL ; Sterk bent in SQL, DAX, dimensioneel modelleren, data vault modeling, versiebeheer en Scrum ; Uitstekend communiceert in Nederlands en Engels (woord en geschrift) en een scherpe, kritische blik hebt, daarnaast durf je tegen de business aan te schuren; Proactief en resultaatgericht bent, met een sterke drive om te blijven verbeteren en jezelf te ontwikkelen; Pré : 2+ jaar ervaring met Machine Learning-modellen, geavanceerde Power BI-kennis en ervaring met het implementeren van AI-modellen in een organisatie. Wat bieden wij? Een salaris tussen € 4.000,- en € 5.400,- bruto per maand (naar kennis en ervaring), plus laptop en telefoon van de zaak, 30 vakantiedagen (o.b.v. fulltime), 8% vakantiegeld , een feestdagengratificatie van € 550,- bruto, reiskostenvergoeding en een goede pensioenregeling; Ruimte om te ondernemen : een uitdagende functie met veel zelfstandigheid, flexibiliteit en verantwoordelijkheid, binnen een groeiende en informele organisatie met ambitieuze doelen; Hybride werken vanuit ons Basecamp in Rotterdam (bij fulltime 3 dagen kantoor, 2 thuis): een moderne werkomgeving met uitzicht over de Waterweg, een inhouse gym, restaurant en de Den Hartogh Academy met meer dan 500 trainingen; Een internationale, maar familiaire werkomgeving, met betrokken collega's van over de hele wereld; Oog voor elkaar : een fijne werksfeer, een caring- en vitaliteitsbudget en toegang tot Benefits at Work met aantrekkelijke kortingen. title: Senior Account Manager
description: Op duizenden werkvloeren in Nederland wordt dagelijks gewerkt met gevaarlijke stoffen. Dat kan veilig, als je weet wat je in huis hebt, wat het doet en welke regels erbij horen. Daar helpt Sdu Toxic organisaties bij. Toxic is de meest complete SaaS-oplossing voor wet- en regelgeving rond gevaarlijke stoffen in Nederland. Organisaties registreren er hun stoffen mee, beoordelen blootstelling, leggen maatregelen vast en informeren hun medewerkers. Zo helpen we QHSE-professionals om mensen veilig te laten werken en aan de arbowetgeving te voldoen. Achter Toxic staat een team met diepgaande kennis van chemische producten en de regels die erbij horen. En een succesvol marketing- en salesteam dat zorgt dat steeds meer organisaties ons vinden. Toxic is onderdeel van Lefebvre Sdu, dat al 200 jaar bouwt aan juridische en fiscale kennis, en van Lefebvre Group, de Europese leider op dat gebied. De vraag groeit. Onze Commercieel Medewerkers Binnendienst en marketing plannen meer afspraken in dan we nu kunnen afronden. Daarom zoeken we een Senior Accountmanager die van die gesprekken klanten maakt. HOE JIJ ONS VERDER BRENGT Jij bent het gezicht van Toxic. Voor de veiligheidskundigen, managers en directies die met ons werken, word jij degene die ze kennen en vertrouwen. Je leert hun organisatie kennen, luistert naar wat er speelt en denkt mee over wat ze nodig hebben. Zo bouw je relaties die jaren meegaan, en groeit Toxic met je klanten mee. Je leert je klanten kennen: hun mensen, hun processen en wat er bij hen speelt. Zo word je hun vaste gesprekspartner en denk je mee over de volgende stap. Elke nieuwe relatie begint met een goed gesprek. De binnendienst en marketing plannen de afspraken, jij bereidt je voor en ontdekt wat een organisatie nodig heeft. Daarnaast zoek je zelf nieuwe kansen. In je demo's laat je zien hoe Toxic werkt en wat het oplevert. Gaat de vraag verder dan het standaardplatform? Dan werk je met collega's een oplossing op maat uit, met API-koppelingen en AI-toepassingen. Je bouwt relaties met veiligheidskundigen, inkopers en directie, brengt hun belangen samen in 1 voorstel en sluit deals met een hogere dealwaarde. Met strategische accountplannen houd je overzicht op je belangrijkste klanten. Je ziet kansen voor up- en cross-sell en herkent retentierisico's vroeg. Samen met Customer Success zorg je dat nieuwe klanten goed starten. Je houdt je pipeline en forecast actueel in Salesforce en deelt wat je bij klanten hoort met marketing en product. Als senior ben je mentor en sparringpartner voor collega-accountmanagers. DIT ZOEKEN WIJ Je bent iemand bij wie klanten zich gehoord voelen. Je luistert goed, stelt de juiste vragen en vertaalt een complex vraagstuk naar een helder voorstel. De markt van gevaarlijke stoffen hoef je nog niet te kennen. Wat je wel meebrengt, is ervaring met het opbouwen van klantrelaties en interesse in software. Je hebt meerdere jaren ervaring als accountmanager, bij voorkeur in SaaS of met digitale oplossingen. Je hebt interesse in software en wilt begrijpen hoe een platform als Toxic werkt, inclusief API-koppelingen en AI-toepassingen. Je bouwt relaties met meerdere stakeholders tegelijk en beheerst het volledige salesproces, van eerste kennismaking tot getekend contract. Je stuurt op data en haalt je targets, met nieuwe klanten en binnen je eigen portefeuille. Je spreekt en schrijft vloeiend Nederlands. Je hoeft de markt nog niet te kennen. Klanten, stoffen en regelgeving leer je bij ons, van collega's die het vak door en door kennen. HIER TEKEN JE VOOR Je tekent voor een rol die past bij je ambitie. Je werkt aan grotere deals, bouwt je eigen netwerk op en ontwikkelt je in een groeiend SaaS-team. Dat doe je binnen Lefebvre Sdu, een legaltechbedrijf met 200 jaar kennis en de energie van een scale-up. Dit krijg je ervoor terug: Een inwerkperiode waarin je Toxic, de markt en onze klanten leert kennen. Een plek waar je vanaf dag 1 invloed hebt op de aanpak, de processen en de richting. Collega's met diepgaande kennis van stoffen en regelgeving, van wie je elke dag leert. Doorgroeimogelijkheden naar Teamlead, Key Accountmanager of Propositiemanager. Een salaris vanaf €4.477 per maand, op basis van een werkweek van 36 uur. Een variabele bonusregeling die kan oplopen tot 30% van je jaarsalaris. 23 vakantiedagen en een persoonlijk keuzebudget van 12%, waarvan 8% vakantiegeld en 4% vrij besteedbaar aan extra vakantiedagen of salaris. Een goede pensioenregeling via PGB, inclusief aanvullende partnerverzekering. Een leaseauto of een reiskostenvergoeding van €0,25 per kilometer, en een aantrekkelijke fietsregeling. Voor een reisafstand onder de 10 km of boven de 60 km geldt een aangepaste regeling. Thuiswerkvergoeding en hybride werken: reken op 2 dagen per week op kantoor in Den Haag. MEER WETEN? Benieuwd hoe Toxic werkt? Kijk alvast op toxic.nl/en. We vertellen je graag meer over het team en de rol. Stuur je cv en je hoort binnen 2 werkdagen van ons. Eerst nog vragen? App of bel Mak via +31 6 18 60 98 89. Find Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

title: Inside Sales Representative
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><p><strong>Available Locations: London, the UK</strong></p> <p><strong>About the role</strong></p> <p>The Inside Sales Representative (ISR) is a critical sales role responsible for driving high-volume, high-velocity net new business acquisition sales in a remote selling model within the commercial segment across EMEA, specifically UKI. Operating as full-cycle territory owners similar to an AE, ISR manages the end-to-end sales process from self-sourcing pipeline, qualifying opportunities and closing deals in partnership with SE and Partner Organisation.</p> <h4><strong>What you'll do</strong></h4> <ul> <li><strong>Build your own pipeline:</strong> Find new business across your assigned territory (UKI) through high-volume outreach by phone, email, LinkedIn and social selling, using tools like Salesforce, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, ZoomInfo and AI outreach</li> <li><strong>Run the whole sales cycle remotely:</strong> Lead discovery and qualification calls using MEDDPIC, give engaging virtual presentations and live product demos, and negotiate and close new business against an ACV quota.</li> <li><strong>Explain the value of Cloudflare's platform:</strong> Connect commercial-segment customers' business and technical problems to the right Cloudflare products, such as Application Security and Performance, Zero Trust/SASE and the Developer Platform, and show the value they'd get.</li> <li><strong>Work closely with other teams:</strong> Partner with Solutions Engineers on technical validation, and with the Partner Organisation to co-sell and close deals faster. Work with Marketing and BDR teammates on campaigns and events that create pipeline.</li> <li><strong>Run your territory with data:</strong> Keep your Salesforce pipeline accurate and your forecasts reliable, track your activity and conversion numbers, and use what you learn to consistently meet or exceed your targets</li> </ul> <h4><strong>Desirable Skills, Knowledge, and Experience:</strong></h4> <ul> <li>1 - 3 years of experience in a sales role, preferably in SaaS or tech sales, such as: </li> <ul> <li>BDR/SDR background with strong outbound experience in a high-paced environment</li> <li>SMB or Transactional sales experience with high volume, high velocity sales motion</li> </ul> <li>Strong track record of meeting or exceeding quota </li> <li>Strong discovery and qualification skills using frameworks like BANT, MEDDIC </li> <li>Excellent presentation and interpersonal communication skills (verbal and written) as well as time management skill</li> <li>Experience using CRM like Salesforce, outbound/prospecting sales tools (e.g. LinkedIn Sales Navigator, ZoomInfo, Salesforce Sales Engagement Outreach etc)</li> <li>Tech-savvy and technically curious - quick to learn technical products, comfortable to run live demos independently, data-driven mindset  </li> <li>Highly accountable and self-driven, customer-centric individuals</li> <li>Multilingual abilities (depending on the coverage regions)</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.</span></p> <p><a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/protecting-free-expression-online/"><strong>Project Galileo</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.</span></p> <p><strong><a href="https://www.cloudflare.com/athenian/">Athenian Project</a></strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.</span></p> <p><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"><strong>1.1.1.1</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: We released</span><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"> <span style="font-weight: 400;">1.1.1.1</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our</span><a href="https://developers.cloudflare.com/1.1.1.1/privacy/public-dns-resolver"> privacy commitment</a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs.  More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview process.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations. Please note that any offer of employment may be conditioned on your authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these U.S. export laws without sponsorship for an export license.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.  We are committed to providing equal employment opportunity for all people and place great value in both diversity and inclusiveness.  All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to their, or any other person's, perceived or actual</span> <span style="font-weight: 400;">race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, family care status, or any other basis protected by law. </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">We are an AA/Veterans/Disabled Employer.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare provides reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities.  Please tell us if you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job. Examples of reasonable accommodations include, but are not limited to, changing the application process, providing documents in an alternate format, using a sign language interpreter, or using specialized equipment.  If you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job, please contact us via e-mail at </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">hr@cloudflare.com</span><span style="font-weight: 400;"> or via mail at 101 Townsend St. San Francisco, CA 94107.</span></p></div>

title: Internship - UAV Robotics/Mechatronics (Drone Prototyping, Integration & Field Testing)
description: Opening WE CANNOT PROVIDE VISA SPONSORSHIP Details Preferred starting date: ASAP Weekly availability: full-time (5 days/week) Period: 6 months Location: Aerospace Innovation Hub, Delft, the Netherlands About the company Fiducial is a young but fast-growing deep-tech start-up with big ambitions at the frontier of autonomy, perception, and defence. Currently, we are developing software for advanced on-board UAV situational awareness in military applications. Using low-cost and widely available sensors and compute, our solutions are built for scalability. From there, we plan to develop a line-up of interconnected solutions to safeguard European safety. Our team consists of engineers that are passionate about the technology and solutions they develop. The only time most of us are not thinking about the technology is when we are asleep, and sometimes even then. Our team members have a background in different fields such as Aerospace Engineering, Computational Science and Engineering, Robotics and Computer Graphics. Our office is located in the Aerospace Innovation Hub, a start-up hub located on the TU Delft campus in the faculty of Aerospace Engineering. We work closely with top-tier partners, ranging from government agencies and prime contractors to academic research institutes and other start-ups. Our projects span from large tender orders in collaboration with partners to low TRL research with government agencies. Whether through formal R&D programs or rapid prototyping tracks, we operate at the intersection of innovation and deployment. Your role If you’ve ever spent a weekend building a drone, tuning a flight controller, soldering a power harness, or figuring out why your FPV setup won’t arm, this internship is literally designed for you. We’re looking for a hands-on builder who loves working with real hardware: wiring sensors mounting compute boards setting up flight controllers testing drones outdoors fixing whatever breaks and making it better If phrases like ArduPilot, PX4, Jetson, ESCs, power distribution, 3D printing, or FPV gear make you smile, you’re the kind of person we want. This is not a “sit behind a desk” internship. You will be on the drones. You will be in the field. You will fly. What you’ll do Build and integrate hardware onto real drone platforms used in active R&D. Work hands-on with flight controllers (ArduPilot) and compute boards (Jetson, Orange Pi). Deploy and debug embedded perception software. Solder, assemble, and prototype wiring, adapters, mounts, and housings. 3D-print parts and quickly turn ideas into working physical prototypes. Support and participate in drone flight tests (you’ll fly regularly). Troubleshoot issues, iterate fast, and improve our hardware setups. You’ll see your work fly, literally! Who you are You’ve built or flown drones / RC systems (any level counts). You tinker with electronics, FPV, embedded software, or robotics. You enjoy making physical things work. You like fast iteration and getting your hands dirty. Linux doesn’t scare you. You are independent, curious, and resourceful. We don’t care about grades, we care about what you’ve made. Please include photos/links of: your drone builds FPV rigs electronics projects CAD/3D-printed parts GitHub repos anything that shows you build things If you’ve ever crashed something, fixed it, and sent it back into the sky — you’ll fit right in. Requirements Enrolled in a relevant study (Aerospace, Robotics, Electrical, Mechatronics, Engineering etc.). Linux basics. Interest in UAVs, robotics, embedded systems, or autonomy. English proficiency. Organized and proactive. Bonus: driver’s license, drone pilot license, CAD, 3D printing, soldering, or flight experience. What we offer 1000 euro monthly compensation. 10 vacation days during internship period. (Really) flexible working hours and option to work from home 2 days per week. Have a direct and significant influence on highly innovative products. The opportunity to iterate quickly with tight feedback loops, close to the product. We are innovating, learning is to be expected. Responsibility over the things you implement, you are the expert on what you build. The application procedure If after reading the above you are convinced you are the right person for the job, send us some information about yourself; this can be a resume, website or other source, as long as we get a clear impression of your background and skills. We’ll get back to you ASAP. If we feel you could be a fit for the position, we’ll invite you for an informal introduction so we can get to know you, and equally important, you can get to know us. After this, a technical focused interview could follow. If at this point we feel you are the person we are looking for, we’ll discuss the specifics (starting date and period). Welcome to the team! title: Production & ESG Data Engineer
description: Are you passionate about data, technology and sustainability? ONE-Dyas is looking for a Production & ESG Data Engineer to ensure the accurate collection, administration and reporting of production, hydrocarbon and ESG data. You will turn complex data into reliable insights that support operational and business decisions. What will you do? · Maintain and improve databases containing validated production and ESG data. · Collect and integrate data from production sources and operated and non-operated assets. · Prepare clear monthly, quarterly and annual reports and visualizations. · Support Production, Engineering, HSE and ESG teams with data supporting operational and business decisions. · Explore opportunities for automation, machine learning and AI to improve collection, administration and reporting. · A bachelor’s level in Engineering, Accounting, Computer Science, Environmental Sciences or a related field. · Experience in data engineering or ESG reporting, preferably within the energy or oil & gas industry. · Knowledge of database management, data visualization and data governance. · Preferably experience with Python, SQL or similar tools. · Strong communication and problem-solving skills. · A proactive, independent and team-oriented approach with an interest in sustainability. Meet ONE-Dyas ONE-Dyas B.V. is the largest privately owned exploration and production company in the Netherlands. As entrepreneurs in Dutch offshore gas and oil, the company aims to make a significant contribution to the energy transition, working at the forefront of sustainability and technological innovation. Extracting gas and oil close to home contributes to the national economy, security of supply, and climate goals by employing local services, products, and know-how, reducing the reliance on imported fuels, cutting emissions, and complying to the highest environmental standards in the industry. With its roots dating back to 1893 in the mining industry, ONE-Dyas has a long history of successfully pioneering energy solutions. Today, its operations span the full lifecycle of offshore assets in the Netherlands, Germany and the UK, including the flagship N05-A development project in the Dutch and German part of the North Sea, set to be the first of its kind to integrate natural gas, wind power and green hydrogen. ONE-Dyas is also actively exploring carbon capture and storage, and green hydrogen opportunities as future energy solutions. Headquartered on the Zuid-as in Amsterdam with around 150 employees, ONE-Dyas has a strong entrepreneurial culture, short lines across all disciplines and a strong relationship with its shareholders leading to a focused and effective work environment. ONE-Dyas has an excellent reputation in the Netherlands, the UK and Germany for its experience and skills across the entire oil & gas energy supply chain. title: Senior Manager, APJC Outreach
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><p><strong>Available location: </strong>Singapore</p> <p>Cloudflare is one of the most dynamic and innovative companies providing services on the Internet. Regulation of the Internet is exploding -- across a number of subject areas and jurisdictions -- at a rate previously unseen in the history of the Internet. We’re looking for a new team member who can help foster and promote our corporate philosophy and approach, in which the security and privacy of our customers are paramount. </p> <p>We are looking for an exceptionally talented and energetic person to join our Public Policy team in Singapore, with a strong background in India policy. You will work on some of the most complicated and rapidly evolving policy issues in the world, such as content moderation, user privacy, and intermediary liability, and you’ll help us develop and communicate real-world solutions to addressing these challenges. You will also build and run programs that further Cloudflare’s reputation and standing in the region by partnering with governments, trade bodies, and civil society organisations. This person has a deep understanding of technology as well as regulatory environments. The ideal candidate can seamlessly go from a technical conversation with engineers to a high-level discussion with regulators and policymakers regarding where Cloudflare fits in the Internet stack. This person should be an expert at presenting technical topics at a level any audience will be able to understand.</p> <p>This role has non-standard working hours.</p> <p><strong>Responsibilities</strong></p> <ul> <li>Engage with policymakers, regulators, trade associations, industry partners, civil society groups and others in India and across the APJC region, to educate stakeholders on Cloudflare’s trust & safety processes and policy positions.</li> <li>Lead programs and advocacy campaigns that showcase our policy principles  to demonstrate what a better Internet looks like in practice.</li> <li>Develop talking points, policy narratives and presentation materials for use at external events and meetings and for other communication purposes (company blog, position papers, etc.).</li> <li>Coordinate with cross-functional teams to address government and law enforcement requests, as appropriate.</li> <li>Provide timely updates to colleagues from the Cloudflare Public Policy, Legal, Trust & Safety Teams and other internal stakeholders.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Minimum Qualification</strong></p> <ul> <li>Bachelor’s degree or preferably master's degree in public policy, law, economics </li> <li>8+ years of related experience handling law enforcement matters at a large technology company and experience handling public policy issues. </li> <li>Strong understanding of the Indian political, regulatory and legal system and protocols, particularly as they relate to digital services.</li> <li>Experience in designing, running, and managing stakeholder, community, or partnership programs and events (for example, workshops, hackathons, or training programs)</li> <li>Ability and willingness to work off hours, including weekends and holidays, to support emergency matters and interact with globally-based company employees</li> <li>Right to work in Singapore, or eligibility and willingness to relocate to Singapore</li> <li>Ability to analyze technical data and present to a less technical audience</li> <li>An ambitious mindset that enables you to successfully work independently with little guidance, but also to use good judgment and escalate / call out issues when needed.</li> <li>A sense of humor.</li> </ul> <p>Preferred Qualification</p> <ul> <li>Knowledge of Cloudflare products and the broader technology industry, including security, networking, Zero Trust, and AI services.</li> <li>Experience in reviewing, processing, and tracking legal documents, particularly in India (e.g., civil and criminal subpoenas, court orders, and search warrants, and legal notices under Indian law)</li> <li>Willingness to travel to India and elsewhere in the region.</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.</span></p> <p><a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/protecting-free-expression-online/"><strong>Project Galileo</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.</span></p> <p><strong><a href="https://www.cloudflare.com/athenian/">Athenian Project</a></strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.</span></p> <p><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"><strong>1.1.1.1</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: We released</span><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"> <span style="font-weight: 400;">1.1.1.1</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our</span><a href="https://developers.cloudflare.com/1.1.1.1/privacy/public-dns-resolver"> privacy commitment</a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs.  More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview process.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations. Please note that any offer of employment may be conditioned on your authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these U.S. export laws without sponsorship for an export license.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.  We are committed to providing equal employment opportunity for all people and place great value in both diversity and inclusiveness.  All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to their, or any other person's, perceived or actual</span> <span style="font-weight: 400;">race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, family care status, or any other basis protected by law. </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">We are an AA/Veterans/Disabled Employer.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare provides reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities.  Please tell us if you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job. Examples of reasonable accommodations include, but are not limited to, changing the application process, providing documents in an alternate format, using a sign language interpreter, or using specialized equipment.  If you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job, please contact us via e-mail at </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">hr@cloudflare.com</span><span style="font-weight: 400;"> or via mail at 101 Townsend St. San Francisco, CA 94107.</span></p></div>

title: Site Reliability Engineer, Cells Infrastructure
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.</p> <p>The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. <a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OuZIb5zszQI">Co-create the future with us</a> as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.</p> <p>*<em>Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.</em></p></div><h2>An overview of this role</h2> <p>We're looking for an Intermediate Site Reliability Engineer to join the Cells Infrastructure team in GitLab's Scale & Architecture organization. In this role, you'll help build and operate Cells, the architecture that lets GitLab.com scale horizontally. Cells splits GitLab.com into many independent units, each with its own application and data stack, behind a shared routing layer.</p> <p>This is a build-it-and-run-it role. You'll provision cells, route traffic to them, deploy them safely, and keep them reliable in production. You'll also help move customer organizations onto Cells, one of GitLab's most important scaling initiatives.</p> <h2>What you'll do</h2> <ul> <li value="1">Operate Cells in production: join the on-call rotation, respond to incidents, lead post-incident reviews, and drive corrective actions to completion.</li> <li value="2">Define and monitor service level objectives (SLOs) for routing and cell health, and build the dashboards, alerts, and runbooks behind them.</li> <li value="3">Provision and operate cell infrastructure on Amazon Web Services (AWS) and Google Cloud Platform (GCP), including Kubernetes, networking, Identity and Access Management (IAM), PostgreSQL, Redis, and object storage.</li> <li value="4">Develop infrastructure as code with Terraform, Helm, and GitOps tooling such as Argo CD.</li> <li value="5">Operate and extend the global routing layer, built on Cloudflare Workers, Envoy, and a Go service backed by Cloud Spanner, and expand routing to more protocols and services.</li> <li value="6">Improve the continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD) pipelines behind ring-based deployments, covering promotion, database migrations, quality assurance validation, and rollback.</li> <li value="7">Support organization migrations by preparing destination cells and helping with dry runs and production cutovers.</li> <li value="8">Work with product teams to make their services cell-compatible, and write documentation so others can operate Cells with confidence.</li> <li value="8">Take part in on-call or operational support where your team’s ownership model requires it.</li> </ul> <h2>What you'll bring</h2> <ul> <li value="1">Professional experience running production infrastructure at scale on AWS, GCP, or both, including Kubernetes, along with strong Terraform and Helm skills.</li> <li value="2">Proficiency in Go, or strong experience in another systems language and willingness to work in Go daily.</li> <li value="3">Solid grounding in site reliability engineering (SRE) best practices: SLOs and error budgets, blameless post-incident reviews, reducing toil through automation, capacity planning, and designing for graceful degradation.</li> <li value="4">Experience owning services in production, including on-call, incident response, and monitoring with tools such as Prometheus and Grafana.</li> <li value="5">Practical knowledge of progressive delivery: how to roll changes safely across a fleet and how to roll them back.</li> <li value="6">A strong understanding of distributed-systems fundamentals, such as request routing, proxies, consistency, and failure domains.</li> <li value="7">Experience working effectively in distributed, all-remote teams: you default to asynchronous, written-first communication, document decisions in issues and merge requests, hand off work cleanly across time zones, and stay transparent about progress and blockers.</li> <li value="8">Experience with Cloudflare, Spanner, Argo CD, TypeScript, or operating GitLab at scale is a plus, not a requirement.</li> </ul> <h2>About the team</h2> <p>Every team in our organization owns its services end to end, from design through on-call.We own the control plane that tracks cells and decides where each request belongs, and keep the fleet in step with GitLab's release cadence.We work closely with delivery, database, migration, and product teams across GitLab. Feature teams own how their services behave on the platform; we own the underlying infrastructure.We're an all-remote, asynchronous team. We make decisions in GitLab issues, use directly responsible individuals (DRIs) to own technical direction, demo our work weekly, and use AI-assisted workflows every day.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><h4><strong>How GitLab Supports Full-Time Employees</strong></h4> <ul> <li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/">Benefits to support your health, finances, and well-being</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/time-off-and-absence/time-off-types/#flexible-paid-time-off-pto">Flexible Paid Time Off </a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/company/culture/inclusion/tmrg-tmag/">Team Member Resource Groups</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/stock-options/">Equity Compensation & Employee Stock Purchase Plan</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/learning-and-development/growth-and-development/">Growth and Development Fund</a></li> <li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/#parental-leave">Parental Leave</a> </li> </ul> <p>Please note that we welcome interest from candidates with varying levels of experience; many successful candidates do not meet every single requirement. Additionally, studies have shown that people from <a href="https://about.gitlab.com/company/culture/inclusion/#examples-of-select-underrepresented-groups">underrepresented groups</a> are less likely to apply to a job unless they meet every single qualification. If you're excited about this role, please apply and allow our recruiters to assess your application.</p> <hr> <p><strong>Country Hiring Guidelines: </strong>GitLab hires new team members in countries around the world. All of our roles are remote, however some roles may carry specific location-based eligibility requirements. Our Talent Acquisition team can help answer any questions about location after starting the recruiting process.  </p> <p><strong>Privacy Policy: </strong>Please review our <a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/hiring/candidate-faq/recruitment-privacy-policy/" target="_blank">Recruitment Privacy Policy.</a> Your privacy is important to us.</p> <p>GitLab is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. GitLab’s policies and practices relating to recruitment, employment, career development and advancement, promotion, and retirement are based solely on merit, regardless of race, color, religion, ancestry, sex (including pregnancy, lactation, sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression), national origin, age, citizenship, marital status, mental or physical disability, genetic information (including family medical history), discharge status from the military, protected veteran status (which includes disabled veterans, recently separated veterans, active duty wartime or campaign badge veterans, and Armed Forces service medal veterans), or any other basis protected by law. title: Stage Bouw
description: Hé stage topper! Kom jij, net als vele andere stagiaires, stagelopen bij Dura Vermeer Bouw en Vastgoed Hengelo? Bij ons krijg jij de kans om mee te denken, werken én ontwikkelen aan gave projecten binnen Noord, Midden en Oost-Nederland. Wij hebben weer volop stageplekken vanaf Februari 2027 op onze bouwen en op kantoor! Dit wordt jouw stage Als stagiair bij Dura Vermeer Bouw en Vastgoed Hengelo ga je aan de slag op ons kantoor of op één van onze projecten. We kijken in overeenstemming welke afdeling of welk project het beste bij jou en/of de opdracht past. Tijdens je stage word je goed begeleid door één van onze collega’s en krijg je de ruimte om jezelf verder te ontwikkelen! Jij staat aan het stuur van je eigen ontwikkeling tijdens je stageperiode: Hoe meer jij wil leren, hoe meer jij kan leren! Naast dat je zelfstandig aan een opdracht kan werken wordt je ook begeleidt door een senior collega die jou alle kneepjes van het vak gaat leren. We hebben door heel ons werkgebied verschillende bouwen waar we ruimte hebben voor een stagiaire, stuur ons vooral een berichtje zodat we samen kunnen kijken wat passend is! Meer bij Dura Vermeer Dura Vermeer is een familiebedrijf. Een onafhankelijke bouwonderneming actief in woningbouw, utiliteitsbouw, infrastructuur en techniek in Nederland. Al sinds 1855 vormen onze onafhankelijkheid en langjarige continuïteit de basis voor onze strategie. Met een omzet van circa € 1,8 miljard en ruim 3.000 medewerkers behoren we tot de top van de Nederlandse bouwsector. Samen realiseren we prachtige projecten. Iconische, en soms ook alledaagse projecten waarmee we nieuwe antwoorden bieden op maatschappelijke vraagstukken. Waarmee we de beste oplossingen voor morgen garanderen en het verschil maken voor Nederland, juist op de langere termijn. We hebben stevige ambities – en daarvoor geldt dat we die alleen kunnen waarmaken dankzij onze mensen. Als beste werkgever maken wij ons er daarom hard voor dat jij elke dag opnieuw kiest voor Dura Vermeer. Dat jij net zo trots bent op wat we maken als wij dat zijn. Dat iedereen die bij ons werkt gelukkig is. Dat je bij ons jezelf kunt zijn, je veilig voelt en je kunt uitspreken. En dat je tot je recht komt. En het beste uit jezelf kunt halen. Hier zit je goed! Wij zijn Dura Vermeer Bouw en Vastgoed Hengelo, een ontwikkelende bouwer in het werkgebied Noord-, Oost- en Midden-Nederland. Als onderdeel van de divisie Bouw & Vastgoed combineren we de kracht van een groot bedrijf, met de fijne sfeer en cultuur van een kleinere organisatie. Bij ons vind je echte doeners en waarmakers. We ontwikkelen en bouwen, samen met onze klanten, partners en collega’s. Wat ons ons maakt? Gewoon dóen en gewóón doen. Dat zit er nou eenmaal in, en zie je terug in alles wat we doen. Wil jij nou werken op een plek waar vakmanschap, samenwerking en heel veel plezier samenkomen? Mooi! Wij zoeken nieuwe collega’s binnen onze disciplines ontwikkeling, woningbouw, utiliteitsbouw, renovatie & transformatie en beheer & exploitatie. Dit breng je mee Je volgt een MBO, HBO of WO opleiding (pre: opleiding Bouwkunde); Je bent proactief, nuchter en een harde werker, net als wij! Dit bieden wij jou Een stagevergoeding van €700 per maand op basis van 40 uren per week; Je krijgt ruimte voor eigen initiatieven; De beste collega’s om het vak van te leren en zij zorgen voor een ongekende goede werksfeer; Een familiebedrijf waarin we voor elkaar klaarstaan! Meer weten? Wij beantwoorden je vragen graag of denken graag met je mee voor het invullen van je stagewens. Schroom niet om contact op te nemen met Nikki Koehorst via 0628362285 of Hopelijk spreken we elkaar snel! Find more English Speaking Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

title: Principal Design Engineer - Mechanical Equipment (80-100%)
description: Lead technically by doing. Join our Design Engineering team as a highly experienced individual contributor. You will take on challenging mechanical design problems yourself, from concepts and CAD models to manufacturing drawings, prototypes and tested hardware, while helping the wider team make strong technical decisions. As a Principal Design Engineer, you are a hands-on member of our Design Engineering team, designing Climeworks’ CO2 collectors, the heart of our direct air capture plant. Improving how they perform, are manufactured and scale is central to the future success of DAC. Mechanical concept & product design: You personally turn new concepts into robust physical products: developing mechanical concepts, creating CAD models, designing components and complete collector assemblies, producing manufacturing drawings, and supporting hardware through fabrication, assembly and testing. Engineering problem-solving & risk reduction: Your experience helps you find the right solutions faster, anticipate problems early and reduce risk before issues reach manufacturing or testing. CO2 collector design: You take mechanical systems from requirements and concepts through to detailed, manufacturable designs. You develop solutions, perform engineering calculations and make the decisions needed to create robust industrial hardware. First-principles engineering: You use experience and first-principles reasoning to identify risks early, evaluate alternatives quickly and converge on simple, robust solutions. You apply calculations, tolerance analysis, design reviews and testing to reduce uncertainty. Own design from concept to commercialisation: You work directly in SolidWorks to create and modify parts, assemblies and system layouts.
