title: Technology and Operational Risk Senior Manager
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong><em>🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.</em></strong></p> <p>We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.</p> <p>After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/personal">personal</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/business-banking">business</a> bank accounts, we offer <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/joint-account">joint accounts</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/16-17">accounts for 16-17 year olds</a>, a <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/under-16s">free kids account</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/flex">credit cards</a> in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. Our UK customers can also <a href="https://monzo.com/savings">save</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/investments">invest </a>and <a href="https://monzo.com/pensions">combine their pensions</a> with us. </p> <p>With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers!</p> <p>We’re not about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo ❤️</p> <hr> <p> </p></div><p>📍Dublin, Ireland | 💰<strong>€92,000 - €116,000, Incentive Awards tied to your performance ➕ benefits</strong>|<a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=U62l09nB0M4"> Hear from the team</a> ✨</p> <p><strong>⭐ Our Risk team</strong></p> <p>We are looking for an <strong>Operational, Technology and Information Security Risk Senior Manager</strong> in the second line of defence to provide independent oversight, challenge and advisory support on the effectiveness of our operational, technology, resilience and information security risk management practices across the EU. </p> <p>You will be a key member of the second line risk management team and work closely with senior stakeholders across first line technology, information security and operational resilience, to ensure risks are proactively identified, assessed, monitored, and managed in line with Monzo's risk management framework and appetite.</p> <p>This role requires a proactive and strategic mindset, strong technology risk management expertise, and a deep understanding of operational resilience and digital banking operations. </p> <p>This role reports to the Director of Operational Risk, Monzo Europe.</p> <p>The role you are applying for is a Controlled Function within the meaning of the Central Bank Reform Act, 2010. For this role, appointment will be conditional on Monzo being fully satisfied that the appointee meets the requirements as set out in the Fitness and Probity Standards issued by the Central Bank of Ireland. As a CF, the role holder will be subject to Conduct Standards under the Central Bank of Ireland Individual Accountability Framework (IAF) and will be required to take reasonable steps to ensure that the relevant conduct standards are met.</p> <p> <strong>🔑 You’ll play a key role by...</strong></p> <ul> <li>Acting as the second line subject matter expert for operational risk, technology (ICT and security risk (including cyber)), and operational resilience.</li> <li>Reviewing and challenging the design and effectiveness of controls over key technology systems, digital infrastructure.</li> <li>Providing effective oversight and challenge of first line risk and control self-assessments (RCSA), incident management and reporting, issue remediation and risk mitigation processes.</li> <li>Providing second line input into our technology and security strategies and business continuity planning.</li> <li>Supporting the ongoing development and maintenance of our Operational Risk Management Framework (ORMF), policies, standards and associated ICT,  Security and Resilience policies and risk appetite metrics.</li> <li>Co-ordinating second line assurance reviews and risk deep dives into critical operational and technology areas, providing actionable recommendations and insights.</li> <li>Overseeing ongoing compliance with  the digital operational resilience act (DORA) in the EU and ensuring alignment  with applicable local regulatory standards.</li> <li>Preparing operational and technology risk reports and providing updates to relevant governance forums, including risk committees and senior management.</li> </ul> <p> <strong>🤩 We’d love to hear from you if…</strong></p> <ul> <li>You have 8+ years’ experience in operational risk, technology risk or related roles in financial services, ideally within a digital or challenger bank, or a pan-European firm. </li> <li>You have a deep knowledge of risk management practices, regulatory expectations, and industry standards related to operational risk, technology and operational resilience. (e.g. EBA Guidelines on ICT & Security Risk Management, DORA, Central Bank of Ireland Guidance on Operational Resilience, General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR), Payment Service Directive (PSD2/PSD3)).</li> <li>You have a strong understanding of digital banking technology, including cloud computing, cybersecurity, fintech integrations and data management.</li> <li>You have experience in evaluating and challenging risk and control environments, particularly in high-growth or fast-changing environments.</li> <li>You are an ambitious risk professional ready to leave the constraints of legacy firms behind. This role places you at the cutting edge of technology and operational risk, challenging you to define the governance needed for our next-generation platforms.</li> <li>You have strong analytical, problem-solving and project management skills.</li> <li>You have excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to influence senior leadership. </li> <li>You have a proven ability to navigate complex stakeholder landscapes such as working with regulators/managing regulatory engagements.</li> </ul> <p>Not ticking every box? That’s totally okay! Studies show that women and people of colour might hesitate to apply unless they meet every single requirement. At Monzo, we’re dedicated to creating a diverse and welcoming team. If you’re passionate about this role and keen to learn and grow with us, we encourage you to apply— even if you don’t have everything that's listed just yet. Drop us your application, we’d love to hear from you!</p> <p><strong>🙌What’s in it for you</strong></p> <p>💰 A salary range of €92,000 - €116,000 ➕Incentive Awards tied to your performance.</p> <p>📍This role will have a hybrid working model, based in our Dublin office 2 - 3 days a week.</p> <p>⏰We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, and at times that suit you and your team. </p> <p>🏝 Annual Leave - 34 days including public holidays (24 holiday days + 10 public holidays)</p> <p>📚€1,200 learning budget each year to use on books, training courses and conferences.</p> <p>🏥Private healthcare scheme</p> <p>💰Pension scheme: the minimum contribution is 4% and Monzo matches any additional contributions that you make up to a maximum of 6%</p> <p>💛Wellbeing benefits: financial education, women’s and men’s health support, mental health benefits, including coaching and counselling</p> <p><strong>🌈 The application journey has 4 key steps</strong></p> <ul> <li>An introductory call with a member of the Monzo Recruitment team</li> <li>An initial call with the hiring manager</li> <li>A series of role specific and behavioural interviews</li> <li>A final call with Monzo Bank Europe's CRO</li> </ul> <p>This process should take around 3-4 weeks - your schedule is really important to us, so we promise to be as flexible as possible! </p> <p>We have some guidelines on using Artificial Intelligence (AI) to ace an application and interview at Monzo. <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/the-ultimate-guide-on-using-ai-to-ace-an-interview-at-monzo">You can read them here.</a></p> <p>We’ll only close this role once we have enough applications for the next stage. Please submit your application as soon as possible to make sure you don’t miss out. </p> <p>If you're successful in applying for this role, we'll work with you to find a start date. In some cases, there might be a delay in when you can be released from your current role so that we can make sure things continue to run smoothly. We’ll be sure to communicate this with you and keep you updated.</p> <p>#LI-ÉS1</p><div class="content-conclusion"><hr> <p><strong>Equal opportunities for everyone</strong></p> <p>Diversity and inclusion are a priority for us and we’re making sure we have lots of support for all of our people to grow at Monzo. title: Accountant
description: <h3> </h3> <p>Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.</p> <p>The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.</p> <h3> </h3> <h3><strong>The role of an Accountant at Canonical:</strong></h3> <p>If you are passionate about the technology industry and want to work for a company that aligns with your interests, we might be the place for you! Canonical, and our world class Ubuntu product, attracts some of the leading talent from around the world. Come and work with exceptional people and advance your career in Finance! </p> <p>Our Finance team is growing and it's a really exciting time to join the team. We are looking for bright, motivated people who have a passion for making a difference. You will be seeking an opportunity to drive process improvements and change, input your ideas and truly contribute to a highly productive team. </p> <p>We are looking for an exceptional Accountant with IFRS experience to help us ready the business for public market scrutiny through our planned IPO.  The right candidate will have domain expertise and a passion for IFRS.  </p> <p><strong>Location: </strong>This role may be office based in London, or Remote in EMEA Time Zones. </p> <h3>What your day will look like</h3> <ul> <li>Assist in the month end reporting process to deliver timely and accurate information</li> <li>Have full responsibility for a part of the ledger processes relevant to your strengths</li> <li>Assist with the year end audit process and statutory reporting</li> <li>Support the finance team's wider plans to prepare for an IPO</li> <li>Improve the efficiency of financial processes and procedures and monitor compliance</li> <li>Share knowledge between team members to ensure cover is available when needed</li> <li>Actively develop your own skills to ensure current knowledge of applicable standards and regulations</li> <li>Establish strong relationships with key colleagues outside the wider finance team</li> </ul> <h3>What we are looking for in you</h3> <ul> <li>Exceptional academic track record and subsequent career performance</li> <li>Bachelor's degree in Accounting or equivalent</li> <li>Qualified accountant (ACCA, ACA, ACMA, CPA, etc.)</li> <li>Experience at a large public accounting firm, or public multinational corporate accounting department preferred</li> <li>NetSuite or similar enterprise grade systems experience</li> <li>Willingness to travel up to four times per year</li> </ul> <h3> </h3> <h3><strong>What we offer colleagues</strong></h3> <p>We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. This team will help us gain insights into the business and our talent pool, and use those insights to improve the experience of working at Canonical.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">As a Workplace Engineer at Canonical, you need an analytical, data-driven mind and a passion to connect and make sense of interesting data from APIs. We focus heavily on the collection of metrics, optimising processes, and ways of working across Canonical.  You need to demonstrate leadership, excellence, and consistency and will mentor others in the team.</span></p> <h3><strong>What we offer colleagues</strong></h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.</span></p> <ul> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Annual compensation review</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Recognition rewards</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Annual holiday leave</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Maternity and paternity leave</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long-haul company events</span></li> </ul> <h3><strong>About Canonical</strong></h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004.​ Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.</span></p> <p><strong>Canonical is an equal opportunity employer</strong></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products.</span><a href="https://canonical.com/careers/diversity/identity"><span style="font-weight: 400;"> Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.</span></a></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">#LI-remote</span></p> <p> </p>

title: Customer Success  - Team Manager
description: <p>Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1000+ colleagues in 70+ countries and very few office based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.</p> <p>The company is founder led, profitable and growing. </p> <p><strong>We are hiring a Customer Success - Team Manager.</strong></p> <p>To support Canonical's growth, we are expanding our CSM team globally and recruiting leaders to support and drive our Customer Success teams regionally. We consider our Customer Success operations an exceptional tool to sustain revenue retention and growth, placing excellence in delivering outstanding customer services in the new technologies sector. As such, we are looking for exceptional candidates with proven track records in Customer Success management and an obvious passion for new technologies. </p> <p>You will enjoy this role if you are organised, persistent, analytical, diplomatic, a listener, hard-working, and determined to grow your skills and teams. As a lead, you will provide mentoring, coaching in post-sales account management and feedback to team members. You will play a crucial role in proactively identifying areas of improvement and implementing process change, driving high-performing teams. Comfortable dealing with ambiguity you will be equip to quickly adapt to change. Collaboration with other teams is also vital to this role to enhance the overall customer experience. Your key responsibility will be to analyze regional performance metrics, identify trends and opportunities for improvement, and implement changes to increase efficiency and achieve business objectives. You will work in close collaboration with the Global Head of Customer Success to drive results.</p> <p>We engage with a diverse customer base and follow a diverse set of motions to provide the appropriate and required level of focus for every customer. The successful candidate will be able to demonstrate the ability to pivot right across this customer base regardless of culture, location or focus.</p> <p><strong>Location: </strong>This opportunity is available in the APAC region and is remote.</p> <p><strong>The role entails:</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Strategic planning and analysis:</strong> preparing communication plans, team meetings, and other messages shared in broader management forums, setting yourself and your team up for success. Regularly reviewing key performance indicators and metrics is your baseline. You will develop strategies to enhance customer engagement, improve retention rates, drive up-sells or cross-sells where appropriate, and ultimately increase customer success.</li> <li><strong>Customer interactions and support to your team:</strong> resolve escalated customer issues requiring expertise or intervention ensuring timely resolution.</li> <li><strong>Team management:</strong> passionate about guiding and supporting your team members, helping them navigate complex customer situations, improve their skills, and achieve their goals. Conducting regular performance reviews with team members you will also help identifying areas for improvement/development as well as celebrating excellence, recognising team achievements, and setting goals for individual growth. </li> <li><strong>Cross-functional collaboration: </strong>collaboration with other departments, such as Sales, Marketing, Product development, and Support, is essential. This ensures alignment on customer needs, feedback sharing, and coordinated efforts to drive customer success. You will establish trustworthy channels of communication across the board.</li> <li><strong>Documentation and reporting: </strong>you are allowed to be creative! While building content with your team and your manager, you will also ensure the changes are well documented, instilling quality and attention to detail in all you do.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What we are looking for in you</strong></p> <ul> <li>Excellent academic results at school and university</li> <li>Bachelor’s or equivalent degree in Business, Communication or STEM subject</li> <li>Knowledge and passion for Customer Success, revenue management and technology, experience in SaaS or software industries</li> <li>Track record of bringing exceptional Customer Success experience results</li> <li>Commitment to continuous learning and improvement - curious, flexible, scientific</li> <li>Creative problem-solving and cross-team collaboration</li> <li>Experience growing and developing a CSM team</li> <li>Hands-on approach to using data to drive team activities and continuous improvement</li> <li>Willingness to travel up to 4 times a year for internal events</li> </ul> <p><strong>Nice-to-have skills</strong></p> <ul> <li>Whilst English is our business language, proficiency (both written and spoken) in Japanese, Korean, Spanish, Portuguese, or French will be valued.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What we offer you</strong></p> <p>We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.</p> <ul> <li>Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person - we’ve been working remotely since 2004!</li> <li>Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year</li> <li>Annual compensation review</li> <li>Recognition rewards</li> <li>Annual holiday leave</li> <li>Maternity and paternity leave</li> <li>Employee Assistance Programme</li> <li>Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues from your team and others</li> <li>Priority Pass for travel</li> </ul> <p><strong>About Canonical</strong></p> <p>Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since its inception in 2004.​ Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.</p> <p><strong>Canonical is an equal opportunity employer</strong></p> <p>We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background creates a better work environment and better products. <a href="https://canonical.com/careers/diversity/identity">Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.</a></p> <p> </p> <p>#LI-remote </p>

We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. WHO WE ARE Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion. Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work. ABOUT THE ROLE Notion sits at a rare intersection: a product people love, a flexible system businesses run on, and a new platform for people and AI to work together. We’re hiring a Product Manager to turn that opportunity into products that feel inevitable. You’ll find consequential customer problems, set a bold but grounded strategy, and build alongside design, engineering, data science, research, and go-to-market partners. This is a high-agency role for someone excited to shape what Notion becomes next—and make powerful new capabilities feel simple, trustworthy, and delightful to millions of customers. This role can be based in either San Francisco or New York City. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days. WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE: - Uncover the customer problems and product opportunities that will define Notion’s next chapter, then turn them into a focused strategy and roadmap. - Take ambitious ideas from first principles to launch, building closely with design and engineering to create experiences that feel simple, useful, and distinctly Notion. - Make the hard calls—balancing customer impact, business opportunity, technical complexity, speed, and long-term product quality. - Shape how AI changes both the product and the way we build, using it to improve research, decisions, experimentation, and execution. - Raise the bar for product thinking across the team by creating clarity, accelerating learning, and establishing principles and success measures that endure. SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: - Demonstrated ability to identify meaningful customer problems and turn them into products that are intuitive, useful, and built with a high level of craft. - Strong product judgment and the ability to make sound tradeoffs among user experience, business impact, technical complexity, quality, and speed. - A track record of moving ambiguous, cross-functional work from problem definition to shipped outcomes while creating clear ownership and alignment. - Customer depth: you can learn directly from users across segments and translate differing needs into a coherent strategy rather than a collection of one-off requests. - Practical AI fluency: you use AI to sharpen research, product thinking, decisions, and execution, and you’re excited to rethink how people and agents work together. NICE TO HAVES: - Experience building collaborative, productivity, or AI-powered products used by a broad range of customers. - Experience operating across both zero-to-one product development and the improvement of products at scale. - Technical fluency and comfort partnering deeply with engineering on complex product systems. Notion is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. title: Engineering Manager - Distributed Systems, Python / Go
location: Home Based - Americas; Home based - EMEA
description: <p>Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, as well as industry leaders across many sectors.</p> <p>Canonical is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1,200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.</p> <p>The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.</p> <p>We are hiring an<strong> Engineering Manager for Distributed Systems Testing </strong>to lead a team responsible for the quality engineering platform that enables deployment and validation of distributed systems across Canonical's cloud portfolio.</p> <p>We see quality engineering as a first-class engineering practice. Our Distributed Systems Testing team ensures the performance, correctness, resilience and interoperability of Canonical cloud solutions built with technologies such as Juju, Terraform, OpenStack and Kubernetes. These systems are deployed and tested across diverse environments, from bare-metal to the public cloud.</p> <p>As Engineering Manager, you will combine strong software engineering judgement with people leadership. You will develop engineering talent, establish effective engineering practices, shape technical direction with senior engineers, and ensure the team delivers high-quality testing infrastructure and automation that enables engineering teams across Canonical to ship software with confidence.</p> <p>We believe engineering managers should be outstanding engineers themselves. You should be comfortable reviewing patches, evaluating software design, debugging a distributed system, or discussing test architecture. title: Software Engineer - Cross-platform C++ - Multipass
description: <p>Use your deep C++ skills on Windows and MacOS to build an amazing open source developer experience with <a href="https://github.com/canonical/multipass">Multipass</a>, the workstation mini-cloud at your fingertips which provides Ubuntu and appliance VMs on demand for build, test and prototyping. The Multipass team is hiring a Software Engineer to join our distributed team. We greatly value quality in our code, and great user experience.</p> <p>Multipass is published for macOS, Windows, and also Linux. Think of it as a workstation mini-cloud. At its simplest you can simply say <strong>multipass launch</strong> and you will get a new VM on your workstation. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work. ABOUT THE ROLE: You will lead Notion’s GTM strategy and growth for France, one of EMEA’s largest and highest-priority markets. France is a Tier 1 region in Notion’s country-first EMEA model, with significant room to scale into a standalone, high-growth business. Notion is shifting from a traditional sales model toward a builder-led model with fewer handoffs, stronger technical fluency, and more direct ownership of customer outcomes. As General Manager, France, you will be the second-line leader responsible for overall revenue outcomes, regional GTM strategy, and the operating model for the French business. You will lead through frontline managers, teams of Business Development Representatives, Solutions Consultants and Outcomes Architects as well as partner cross functionally with Professional Services, Channel Partnerships and RevOps. This is a hands-on builder-leader role for an AI-native, country-first GTM model. You will bring Notion’s new GTM model to life in France: moving from a segment-first motion to a country-first, AI-native operating system where teams help customers diagnose problems, design agentic workflows, and build real systems with Notion AI. This role sits on the EMEA Leadership Team and reports to the General Manager, EMEA. This role will be based in Paris. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days. WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE: - Own the GTM strategy, operating rhythm, and growth plan for France, with accountability for overall regional revenue outcomes across Sales Assist and Self Serve contribution. - Lead as a second-line manager: hire, coach, and develop frontline leaders and IC teams across Business Development, Solutions Consulting, Outcomes Architecture, Forward Deployed Architecture/Engineering, and supporting GTM functions. - Scale a country-first GTM motion that brings Notion closer to French customers through local executive engagement, market nuance, and faster field-level decision-making. - Accelerate the land engine by opening the right front doors, growing professional workspaces, increasing net-new and upgrade opportunities, and connecting self-serve signals to sales-assisted motion. - Win lighthouse customers and turn them into market momentum by making them wildly successful, telling their story locally, and using those wins to influence peer companies across France. - Embed Notion’s AI-era GTM model across the team, including agent-enabled customer journeys, first-agent workflow activation, AI/agent demo proficiency, and stronger “build with the customer” motions. - Make agentic transformation central to the French GTM motion: help customers identify high-value workflows, build and deploy Notion Agents, automate cross-functional work, and measure outcomes from AI adoption. - Partner tightly with Solutions Consultants, Outcomes Architects, Forward Deployed Architects/Engineers, Professional Services, Marketing and Channel to reduce handoffs and deliver faster, more durable customer value. - Build “sell with” partner motions in France, including partner-sourced pipeline, co-sell plays, enablement, AI/agentic solution packages, and joint account planning. - Establish Notion as a visible force in the French ecosystem through executive dinners, field events, startup and community engagement, partner activations, and customer advocacy. - Represent the voice of French customers back to Product, PMM, Marketing, and EMEA leadership, especially around AI transformation, enterprise requirements, security, compliance, localization, and competitive dynamics. - Create a talent destination in France by hiring builder-oriented leaders and ICs, raising the craft bar, and developing the next generation of AI-native GTM talent. - Drive operational excellence across forecasting, pipeline quality, territory planning, inspection cadence, performance management, and cross-functional execution. WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR: A strategic and hands-on GTM operator who has scaled enterprise SaaS or AI businesses in France and knows how to build a market, not just inherit one. You have led through managers, owned complex revenue outcomes, and created local market momentum through customers, partners, community, and talent. You combine second-line leadership with builder energy. You can set a crisp country strategy, install the operating system to execute it, and step into the field when needed — whether joining an executive customer conversation, sharpening a pipeline plan, coaching a manager, or helping the team translate a customer problem into an AI-powered, agentic workflow. You are excited by Notion’s shift to an AI-native, country-first GTM model and believe the best GTM teams will increasingly be builders: BDRs who identify transformation opportunities, Solutions Consultants who build with customers in the room, Outcomes Architects who turn early workflows into durable adoption, and Forward Deployed Architects/Engineers who design the technical systems behind complex agentic workflows. SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: - 12+ years of professional experience, including 5+ years leading SaaS or AI sales & GTM teams in France. - Deep knowledge of the French enterprise and startup ecosystem, including executive buyer networks, local partner channels, and market-specific buying dynamics across all market segments (commercial, midmarket and enterprise) - Proven second-line leadership experience, including hiring, coaching, and developing frontline managers and high-performing IC teams. - Track record of owning and exceeding revenue targets across new business, expansion, and renewal/churn dynamics. - Agency & Urgency: experience building or scaling a regional/country business in a high-growth or ambiguous environment. - Experience selling, implementing, or leading GTM teams around AI, automation, agentic workflows, collaboration, productivity, developer, or data products. - Strong strategic judgment: ability to define a country plan, segment the market, prioritize accounts and plays, and align cross-functional teams around outcomes. - Operational rigor across forecasting, pipeline generation, inspection, performance management, territory planning, and sales process. - Executive presence with CIO, CTO, CPO, COO, and business transformation buyers, with the ability to shape a compelling AI and agentic workflow narrative. - Strong understanding of modern GTM motions across Business Development, Solutions Consulting, Outcomes Architecture, Forward Deployed Architecture/Engineering, Professional Services, Channel, Marketing, RevOps, and Product. - Builder mentality and deep AI curiosity: comfortable learning, demoing, and coaching teams on agent-first workflows, proof-of-value motions, and customer co-building. - Fluency in French and English. NICE TO HAVES: - Experience launching or scaling a country-first or regional GTM operating model. - Familiarity with enterprise security, compliance, APIs, webhooks, connectors, data residency, AI governance, and technical evaluation processes. - Experience scaling partner, channel, marketplace, or consultant-led GTM motions around AI or workflow transformation. Notion is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. The compensation offered for this role will be based on multiple factors such as location, the role's scope and complexity, and the candidate's experience and expertise, and may vary from the range provided below. The estimated range for total on target earnings (including base salary and on target incentive pay) for this role is €350,000 - €408,000 per year. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on. EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & ACCOMMODATIONS We hire talented people from a wide range of backgrounds. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every bullet, we still encourage you to apply. Notion is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any legally protected characteristic. description: <p>The Workplace Engineering function sits at the intersection of traditional HR analytics and modern Product Engineering. You aren't just managing analysts; you are leading a product squad.</li> <li>Product Ownership on People Science: Bridge the gap between "HR-speak" and "Dev-speak", ensuring engineers understand the human behavioral intent behind the code.</li> <li>Strategic Insight & Business Outcomes: Move beyond descriptive metrics (e.g., turnover rate) to predictive and prescriptive insights (e.g., predicting attrition risk based on "Time-Product" engagement data).</li> <li>Data Stewardship & Product Storytelling: Act as the "Translator-in-Chief". Take complex data models and turn them into compelling narratives. Lead the development of AI Agents that can surface insights to managers in real-time. Ensure the "People Data Stack" is secure, GDPR/privacy-compliant, and acts as a "Single Source of Truth" across all People related offerings, products and services.</li> <li>“Effectiveness at Work” Strategy: Identify opportunities to leverage “High Tech” solutions in our People offerings, and free up more time for “High Touch”, human involvement, thereby maximizing human value.</li> </ul> <h3>What we are looking for in you</h3> <ul> <li>Background in data science, mathematics, or engineering, skilled in advanced statistics, data wrangling/science, databases (SQL, etc.) or software engineering.</li> <li>Strength in coding/scripting languages (Python, R, JavaScript, etc.), software engineering, visualization (e.g. Superset, Tableau), and automation.</li> <li>Ability to translate business questions to key research objectives.</li> <li>Ability to identify the best methodology to execute research, synthesize and analyze findings.</li> <li>Proven ability to lead and drive others to execute against well planned roadmaps, with a strong mentor/coaching mindset. </li> <li>Willingness to examine the status quo and be resilient in the face of challenges.</li> <li>Ambition to build tomorrow's AI/Data stack in open source.</li> <li>An exceptional academic track record from high school and university.</li> <li>Business level written and spoken English.</li> <li>Sincere personal motivation aligned with our mission.</li> <li>International travel 2-4 times a year for company events up to two weeks long.</li> </ul> <p>In addition we expect that you will match our values, by being:</p> <ul> <li>Precise, taking care to deliver correctness and clarity.</li> <li>Reliable, delivering high quality work that builds trust and confidence.</li> <li>Accessible, collaborating to build products and systems that are usable.</li> <li>Adroit, blending enthusiasm, knowledge, adaptability, style and character.</li> </ul> <h3>Nice-to-have skills</h3> <ul> <li>Experience with dbt (Data Build Tool), Airbyte, Ranger, Superset, Temporal, or Trino</li> <li>Basic understanding of containerization technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes</li> <li>Agentic Engineering</li> <li>Product management</li> <li>User experience and design</li> </ul> <h3>What we offer colleagues</h3> <p>We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. We are founder-led, profitable, and growing.</p> <p>Powered by worldwide distributed collaboration since our inception in 2004, we believe tech and business leadership can emerge anywhere. We have no central headquarters. Most of us work from home, but we are exceptionally disciplined about this. We have very high expectations of all colleagues, and are champions of excellence. description: <p>Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. <strong>Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives</strong> such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. This critical function is part of our mission to transform Linux certification, in partnership with the engineering directors of Ubuntu Enablement and Ubuntu Certification. Our goal is to deliver the world's best long term OS stability commitment on PC, server and IoT hardware.</p> <p>We believe that Engineering Directors should be outstanding engineers themselves. They should be very comfortable reviewing a patch or a software design spec. They are trusted engineers who understand the importance of a whole-team effort in creating great products, and who enjoy seeing colleagues develop. They should contribute code themselves to set the standard for coding, but know that the code they write is far less significant than their ability to shape the whole team’s direction, focus and delivery. We grow management skills, and train engineers who are interested in soft skills to be managers. Even though this is a director level position, managing managers, we expect Engineering Directors to be outstanding system software engineers with the confidence to lead by example across the full range of activities in their teams. You’ll need to know how to drive testing and benchmarking to improve the clarity in your teams around quality and performance. You’ll also need to be confident to set and defend high expectations of work ethic, consistency, focus and learning.</p> <p>In this Engineering Director role, you will lead the strategy and the team responsible for quality coordination and integration testing of our software stacks with hardware. We are looking for a quality expert with the ability to establish quality processes from the ground up. The candidate must understand today's PC and ARM IoT hardware, and be excited about the new generation of RISC-V hardware that is on the horizon. They should understand the board and device product lifecycle and know the tools and techniques used to introduce new products. They will work with teams across the company to drive quality improvements through the entire development cycle. This challenging role demands a high degree of technical skill combined with management experience.</p> <p>Today, most Linux certification is poor quality. Vendors run one set of tests and then declare that 'the hardware is certified'. But Linux is not a static platform. We make many more security fixes in the Linux world than people traditionally made in the proprietary OS world - all of these need to be tested on hardware which has been certified, even if that certification is 'old'. Also, Linux and open source evolve significantly every six months, and even more between major enterprise releases like the Ubuntu LTS versions. During the lifespan of an LTS, new kernel improvements will be available to users, and they want to be sure that their hardware will work. Today's Linux certification programs do not meet the needs of its users, and we want to change that.</p> <p>Our intention is to deliver <strong>continuous quality and certification</strong> across the entire portfolio of certified hardware. Once we have enabled and certified a device, we intend to keep testing it to ensure that every single change we deliver to Ubuntu users globally is verified on all the hardware we know about. We also intend to <strong>measure energy consumption</strong> on a continuous process, as part of our commitment to <strong>measure, manage and drive down the carbon footprint of Ubuntu</strong> usage around the planet. We are building the world's largest and best-equipped Linux device certification facility in Taipei, which will enable this continuous testing. We are also structuring our renewed partnership and customer agreements to facilitate this process going forward.</p> <p>We believe that open source is just starting to transform the tech sector and enterprise compute. Our goal is to make open source easier, more reliable and more secure for deployment and development. We strive to be the provider of ‘most software to most companies’. To deliver on that ambition, our engineers are carefully selected from the applicants across the globe. We select for brilliance and motivation to take open source to the next level. Our engineering directors and managers help teams achieve more than they thought they could, and feel proud of the result.</p> <p>As an Engineering Director at Canonical your primary responsibility is to the teams you lead, to ensure that they measure outcomes, make process improvements, do valuable work, and find career satisfaction at Canonical. Technical leadership is a requirement, so that you’re able to challenge and grow your teams. Strong aptitude for planning, management and operations are necessary too. You will meet with stakeholders, prioritize requests, plan your roadmap and ensure the team can deliver their goals.</p> <p><strong>Location:</strong> As an Engineering Director position, this requires a candidate who is confident to run a project which spans several teams and time zones, hiring and managing both engineering managers and staff engineers. certification lab.</p> <h3>Key responsibilities</h3> <ul> <li>Manage, mentor and grow the software engineering teams addressing hardware enablement quality assurance and testing</li> <li>Lead the OEM Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1100+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.</p> <p>The company is founder led, profitable and growing.</p> <p>Location: <span style="font-weight: 300;">This is an office based role. </span>We expect the suitable candidate to be based in Toronto as you will be required to work on-site at our lab.</p> <p>We are hiring a MAAS Systems Engineer to focus on building tooling to increase data center operational efficiency. As a MAAS Systems Engineer in Canonical, you will be responsible for the day-to-day management and operations of our lab in the Toronto area, which we use for Ubuntu server certification of US based silicon and server designs. You'll write and use software that deploys and configures servers and network switches, and solve difficult design problems related to doing this well and fast at scale. You will work with a mixture of hardware: cutting edge new silicon that Kernel Team and Partner Engineering teams work on to make them run Linux extremely well, as well as established hardware to make sure new versions of Ubuntu are smooth and fast. This role is a combination of software engineering focusing on reliable automated hardware commissioning and deployment, as well as testing, troubleshooting and experimentation focusing on improving reliability and performance of our software. You don't need to be an expert in all of these areas, but you need to be a good software engineer who is curious about complex distributed systems to succeed in this role. If you love hacking in your home lab, have good Python skills, and are curious about data centre hardware, you will love this opportunity. </p> <p> </p> <h2>This role entails</h2> <ul> <li>Use your Python development skills to develop the Metal as a Service (MAAS) software to work with a large variety of server and network hardware.</li> <li>Actively expand MAAS functionality by creating integrations with testing and scheduling software such as Testflinger.</li> <li>Contribute improvements and fixes to Testflinger.</li> <li>Remotely operate a fully automated server lab with the latest server and network silicon from leading vendors, making sure it remains available to other teams.</li> <li>Improve and extend hardware and network monitoring through automation.</li> <li>Collaborate with other MAAS engineers, as well as data centre hardware specialists, teams responsible for certifying hardware for Ubuntu, kernel engineers and other teams who use the hardware lab.</li> </ul> <h2>What we are looking for in you</h2> <ul> <li>STEM Bachelor’s degree, preferably in Computer Science or Software Engineering</li> <li>Curiosity to find out why some systems misbehave, and drive to figure out how to make them behave</li> <li>Python programming experience</li> <li>Linux Administration experience</li> <li>Ability to communicate clearly and effectively in English</li> <li>Ability to work with a globally distributed team of passionate engineers</li> <li>An exceptional academic track record from both high school and preferably university</li> <li>Willingness to travel up to 4 times a year for internal events</li> </ul> <h2>Nice-to-have skills</h2> <ul> <li>Mix of Rack and Virtual systems experience</li> <li>Troubleshooting skills</li> <li>Systematic approach to testing</li> <li>Love for performance engineering</li> <li>Data centre operations experience</li> </ul> <h2>What we offer colleagues</h2> <p>We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.</p> <ul> <li>Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person</li> <li>Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year</li> <li>Annual compensation review</li> <li>Recognition rewards</li> <li>Annual holiday leave</li> <li>Maternity and paternity leave</li> <li>Employee Assistance Programme</li> <li>Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues</li> <li>Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events</li> </ul> <h2>About Canonical</h2> <p>Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world on a daily basis. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Canonical has been a remote-first company since its inception in 2004.​ Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.</p> <h2>Canonical is an equal opportunity employer</h2> <p>We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products.<a href="https://canonical.com/careers/diversity/identity"> Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.</a></p> <p>#LI-hybrid</p>

description: <p>Canonical is hiring a Python Software Engineer to join the Certification team, who make the tools which enable us to know that a desktop, laptop, server or IoT device is working properly. Canonical offers a fun, fast-paced team environment and a career full of learning and development opportunities. This team is centered in EMEA time zones, and works with colleagues on related teams in both the Americas and APAC.</p> <p>We work together with silicon companies, OEMs, ODMs and teams within Canonical to ensure a smooth, secure out of the box Ubuntu experience, with success in this role leading to a great Ubuntu experience being offered on more and more devices.</p> <h3>Role description</h3> <p>We are looking for a self-motivated software engineer with experience developing in Python, to work on test automation tools or Linux based embedded hardware. title: Renewals Sales Manager, Americas
description: <p>Open source software is the new default in the enterprise, and Canonical is the new challenger to major enterprise software vendors.</p> <p>We are profitable and growing our global enterprise sales organisation. We are hiring a <strong>regional sales renewal team manager</strong> in North America to lead the renewals team in the region.</p> <p>We deliver better open source from the data center to cloud and edge. Our Linux distribution Ubuntu is now the leading platform for public cloud compute, and the favorite platform for software engineers, data scientists and AI developers. Our mission is to accelerate the adoption and quality of open source globally, and our goal is to ship the most software on the planet by cores. A tidal wave of open source innovation is the next phase of the entire enterprise software industry, and we aim to be the most compelling way to ride that wave.</p> <p>Our customers include Global 500 enterprises and startups. We are expanding our product range from the base operating system - Ubuntu - to full enterprise solutions in infrastructure and applications. We can deliver software defined storage, private cloud solutions, container runtime environments, as well as databases, message queues, identity, observability, analytics, machine learning and web publishing capabilities. Customers love the idea that they can get security compliance and support for everything open source from a single company. Our goal is to have more solutions on tap than any other vendor, and we have built unique capabilities to make that possible across every cloud, every class of compute and every category of application.</p> <p>Canonical provides licensed enterprise software products, commercial support, managed services, consulting and training services to customers who are deploying Ubuntu or open source applications on the cloud, in their data center, or to the connected device and IoT ecosystem. We are just over 1,000 colleagues in 70+ countries and over $250m in revenue, profitable, on a steady but relentless growth trajectory. We are almost entirely distributed, with leadership spread across many countries. We believe that talent is equally distributed across the globe, and we are excited to hire, develop, promote and ultimately trust a diverse group of exceptional leads to build the best, not biggest, enterprise software company.</p> <p>We hire carefully and deliberately; our selection process is long and requires substantial work from applicants. It will take successful applicants three to six months to secure an offer. This is not a place to apply if you are in a rush to find a position, it is a worthwhile place to apply if you are ambitious and long-term in your thinking about your career and the dynamics which move the world forward. If you see clearly the rise of open source, and you understand the drivers of enterprise procurement and technical decision making, then you will understand why Canonical has such a tremendous long term advantage. You will also understand, given the ferocity of competition and the challenges of competing in a market of giants, that we have to set a very high bar for hiring and performance. In order to be a world leading company we select for exceptional ability as well as character, and then provide an environment which promotes teamwork and celebrates diligence, collaboration and effectiveness. All of those are easy to say but hard to do - at Canonical we are willing to be uncomfortable in pursuit of that excellence.</p> <p>In building our sales team, we look for five things:</p> <ul> <li>Empathy for the customer - a real understanding of customer needs, industry-specific challenges, and a desire to help customers solve their business problems</li> <li>High intellect - the ability to learn quickly, understand very complex subjects, and communicate clearly to build trust and confidence</li> <li>Passion for technology - a fascination with the state of the art from brilliant people solving hard problems, and fierce competition for large prizes</li> <li>Teamwork - a willingness to help others, to collaborate well with people from different disciplines, and to balance personal and team ambitions</li> <li>Energy - the drive to motivate oneself and others to achieve the best result for the team and our customers</li> </ul> <p>Ubuntu is already very widely adopted which gives us a credible basis for conversations in the market. Nevertheless, it requires real work for sales professionals to build on that adoption to create trusted and profitable commercial relationships with the enterprises in their territory. Our product managers and marketing teams run campaigns to generate awareness, engagement and leads, but you will need to go beyond managing inbound interest to develop the potential of your territory. You will need judgement as to which industries and companies are ready to go deeper with open source and Canonical, and energy to develop relationships in advance of proven interest. We expect professional practice, territory and account planning, as well as clear, complete and continuous reporting on pipeline status and activity, using standard professional tools.</p> <p>The successful candidate will carry an annual team bookings quota within their territory. They should be able to travel regionally for client engagements or, industry conferences, and internationally for company events twice a year. They will be expected to demonstrate professionalism and effectiveness in managing their team. They will need to coach, mentor and lead by example. Their sales representatives are expected to prospect accounts for new business, maintain and develop existing relationships, and work with colleagues and partners on account strategy. They must be comfortable selling enterprise software, open source, cloud, virtualization, container technologies and technical software solutions to senior levels of the enterprise.</p> <p><strong>Location:</strong> We are expanding our sales organisation globally and have open sales team manager roles in every region.</p> <h3>What your day will look like</h3> <ul> <li>Build and execute a territory plan to prioritize outreach and prospecting</li> <li>Allocate portions of territory and accounts to sales representatives on your team</li> <li>Identify and prioritise new logo accounts in your territory for account-based marketing and prospecting</li> <li>Ensure that sales representatives have high quality account plans for existing accounts and priority prospects</li> <li>Monitor new pipeline development by your team, through outreach, prospecting, local marketing, and industry events</li> <li>Support contract closure to meet and exceed quarterly and annual bookings targets</li> <li>Be mindful and proactive in achieving tactical and strategic objectives</li> <li>Work with customer success to identify growth opportunities</li> <li>Ensure your team maintain accurate pipeline data and forecasts within Salesforce</li> <li>Represent the company, its solutions and software</li> </ul> <h3>What we are looking for in you</h3> <ul> <li>Bachelor's level degree, preferably in engineering or computer science</li> <li>Leadership and management skill</li> <li>Experience of open source technology and solutions</li> <li>Detail oriented with effective planning, organisation and reporting skill</li> <li>Experience in enterprise software or technology sales planning and execution</li> <li>Track record of achievement in sales targets and new account wins</li> <li>Self-discipline and motivation to be successful in a distributed team</li> <li>Professional written and spoken English, as well as any language that may be appropriate for your target market</li> <li>Ability to travel for customer engagements, industry events and company events</li> </ul> <h3>Additional skills of interest</h3> <ul> <li>Specific vertical experience, in particular finance, telco, health, energy, public sector, tech</li> <li>Experience speaking at conferences or industry events</li> </ul> <h3>What we offer you</h3> <p>We consider geographical location, title: Représentant du Développement des Ventes
description: <p>Canonical est une entreprise mondiale axée sur le travail à distance qui publie des solutions d'entreprise Ubuntu et open source pour le cloud, les développeurs, l'IoT et l'IA. Ubuntu est la distribution Linux qui connaît la croissance la plus rapide et se classe au premier rang des systèmes d'exploitation dans le cloud.</p> <p>En partenariat avec Google, Amazon, IBM et Microsoft, Canonical aide les entreprises à devenir plus agiles, plus productives et à adopter plus rapidement de nouvelles technologies. Les exemples de réussite client incluent l'IA, la blockchain, l'IoT, la robotique avancée et les voitures autonomes, où Ubuntu est alors la plate-forme de développement privilégiée.</p> <p><strong>Le rôle d'un représentant du développement des ventes chez Canonical</strong></p> <p>Canonical est rentable et en croissance. Nous considérons notre organisation de développement des ventes comme la meilleure académie de vente technologique du marché et, à ce titre, nous sélectionnons des candidats exceptionnels et ambitieux pour rejoindre notre équipe. Vous apprécierez ce rôle si vous êtes organisé, persévérant, charismatique et travailleur. Vous devrez être intéressé par la technologie et ses implications commerciales. Dans ce rôle, vous collaborez avec une équipe régionale de ventes et de marketing, et votre objectif principal est de trouver des projets clients qui correspondent à nos solutions produits et de promouvoir Canonical dans plusieurs secteurs et zones géographiques différents.</p> <p>Cliquez <a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=FTMaesnL8LM">ICI</a> pour regarder notre équipe SDR discuter de son rôle dans Canonical</p> <p><strong>À quoi ressemblera votre journée</strong></p> <ul> <li>Gérer les demandes entrantes des clients par e-mail, téléphone et chat</li> <li>Exécuter des campagnes de vente et de marketing sortantes</li> <li>Se rendre à des événements et des conférences dans le monde entier, présenter sur des stands et générer des opportunités de marketing et de vente en face à face.</li> <li>Collaborer avec plusieurs équipes et parties prenantes senior pour obtenir des résultats</li> <li>Travailler directement avec le marketing sur les campagnes</li> <li>Rechercher des informations sur des clients potentiels</li> <li>Générer un pipeline de plusieurs millions d’euros</li> <li>Identifier les prospects et les tendances du marché</li> <li>Aider à définir les processus et les stratégies de l'équipe</li> <li>Assurer la liaison avec les clients nouveaux et existants, organiser et assister à des réunions tout en cartographiant activement les comptes pour identifier de nouvelles opportunités</li> <li>Créer, mettre à jour, maintenir et entretenir avec précision des prospects sur des opportunités mondiales</li> </ul> <p><strong>Ce que nous recherchons chez vous</strong></p> <ul> <li>Excellents résultats académiques à l'école et à l'université</li> <li>Passion pour les affaires et la technologie</li> <li>Envie d’apprendre et de s’améliorer continuellement - curieux, flexible, scientifique</li> <li>Résolution créative de problèmes et collaboration entre équipes</li> <li>Compétences en communication verbale et écrite</li> <li>Axé sur les résultats avec un esprit de dépassement de soi</li> <li>Persistance et persévérance</li> </ul> <p><strong>Ce que nous vous proposons</strong></p> <p>Votre salaire de base dépendra de divers facteurs, notamment votre situation géographique, votre niveau d'expérience, vos connaissances et vos compétences. En plus des avantages ci-dessus, certains postes sont également éligibles à des avantages et récompenses supplémentaires, notamment des primes annuelles et des incitations à la vente basées sur les revenus ou l'utilisation. Notre philosophie de rémunération est de garantir l’équité au sein de notre personnel mondial.</p> <p>En plus d'un salaire de base compétitif, nous offrons à tous les membres de l'équipe des avantages supplémentaires qui reflètent nos valeurs et nos idéaux. title: Representante de Desarrollo de Ventas
description: <p>Canonical es una empresa de software global, es la editora de Ubuntu y soluciones empresariales de código abierto para la nube, desarrolladores, IoT e IA. Ubuntu es la distribución de Linux de más rápido crecimiento y se ubica como el sistema operativo número uno en la nube.</p> <p>En asociación con Google, Amazon, IBM y Microsoft, Canonical ayuda a las empresas a ser más ágiles, productivas y a adoptar nuevas tecnologías más rápidamente. Ejemplos de éxito de los clientes incluyen IA, Blockchain, IoT, robótica avanzada y vehículos autónomos, donde Ubuntu es la plataforma de desarrollo preferida.</p> <p><strong>El papel de un representante de desarrollo de ventas en Canonical</strong></p> <p>Canonical es rentable y está creciendo. nombre de Canonical en múltiples industrias y geografías diferentes.</p> <p>Haz clic <a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=FTMaesnL8LM">AQUÍ</a> para ver a nuestro equipo SDR discutir su papel en Canonical</p> <p><strong>Cómo será tu día</strong></p> <ul> <li>Manejar las consultas entrantes de los clientes a través de correo electrónico, teléfono y chat.</li> <li>Ejecutar campañas salientes de ventas y marketing.</li> <li>Viajar a eventos y conferencias en todo el mundo, presentar en stands e impulsar oportunidades de marketing y ventas cara a cara.</li> <li>Colaborar entre múltiples equipos y partes interesadas de alto nivel para impulsar resultados.</li> <li>Trabajar directamente con marketing en campañas.</li> <li>Investigar información sobre clientes potenciales.</li> precisión clientes potenciales en oportunidades globales.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Lo que buscamos en ti</strong></p> <ul> <li>Excelentes resultados académicos en la escuela y la universidad.</li> equipos.</li> <li>Habilidades de comunicación verbal y escrita.</li> <li>Impulsado por resultados con un espíritu de superación</li> <li>Persistencia y perseverancia</li> </ul> <p><strong>Que te title: Revenue Accountant
description: <h3><strong></strong></h3> <p>Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.</p> <p>The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.</p> <h3><strong></strong></h3> <h3><strong>The role of a Revenue Accountant at Canonical:</strong></h3> <p>If you are passionate about the technology industry and want to work for a company that aligns with your interests, we might be the place for you! Canonical, and our world class Ubuntu product, attracts some of the leading talent from around the world. Come and work with exceptional people and advance your career in Finance! </p> <p>Our Finance team is growing and it's a really exciting time to join the team. We are looking for bright, motivated people who have a passion for making a difference. You will be seeking an opportunity to drive process improvements and change, input your ideas and truly contribute to a highly productive team. </p> <p>We are looking for an exceptional Accountant with IFRS 15 experience to help us ready the business for public market scrutiny through our planned IPO.  The right candidate will have domain expertise and a passion for IFRS 15 or ASC 606.  </p> <p><strong>Location: </strong>This role may be office based in London, or Remote in EMEA Time Zones. </p> <h3>What your day will look like</h3> <ul> <li>Assist in the month end reporting process to deliver timely and accurate information</li> <li>Have full responsibility for a part of the revenue recognition process relevant to your strengths</li> <li>Assist with the year end audit process and statutory reporting</li> <li>Support the finance team's wider plans to prepare for an IPO</li> <li>Improve the efficiency of financial processes and procedures and monitor compliance</li> <li>Share knowledge between team members to ensure cover is available when needed</li> <li>Actively develop your own skills to ensure current knowledge of applicable standards and regulations</li> <li>Establish strong relationships with key colleagues outside the wider finance team</li> </ul> <h3>What we are looking for in you</h3> <ul> <li>Exceptional academic track record and subsequent career performance</li> <li>Bachelor's degree in Accounting or equivalent</li> <li>Qualified accountant (ACCA, ACA, ACMA, CPA, etc.)</li> <li>IFRS 15/ASC 606 revenue recognition experience</li> <li>Experience at a large public accounting firm, or public multinational corporate accounting department preferred</li> <li>NetSuite or similar systems experience a plus</li> <li>Willingness to travel up to four times per year</li> </ul> <h3></h3> <h3><strong>What we offer colleagues</strong></h3> <p>We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.</p> <ul> <li>Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person</li> <li>Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year</li> <li>Annual compensation review</li> <li>Recognition rewards</li> <li>Annual holiday leave</li> <li>Maternity and paternity leave</li> <li>Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform</li> <li>Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues</li> <li>Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long-haul company events</li> </ul> <h3><strong>About Canonical</strong></h3> <p>Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004.​ Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.</p> <p><strong>Canonical is an equal opportunity employer</strong></p> <p>We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products.<a href="https://canonical.com/careers/diversity/identity"> Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.</a></p> <p>#LI-remote</p> <h3></h3>
